attributes.name: secondary_mor_operator_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the certified water treatment plant operator responsible for preparing and submitting the monthly operating report.

attributes.name: primary_parent_mor_submission_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original MOR submission record when this record is a resubmission or amendment. Null for original submissions. Enables lineage tracking across submission versions.
attributes.references: Water Utilities Data Lineage Policy; EPA MOR Amendment Tracking

attributes.name: source_mor_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervising operator or plant manager who reviewed and approved the monthly operating report before submission.

attributes.name: secondary_primary_amended_mor_submission_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on mor_submission (amended_mor_submission_id)

attributes.name: regulatory_agency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory agency (e.g., state primacy agency, EPA regional office) that is the designated recipient of this MOR submission.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; State Primacy Agency Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory agency formally accepted and acknowledged the MOR submission as complete and compliant. Null if not yet accepted.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; State Primacy Agency Acceptance Procedures

attributes.name: average_daily_flow_mgd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Daily Flow (Million Gallons per Day)
attributes.description: Average daily flow rate of water produced or wastewater treated during the reporting month, measured in million gallons per day.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) M6 Manual

tag_set.value: Average Daily Flow (Million Gallons per Day)

attributes.name: avg_daily_flow_mgd
attributes.description: Average daily flow volume processed at the facility during the reporting month, expressed in Million Gallons per Day (MGD). Key operational metric reported in MOR and used for capacity planning and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; AWWA M1 Manual; NPDES Permit Conditions

attributes.name: avg_turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: Average turbidity of finished water or effluent during the reporting month, measured in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU). Reported in MOR as an indicator of filtration and treatment effectiveness.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule; SDWA; AWWA Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: bod_avg_mg_l
attributes.description: Average Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) of treated effluent during the reporting month, expressed in milligrams per liter (mg/L). Applicable to WWTP/STP MOR submissions; reported for NPDES permit compliance against effluent limits.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES Permit Program; CWA Effluent Guidelines; WEF MOP 8

attributes.name: chlorine_residual_avg_mg_l
attributes.description: Average free or total chlorine residual concentration in finished water or distribution system during the reporting month, expressed in milligrams per liter (mg/L). Reported in MOR to demonstrate disinfection maintenance compliance.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; Total Coliform Rule; AWWA Disinfection Guidelines

attributes.name: chlorine_residual_compliance_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether chlorine residual levels in the distribution system during the reporting month met the minimum required disinfectant residual of 0.2 milligrams per liter.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or tracking number issued by the regulatory agency upon receipt of the monthly operating report submission.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MOR submission record was first created in the system (Silver layer ingestion time). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Water Utilities Data Governance Policy; ISO 9001 Quality Management Records

attributes.name: ct_compliance_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether all disinfection contact time calculations during the reporting month achieved the required CT values for pathogen inactivation.

attributes.name: ct_compliance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of operating days during the reporting month where the facility achieved the required CT (Contact Time for Disinfection) value as mandated by the Surface Water Treatment Rule. Critical SDWA compliance metric reported in MOR.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR); SDWA; EPA CT Guidance Manual

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which the monthly operating report data was compiled, such as OSIsoft PI Historian, LIMS, or SCADA.

attributes.name: days_late
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the MOR submission exceeded the regulatory due date. Zero or null if submitted on time. Used for enforcement and compliance scoring.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Enforcement Policy; State Primacy Agency Compliance Monitoring

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or URL pointing to the official MOR document (PDF or electronic file) submitted to the regulatory agency. Enables retrieval of the source report for audit and compliance review.
attributes.references: Water Utilities Document Management Policy; EPA Electronic Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which this Monthly Operating Report must be submitted to the designated agency. Used for compliance tracking and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: State Drinking Water Program Reporting Deadlines; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the treatment facility covered by this MOR. WTP = Water Treatment Plant; WWTP = Wastewater Treatment Plant; STP = Sewage Treatment Plant. Determines applicable regulatory standards and report sections.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; EPA CWA; NPDES Permit Program

attributes.name: haa5_level_ug_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of Haloacetic Acids (HAA5), a class of Disinfection Byproducts (DBPs), in finished water during the reporting month, expressed in micrograms per liter (µg/L). Reported in MOR for DBP Rule compliance; MCL is 60 µg/L.
attributes.references: EPA Disinfection Byproducts Rule (DBPR); SDWA MCL Standards; EPA Stage 2 DBPR

attributes.name: has_mcl_exceedance
attributes.description: Indicates whether any Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) was exceeded at the facility during the reporting month (True = exceedance occurred). Triggers public notification and corrective action requirements under SDWA.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA MCL Standards; National Primary Drinking Water Regulations; State Primacy Agency Requirements

attributes.name: has_sso_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Sanitary Sewer Overflow (SSO) event occurred at or associated with the facility during the reporting month (True = SSO occurred). Applicable to WWTP submissions; triggers mandatory regulatory notification under NPDES.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES SSO Reporting Requirements; CWA; State SSO Reporting Rules

attributes.name: is_late_submission
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MOR was submitted after the regulatory due date (True = late submission). Used for compliance tracking and regulatory penalty assessment.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Enforcement Policy; State Primacy Agency Compliance Monitoring

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MOR submission record was most recently modified in the system. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: Water Utilities Data Governance Policy; ISO 9001 Quality Management Records

attributes.name: max_daily_flow_mgd
attributes.description: Maximum single-day flow volume processed at the facility during the reporting month, expressed in Million Gallons per Day (MGD). Used to assess peak demand and permit compliance against maximum daily flow limits.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; NPDES Permit Conditions; AWWA M1 Manual

attributes.name: max_turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: Maximum single turbidity reading recorded during the reporting month, measured in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU). Used to identify peak exceedance events and assess MCL compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule; SDWA MCL Standards

attributes.name: mcl_exceedance_count
attributes.description: Number of maximum contaminant level exceedances detected during the reporting month across all monitored parameters.

attributes.name: min_daily_flow_mgd
attributes.description: Minimum single-day flow volume processed at the facility during the reporting month, expressed in Million Gallons per Day (MGD). Used for operational range analysis and low-flow condition monitoring.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; NPDES Permit Conditions

attributes.name: narrative_summary
attributes.description: Operator-provided narrative summary describing significant operational events, process adjustments, equipment issues, or unusual conditions during the reporting month.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or compliance staff to record explanatory notes, unusual conditions, corrective actions taken, or other contextual information relevant to this MOR submission period.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; Water Utilities Compliance Documentation Policy

attributes.name: operator_certification_grade
attributes.description: Certification grade level of the submitting operator (e.g., Grade 1, Grade 2, Grade 3, Grade 4) as issued by the state primacy agency. Must meet or exceed the classification grade of the facility being reported on.
attributes.references: State Drinking Water Program Operator Certification Requirements; AWWA Operator Certification Standards

attributes.name: operator_certification_number
attributes.description: State-issued certification number of the licensed operator who prepared and certified the monthly operating report.

attributes.name: operator_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued certification license number of the responsible operator who signed and submitted this MOR. Required by state drinking water programs to verify that reports are prepared by a certified operator.
attributes.references: State Drinking Water Program Operator Certification Requirements; AWWA Operator Certification Standards

attributes.name: peak_daily_flow_mgd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Peak Daily Flow (Million Gallons per Day)
attributes.description: Maximum daily flow rate recorded during the reporting month, measured in million gallons per day.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) M6 Manual

tag_set.value: Peak Daily Flow (Million Gallons per Day)

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: The NPDES permit number or state operating permit number associated with the facility for which this MOR is submitted. Links the report to the governing regulatory authorization.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES Permit Program; CWA Section 402; SDWA Operating Permit Requirements

attributes.name: ph_avg
attributes.description: Average pH (Potential of Hydrogen) of treated water or effluent during the reporting month. Reported in MOR as a water quality parameter; typical drinking water range is 6.5–8.5 per SDWA secondary standards.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Secondary Standards; NPDES Permit Conditions; AWWA Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: public_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which public notification was issued for any violations or exceedances during the reporting month.

attributes.name: public_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether any violations or exceedances during the reporting month triggered mandatory public notification requirements.

attributes.name: pwsid
attributes.description: EPA-assigned public water system identification number for the facility submitting the monthly operating report.
attributes.references: EPA Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS)

attributes.name: regulatory_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory agency officially accepted the monthly operating report as complete and compliant.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory agency formally rejected the MOR submission. Null if not rejected. Used to track resubmission timelines and compliance history.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; State Primacy Agency Rejection Procedures

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation provided by the regulatory agency for rejecting the MOR submission. Null if not rejected. Used to guide corrective action and resubmission.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; State Primacy Agency Feedback Procedures

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this MOR submission, used for regulatory correspondence and tracking (e.g., MOR-WTP01-2024-03).
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; State Drinking Water Program Reporting Standards

attributes.name: reporting_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) for which this Monthly Operating Report covers operational data. Combined with reporting_year to define the reporting period.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; AWWA M1 Manual — Principles of Water Rates

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the calendar month covered by this monthly operating report submission.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the calendar month covered by this monthly operating report submission.

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: Calendar year (e.g., 2024) for which this Monthly Operating Report covers operational data. Combined with reporting_month to define the reporting period.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; SDWA Annual Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: resubmission_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which a corrected monthly operating report must be resubmitted to the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: resubmission_number
attributes.description: Sequential resubmission count for this reporting period and facility (0 = original submission, 1 = first resubmission, 2 = second resubmission, etc.). Used to track amendment history following regulatory rejection or voluntary correction.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; State Primacy Agency Resubmission Procedures

attributes.name: resubmission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the regulatory agency has requested resubmission of the monthly operating report with corrections or additional information.

attributes.name: scada_data_source
attributes.description: Identifier or tag reference for the OSIsoft PI Historian / SCADA data source from which process metrics (flow, turbidity, CT values) were extracted to populate this MOR. Supports data lineage and audit traceability back to the operational system of record.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Integration Standards; Water Utilities SCADA Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: submission_due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the monthly operating report must be submitted to avoid non-compliance.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the MOR was submitted to the regulatory agency. Electronic submissions may be via state regulatory portal or EPA NetDMR; paper submissions are physical mail.
attributes.references: EPA NetDMR Electronic Reporting Rule; State Primacy Agency Submission Requirements

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this monthly operating report submission for tracking and correspondence with regulatory agencies.

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the MOR submission in the regulatory workflow. Draft indicates report is being prepared; submitted indicates it has been sent to the regulatory agency; accepted indicates agency approval; rejected indicates agency rejection requiring resubmission; under_review indicates agency is actively reviewing.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; State Primacy Agency Workflow Standards

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the MOR was formally submitted to the regulatory agency. This is the principal business event timestamp for the submission transaction.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; SDWA Reporting Deadlines

attributes.name: supervisor_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supervising operator or plant manager approved the monthly operating report for submission.

attributes.name: total_production_volume_mg
attributes.description: Total volume of finished water produced or wastewater treated during the reporting month, measured in million gallons.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) M6 Manual

attributes.name: total_volume_treated_mg
attributes.description: Total volume of water or wastewater treated at the facility during the reporting month, expressed in Million Gallons. Derived from daily flow records and reported in the MOR for production accounting.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines; AWWA Water Audit Methodology

attributes.name: tss_avg_mg_l
attributes.description: Average Total Suspended Solids (TSS) concentration in treated effluent during the reporting month, expressed in milligrams per liter (mg/L). Applicable to WWTP/STP MOR submissions; reported for NPDES permit compliance.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES Permit Program; CWA Effluent Guidelines; WEF MOP 8

attributes.name: tthm_level_ug_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of Total Trihalomethanes (THMs), a class of Disinfection Byproducts (DBPs), in finished water during the reporting month, expressed in micrograms per liter (µg/L). Reported in MOR for DBP Rule compliance; MCL is 80 µg/L.
attributes.references: EPA Disinfection Byproducts Rule (DBPR); SDWA MCL Standards; EPA Stage 2 DBPR

attributes.name: turbidity_compliance_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether all turbidity measurements during the reporting month met the regulatory maximum contaminant level of 0.3 Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU) for 95% of samples.

attributes.name: turbidity_compliance_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of turbidity measurements during the reporting month that met the Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) or treatment technique standard, expressed in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU). Key finished water quality metric in MOR.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule; SDWA MCL Standards; EPA Turbidity Guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this monthly operating report submission record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of regulatory violations recorded during the reporting month, including monitoring, reporting, and treatment technique violations.

attributes.name: violations_count
attributes.description: Total number of regulatory violations (MCL exceedances, treatment technique violations, monitoring violations) recorded at the facility during the reporting month and included in this MOR submission.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Violation Categories; NPDES Compliance Monitoring; State Primacy Agency Reporting

products.name: scada_tag
products.description: Master reference table for scada_tag. Referenced by: distribution.pressure_monitoring_point.scada_tag_id, treatment.source_water_intake.scada_tag_id, treatment.uv_disinfection_event.scada_tag_id

attributes.name: scada_tag_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Tag ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian tag record in the master tag registry. Primary key for the scada_tag data product.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Data Reference; AWWA M2 - Instrumentation and Control

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Tag ID

attributes.name: derived_from_scada_tag_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on scada_tag (derived_from_scada_tag_id)

attributes.name: online_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the physical instrument or sensor asset that provides the measurement for this SCADA tag. Links the tag to the asset management system (CMMS) for calibration tracking and maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: ISA-5.1 Instrumentation Symbols and Identification, ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: pi_point_id
attributes.description: The unique point identifier in the OSIsoft PI Historian system that corresponds to this SCADA tag. Used for direct integration with PI System for time-series data retrieval and analysis.

attributes.name: primary_scada_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical instrument or sensor asset (e.g., flow meter, pressure transmitter, turbidimeter, chlorine analyzer, pH probe, level sensor) registered in the asset management system (IBM Maximo) that this tag represents.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: primary_scada_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the water treatment plant (WTP) or wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) where this SCADA tag is deployed. Links the tag to its physical facility location.
attributes.references: AWWA Standards, WEF Manual of Practice

attributes.name: primary_scada_process_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific treatment process unit (filter, clarifier, UV reactor, chemical dosing system, etc.) that this SCADA tag monitors or controls. Enables drill-down analysis by process stage.

attributes.name: secondary_scada_treatment_process_process_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific treatment process unit (e.g., coagulation basin, filter unit, UV reactor, chlorination contact chamber, RO train) to which this tag is associated.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Asset Framework (AF); AWWA M2

attributes.name: secondary_scada_wtp_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Treatment Plant (WTP) / Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) Facility ID
attributes.description: Reference to the treatment facility (WTP or WWTP) where this SCADA tag is physically installed and operationally active.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; NPDES Permit Program; AWWA M2

tag_set.value: Water Treatment Plant (WTP) / Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) Facility ID

attributes.name: alarm_delay_seconds
attributes.description: The time delay in seconds before an alarm is triggered after the tag value crosses the alarm threshold. Used to prevent nuisance alarms from transient process fluctuations. Typical values range from 0 (immediate) to 300 seconds (5 minutes).
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems for the Process Industries

attributes.name: alarm_priority
attributes.description: The priority classification assigned to alarms generated by this SCADA tag. Critical alarms require immediate operator response, high alarms need prompt attention, medium alarms should be addressed within shift, low alarms are monitored, and informational alarms are logged for trending.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems for the Process Industries, EEMUA 191 Alarm Systems Guide

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the physical instrument associated with this tag must next be calibrated per the facility's calibration schedule and regulatory requirements. Overdue calibration may invalidate regulatory compliance data and trigger MOR reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Measurement System Analysis; EPA SDWA Analytical Method Requirements; AWWA M2; State Primacy Agency Calibration Requirements

attributes.name: calibration_interval_days
attributes.description: The required frequency in days between instrument calibrations as specified by the manufacturer, facility SOP, or regulatory requirement. Used to auto-calculate calibration_due_date and trigger preventive maintenance work orders in IBM Maximo.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; AWWA M2; EPA SDWA Analytical Method Requirements; IBM Maximo PM

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: The date this SCADA tag was first commissioned and activated in the PI Historian system, marking the start of its operational data collection lifecycle. Used for data availability analysis and asset age tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA M2; IBM Maximo Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: compression_deviation
attributes.description: The exception/compression deviation threshold configured in PI Historian for this tag. Values within this deviation from the last stored value are suppressed to reduce archive storage. Critical for balancing data fidelity against storage efficiency. Expressed in the tag's engineering units.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Data Archive Configuration Guide; AWWA M2

attributes.name: compression_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether data compression is enabled for this SCADA tag in the historian system. Compression reduces storage requirements by only recording values when they change significantly, rather than at every scan interval.

attributes.name: compression_max_time_seconds
attributes.description: The maximum time in seconds that PI Historian will suppress a value due to compression before forcing a new archive event, even if the value has not changed beyond the compression deviation. Ensures regulatory compliance data is recorded at minimum required intervals.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Data Archive Configuration Guide; EPA SDWA Monitoring Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SCADA tag record was first created in the master tag registry. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Record Control; EPA SDWA Data Retention; AWWA M2

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Current data quality status of the tag as assessed by PI Historian or the data quality management process. 'good' = reliable data; 'questionable' = data may be unreliable (e.g., instrument drift suspected); 'bad' = known bad data (e.g., instrument failure, communication error); 'substituted' = manual or calculated substitute value in use; 'out_of_service' = instrument intentionally offline.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Data Quality; EPA SDWA Data Quality Requirements; AWWA M2

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the SCADA system or historian that is the authoritative source for this tag's data, such as OSIsoft PI Historian, Wonderware Historian, or specific PLC/RTU system. Enables data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Enterprise-Control System Integration, OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: data_type
attributes.description: The native data type of the tag value as stored in the PI Historian archive. Determines precision, storage requirements, and compatibility with downstream analytics. 'float32'/'float64' for analog measurements, 'int16'/'int32' for integer counts, 'boolean'/'digital' for on/off states, 'string' for text-based status tags. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: float32|float64|int16|int32|int64|boolean|string|digital — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Configuration Guide; IEEE 754 Floating Point Standard

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: The date this SCADA tag was decommissioned and removed from active data collection. Null for active tags. Used for historical data completeness analysis and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA M2; EPA Data Retention Requirements

attributes.name: display_digits
attributes.description: The number of decimal places to display for this tag's value in HMI screens, PI Vision dashboards, and operator reports. Configured per instrument precision requirements (e.g., 2 for turbidity in NTU, 3 for chlorine residual in mg/L, 0 for integer counts).
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Configuration; AWWA M2 HMI Display Standards

attributes.name: engineering_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measurement for the tag's process variable as configured in PI Historian (e.g., NTU, MGD, GPM, PSI, mg/L, pH, °C, mJ/cm², %, ft, mW/cm²). Aligns with AWWA and EPA standard measurement units for water treatment process parameters.
attributes.references: AWWA M2; EPA SDWA Measurement Standards; ISA-5.1; NIST SP 811

attributes.name: gis_latitude
attributes.description: The latitude coordinate (in decimal degrees) of the physical location of the instrument or measurement point associated with this SCADA tag. Enables spatial analysis and integration with GIS systems for asset mapping and network modeling.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geographic Coordinate System, Esri ArcGIS Standards

attributes.name: gis_longitude
attributes.description: The longitude coordinate (in decimal degrees) of the physical location of the instrument or measurement point associated with this SCADA tag. Enables spatial analysis and integration with GIS systems for asset mapping and network modeling.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geographic Coordinate System, Esri ArcGIS Standards

attributes.name: high_alarm_limit
attributes.description: The threshold value above which the SCADA system generates a high alarm for this tag. Alerts operators to potential process deviations requiring attention. May be regulatory-driven for compliance parameters such as turbidity or chlorine residual.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems for the Process Industries, EPA Drinking Water Standards

attributes.name: high_limit
attributes.description: The critical upper alarm threshold for this tag. When the process variable exceeds this value, a high-priority (Level 1) alarm is triggered in the SCADA/HMI system, typically requiring immediate operator intervention. For regulatory parameters (e.g., turbidity, chlorine residual), this may align with MCL exceedance thresholds.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems; EPA SDWA MCL; AWWA M2

attributes.name: high_range_limit
attributes.description: The maximum value in the normal operating range for this SCADA tag. Values above this threshold may indicate sensor malfunction, process upset, or alarm condition. Used for data validation and quality checks.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Enterprise-Control System Integration, AWWA Standards

attributes.name: high_trip_limit
attributes.description: The critical threshold value above which the SCADA system triggers an automatic shutdown or safety interlock for this tag. Represents a safety or regulatory compliance boundary that requires immediate automated response.
attributes.references: ISA-84 Safety Instrumented Systems, EPA Safe Drinking Water Act

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: The date when the instrument or SCADA tag was first installed and commissioned in the treatment plant. Used for asset lifecycle tracking, depreciation calculations, and planning for equipment replacement.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical instrument or sensor type associated with this tag (e.g., flow_meter, pressure_transmitter, turbidimeter, chlorine_analyzer, ph_probe, level_sensor, temperature_sensor, uv_intensity_sensor, conductivity_analyzer, dissolved_oxygen_analyzer). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flow_meter|pressure_transmitter|turbidimeter|chlorine_analyzer|ph_probe|level_sensor|temperature_sensor|uv_intensity_sensor|conductivity_analyzer|dissolved_oxygen_analyzer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AWWA M2 - Instrumentation and Control; ISA-5.1 Instrumentation Symbols and Identification

attributes.name: is_critical_control_point
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tag monitors a Critical Control Point (CCP) in the treatment process as defined by the facility's Water Safety Plan or Process Control Plan. CCP tags require enhanced monitoring, alarm management, and data quality assurance per AWWA and EPA guidance.
attributes.references: EPA Water Safety Plan Guidance; AWWA Process Control; WHO Water Safety Plans; ISO 22000

attributes.name: is_ct_compliance_parameter
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Contact Time (CT) Compliance Parameter Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SCADA tag is used in CT (Contact Time) compliance calculations for disinfection. CT is the product of disinfectant concentration and contact time, required to demonstrate adequate pathogen inactivation per EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule, EPA Long Term 2 Enhanced Surface Water Treatment Rule

tag_set.value: Is Contact Time (CT) Compliance Parameter Flag

attributes.name: is_ct_compliance_tag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tag is used in the calculation of CT (Contact Time for Disinfection) compliance values per the Surface Water Treatment Rule. CT compliance tags (disinfectant residual and flow rate) require continuous monitoring and are critical for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR); 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA M2

attributes.name: is_dmr_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SCADA tag's data must be included in the Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR) submitted under the NPDES (National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System) permit for wastewater discharge compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Water Act, EPA NPDES Permit Program

tag_set.value: Is Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR) Reportable Flag

attributes.name: is_mor_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether data from this tag is included in the Monthly Operating Report (MOR) submitted to the state primacy agency. MOR-reportable tags require higher data quality standards, complete audit trails, and validated calibration records.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; State Primacy Agency MOR Requirements; AWWA M2

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: The date the physical instrument associated with this tag was most recently calibrated and verified. Used to assess data quality, support MOR submissions, and schedule preventive maintenance in IBM Maximo.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; EPA SDWA; AWWA M2; IBM Maximo PM Scheduling

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the physical location of the instrument or measurement point associated with this SCADA tag, including building, room, equipment identifier, and piping location. Aids field technicians in locating equipment for maintenance and calibration.

attributes.name: low_alarm_limit
attributes.description: The threshold value below which the SCADA system generates a low alarm for this tag. Alerts operators to potential process deviations requiring attention. May be regulatory-driven for compliance parameters.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems for the Process Industries, EPA Drinking Water Standards

attributes.name: low_limit
attributes.description: The lower warning alarm threshold for this tag. When the process variable falls below this value, a low-priority warning alarm is triggered (e.g., low chlorine residual warning before MCL violation, low flow rate indicating pump issue).
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems; AWWA M2; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: low_range_limit
attributes.description: The minimum value in the normal operating range for this SCADA tag. Values below this threshold may indicate sensor malfunction, process upset, or alarm condition. Used for data validation and quality checks.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Enterprise-Control System Integration, AWWA Standards

attributes.name: low_trip_limit
attributes.description: The critical threshold value below which the SCADA system triggers an automatic shutdown or safety interlock for this tag. Represents a safety or regulatory compliance boundary that requires immediate automated response.
attributes.references: ISA-84 Safety Instrumented Systems, EPA Safe Drinking Water Act

attributes.name: maximo_asset_num
attributes.description: The asset number assigned to the physical instrument in IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS). Enables cross-referencing between the SCADA tag registry and the asset management system for maintenance work orders, failure history, and lifecycle cost tracking.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA CMMS Best Practices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operators and engineers to document additional context, configuration details, operational considerations, or historical information about this SCADA tag that is not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: AWWA Standards, WEF Manual of Practice

attributes.name: parameter_measured
attributes.description: The physical or chemical parameter that this SCADA tag measures or controls, such as flow rate, pressure, turbidity, chlorine residual, pH, temperature, level, or valve position. Uses industry-standard terminology.
attributes.references: AWWA Standards, EPA Drinking Water Standards, Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater

attributes.name: pi_af_element_path
attributes.description: The full hierarchical path of this tag within the OSIsoft PI Asset Framework (AF) element hierarchy (e.g., '\\WaterUtilities\WTP1\Filtration\Filter1\EffluentTurbidity'). Enables contextual analytics, template-based reporting, and structured navigation of the treatment process hierarchy in PI Vision and PI DataLink.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Asset Framework (AF) Configuration Guide; AWWA M2

attributes.name: pi_server_name
attributes.description: The name of the OSIsoft PI Data Archive server instance where this tag's time-series data is stored. Water utilities may operate multiple PI servers (e.g., one per WTP/WWTP or a centralized enterprise PI server). Used for data retrieval routing and server capacity management.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Architecture Guide; AWWA Cybersecurity Guidance

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: The fully qualified, unique tag name as registered in the OSIsoft PI Historian server. This is the primary operational identifier used by SCADA/PI systems to retrieve time-series data (e.g., 'WTP1.FILT1.TURB.PV'). Must conform to PI tag naming conventions.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Naming Standard; AWWA M2 - Instrumentation and Control

attributes.name: plc_controller_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the PLC or RTU (Remote Terminal Unit) that physically reads or controls this SCADA tag. Links the tag to the specific control hardware in the field.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Enterprise-Control System Integration, IEC 61131 PLC Programming Standards

attributes.name: process_area
attributes.description: The treatment process area or stage where this tag is located (e.g., raw_water_intake, coagulation, flocculation, sedimentation, filtration, disinfection_uv, disinfection_chlorination, ro_treatment, gac_adsorption, finished_water_storage, chemical_feed, backwash). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_water_intake|coagulation|flocculation|sedimentation|filtration|disinfection_uv|disinfection_chlorination|ro_treatment|gac_adsorption|finished_water_storage|chemical_feed|backwash — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AWWA M2; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule; OSIsoft PI AF Hierarchy

attributes.name: regulatory_limit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory limit applied to this SCADA tag. MCL (Maximum Contaminant Level) is an enforceable standard, MCLG (Maximum Contaminant Level Goal) is a non-enforceable health goal, action level triggers additional monitoring, treatment technique requires specific treatment processes, and operational limit is a facility-specific permit condition.
attributes.references: EPA Safe Drinking Water Act, EPA National Primary Drinking Water Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_limit_value
attributes.description: The regulatory compliance threshold for this SCADA tag, such as Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) for turbidity, chlorine residual, or disinfection byproducts. Used for automated compliance monitoring and Monthly Operating Report (MOR) generation.
attributes.references: EPA Safe Drinking Water Act, EPA National Primary Drinking Water Regulations, State Drinking Water Programs

attributes.name: regulatory_parameter
attributes.description: Identifies whether this tag monitors a parameter subject to EPA or state drinking water/wastewater regulatory compliance requirements. Maps the tag to specific regulatory frameworks: turbidity (Surface Water Treatment Rule), chlorine_residual (SDWA disinfection), ct_value (CT compliance), uv_dose (UV disinfection rule), dbp_thm (THM/TTHM rule), dbp_haa5 (HAA5 rule), pfas (PFAS MCL), none (non-regulatory operational tag). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: turbidity|chlorine_residual|ph|fluoride|ct_value|uv_dose|toc|bod|tss|tds|pfas|dbp_thm|dbp_haa5|none — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR); Stage 2 DBP Rule; LCRR; PFAS National Primary Drinking Water Regulation

attributes.name: scada_system
attributes.description: Identifies the SCADA or DCS platform that is the originating source of this tag's data before it is archived in PI Historian. Supports multi-vendor SCADA environments and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: AWWA M2; NIST SP 800-82 ICS Security; OSIsoft PI Historian Interface Documentation

attributes.name: scan_interval_seconds
attributes.description: The frequency at which the SCADA system reads or updates this tag's value, expressed in seconds. Critical for understanding data granularity and system performance. Typical values range from 1 second for critical control loops to 300 seconds (5 minutes) for slow-changing parameters.

attributes.name: scan_rate_seconds
attributes.description: The frequency in seconds at which the PI Historian interface scans the PLC/RTU/SCADA source for new data values for this tag. Common values: 1 (high-frequency process control), 5, 10, 30, 60 (regulatory compliance monitoring), 300 (trend monitoring). Directly impacts data storage volume and process control responsiveness.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Interface Configuration; AWWA M2; EPA CT Compliance Monitoring

attributes.name: source_address
attributes.description: The register address or OPC-UA node identifier on the PLC/RTU from which the PI Historian interface reads this tag's value (e.g., Modbus register address, OPC item path). Essential for SCADA interface configuration and data quality troubleshooting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Interface Configuration; IEC 61131; OPC Foundation OPC-UA Standard

attributes.name: span_value
attributes.description: The maximum (span) end of the instrument's calibrated measurement range, expressed in engineering units. Used for signal scaling, over-range detection, and calibration verification (e.g., 10.0 for a 0–10 NTU turbidimeter, 200.0 for a 0–200 PSI pressure transmitter).
attributes.references: ISA-5.1; AWWA M2 - Instrumentation and Control; ISO 9001 Calibration

attributes.name: substitution_mode
attributes.description: Defines how PI Historian handles missing or bad-quality data values for this tag during data gaps (e.g., instrument offline, communication failure). 'none' = no substitution, gap remains; 'last_value' = hold last good value; 'interpolated' = linear interpolation; 'manual_entry' = operator-entered substitute value for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Data Quality; EPA SDWA Data Completeness Requirements; State MOR Guidance

attributes.name: tag_alias
attributes.description: An alternative short name or alias for the tag used in HMI displays, operator logs, or legacy SCADA systems where the full PI tag name is too long. Facilitates cross-system tag mapping and operator familiarity.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Configuration; AWWA M2 HMI Standards

attributes.name: tag_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the tag's measurement purpose and physical location (e.g., 'Filter 1 Effluent Turbidity Process Variable - WTP1'). Used in operator HMI displays, PI Vision dashboards, and MOR reporting.

attributes.name: tag_name
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric name or identifier assigned to the SCADA tag within the SCADA system. This is the human-readable tag name used by operators and engineers to identify the measurement point or control point.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Enterprise-Control System Integration, OSIsoft PI System Naming Conventions

attributes.name: tag_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the SCADA tag. 'active' = tag is live and collecting data; 'inactive' = tag exists but data collection is paused; 'decommissioned' = tag retired from service; 'maintenance' = tag temporarily offline for instrument servicing; 'spare' = tag reserved for future instrument.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA M2

attributes.name: tag_type
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI Historian tag data class type. 'analog_input' = continuous process variable (e.g., turbidity, flow, pressure); 'analog_output' = control output signal; 'digital_input' = discrete on/off state; 'digital_output' = discrete control command; 'calculated' = PI Performance Equation derived tag; 'accumulator' = totalizer tag; 'string' = text-based state tag. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: analog_input|analog_output|digital_input|digital_output|calculated|accumulator|string — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Configuration Guide; ISA-5.1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SCADA tag record was most recently modified in the master tag registry (e.g., alarm limit change, scan rate adjustment, status update). Supports change management and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Record Control; EPA SDWA Data Retention; AWWA M2

attributes.name: zero_value
attributes.description: The minimum (zero) end of the instrument's calibrated measurement range, expressed in engineering units. Used for signal scaling, calibration verification, and alarm setpoint validation (e.g., 0.0 for a 0–10 NTU turbidimeter).
attributes.references: ISA-5.1; AWWA M2 - Instrumentation and Control; ISO 9001 Calibration

products.name: facility_service_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational allocation between water treatment facilities and service territories. It captures the primary/backup facility designations, capacity allocation percentages for cost distribution, and interconnection infrastructure that enables one facility to serve multiple territories and one territory to receive water from multiple facilities. Each record links one facility to one service territory with attributes that exist only in the context of this operational relationship.. Existence Justification: Water utilities operate multiple treatment facilities serving overlapping service territories with primary and backup designations for system redundancy and emergency response. One facility provides water to multiple territories, and one territory receives water from multiple facilities through interconnection infrastructure. The business actively manages allocation percentages for cost distribution, primary/backup status for emergency protocols, and interconnection points for hydraulic modeling.

products.name: facility_project
products.description: This association product represents the operational involvement between a water treatment facility and a capital improvement project. It captures which facilities are affected by which CIP projects, the specific areas of the facility under construction or upgrade, the construction phasing, and operational impacts during project execution. Each record links one facility to one CIP project with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, enabling project managers to track multi-facility projects and facility operators to manage multiple concurrent projects at a single plant.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, treatment facilities routinely have multiple concurrent capital projects (e.g., filter upgrades, SCADA improvements, chemical feed system replacements), and regional CIP programs often span multiple facilities (e.g., utility-wide SCADA replacement, disinfection byproduct compliance program across all plants). Project managers need to track which facilities are affected by each project, the construction phasing at each site, and operational impacts. Facility operators need to manage multiple concurrent projects affecting different areas of their plant.

products.name: operator_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the qualification and authorization relationship between treatment process units and utility operators. It captures operator-specific competency assessments, equipment-specific training records, and authorization status required for regulatory compliance and safe operation of treatment processes. Each record links one process unit to one qualified operator with certification dates, competency levels, and authorization expiration tracking.. Existence Justification: In water utility treatment operations, operators must be individually qualified and authorized to operate specific process units (membrane systems, UV reactors, chemical feed systems, etc.) based on equipment-specific training and competency assessments. Each operator is qualified on multiple process units to provide operational flexibility, and each process unit requires multiple qualified operators to ensure 24/7 shift coverage and regulatory compliance. The qualification relationship itself carries critical operational data including certification dates, competency levels, authorization expiration dates, and primary operator designations that belong to neither the process unit nor the employee alone.

products.description: This association product represents the compliance obligation between a treatment permit and a regulatory requirement. It captures the specific monitoring, reporting, and compliance tracking for each permit-requirement combination. Each record links one treatment permit to one regulatory requirement with attributes that track compliance status, assessment dates, and monitoring schedules that exist only in the context of this specific permit-requirement relationship.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, each treatment permit must comply with multiple regulatory requirements (SDWA MCLs, Surface Water Treatment Rule, Lead and Copper Rule, Stage 2 DBPR, etc.), and each regulatory requirement applies to multiple permits across different facilities. The utility actively manages these permit-compliance obligations by tracking compliance status, monitoring schedules, assessment dates, and responsible staff for each permit-requirement combination. This is an operational compliance management process, not an analytical correlation.

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all water and wastewater service accounts including residential, commercial, industrial, and municipal customers. Manages customer profiles, service addresses, account hierarchies, customer segments, contact information, service agreements, and customer lifecycle from application through termination. SSOT for customer identity across all billing, metering, and service delivery systems.

products.name: customer_account
products.description: Master record for every water and wastewater service account — residential, commercial, industrial, and municipal. Serves as the SSOT for customer identity across Oracle CC&B, SAP, AMI, and all downstream systems. Captures account number, account type (residential/commercial/industrial/municipal), account status (active/inactive/pending/suspended/terminated), service class, credit rating, account open date, account close date, language preference, paperless billing flag, autopay enrollment, lifecycle stage, and water budget allocation (where applicable). This is the primary anchor entity for the customer domain — all billing, metering, service delivery, and regulatory reporting references flow through this entity.

products.name: contact
products.description: Master record of all contact points, communication preferences, and third-party notification arrangements associated with a customer account or person. Captures contact type (billing, service, emergency, legal notice, third-party notification), contact value, contact channel (phone/email/SMS/postal/portal), is_primary flag, is_verified flag, verification date, opt-in/opt-out status per communication channel, preferred language, notification trigger type (for third-party arrangements: pre-disconnect, outage, boil-water notice), ADA accommodation flags (large print, braille, TTY), relationship to account holder (for third-party contacts), effective date range, and consent documentation reference. Supports multi-channel customer communications including CCR delivery, boil-water notices, outage notifications, TCPA/CAN-SPAM compliance, EPA CCR electronic delivery rules, and state PUC consumer protection rules for third-party notification before disconnection.
products.reference: Oracle CC&B Contact / MS Dynamics 365 Contact

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contact record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_contact_customer_account_id

attributes.references: Oracle Utilities Customer Care and Billing (CC&B) - Customer Account Object

attributes.name: secondary_contact_customer_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account or person this contact is associated with. Links contact to the customer master record in Oracle Utilities CC&B.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities Customer Care and Billing (CC&B) - Customer Account Object

attributes.name: person_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.person. Business justification: Contact points (phone, email) may be associated with specific persons in addition to accounts. This allows tracking which person at an account uses which contact method. Nullable FK as some contacts a

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Contact information verification (especially for emergency notifications, LCRR compliance) is performed by CSR staff. Data quality accountability and regulatory compliance requirement. New attribute n

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The communication channel or medium through which this contact point operates. Supports multi-channel customer engagement including Consumer Confidence Report (CCR) delivery, boil-water notices, and outage notifications.
attributes.references: Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) Public Notification Requirements

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Active contacts are used for communications; inactive contacts are retained for history; invalid contacts have been identified as unreachable; pending_verification contacts await confirmation.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact purpose. Indicates whether this contact is used for billing correspondence, service notifications, emergency alerts, legal notices, technical communications, or general customer service inquiries.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Customer Communication Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_failure_count
attributes.description: Count of failed communication delivery attempts to this contact. Used to identify problematic contacts and trigger validation workflows.

attributes.name: delivery_success_count
attributes.description: Count of successful communication deliveries to this contact. Used to calculate contact reliability and quality scores.

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating customer has requested no contact through this channel except for legally required communications. Overrides opt-in preferences except for emergency and regulatory notifications.
attributes.references: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA); Internal Customer Privacy Policy

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this contact information is no longer active. Null for currently active contacts. Enables contact history tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this contact information becomes active and valid for use. Supports temporal contact management and future-dated contact changes.

attributes.name: invalid_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact was marked as invalid. Used for data quality reporting and contact refresh prioritization.

attributes.name: invalid_reason
attributes.description: Reason why this contact was marked as invalid. Populated when contact_status is set to invalid. Supports data quality improvement and contact cleansing workflows.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary contact point for the associated customer and contact type. Used to determine default communication channel for critical notifications.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this contact information has been verified as accurate and reachable. Verification may occur through confirmation emails, SMS codes, or postal mail validation.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Human-readable label or nickname for this contact (e.g., 'Home Phone', 'Work Email', 'Billing Address'). Helps users distinguish between multiple contacts of the same type.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for communications sent to this contact. Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code. Supports multilingual customer communications and regulatory compliance for non-English speaking customers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ENG|SPA|FRE|CHI|VIE|KOR|RUS|ARA|POR|GER — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 639-2 Language Codes; Title VI of the Civil Rights Act (Limited English Proficiency Requirements)

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact point was last used for outbound communication. Used to track contact engagement and identify stale contact records.

attributes.name: last_contact_type
attributes.description: Type of the last communication sent to this contact (e.g., bill, service alert, CCR, boil-water notice). Supports communication history analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this contact record. May include special handling instructions, customer preferences, or historical context.

attributes.name: opt_in_billing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating customer consent to receive billing-related communications through this contact channel. Supports compliance with communication preference regulations.
attributes.references: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA); CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: opt_in_emergency
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating customer consent to receive emergency alerts (e.g., boil-water notices, water quality advisories, Sanitary Sewer Overflow (SSO) notifications) through this contact channel. Typically defaults to true for critical public health communications.
attributes.references: Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) Public Notification Requirements; Clean Water Act (CWA)

attributes.name: opt_in_marketing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating customer consent to receive marketing and promotional communications (e.g., conservation programs, new service offerings) through this contact channel.
attributes.references: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA); CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: opt_in_service
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating customer consent to receive service-related communications (e.g., planned outages, maintenance notifications) through this contact channel.
attributes.references: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA); CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer opted out of communications through this contact channel. Null if customer has not opted out. Used for compliance reporting and communication suppression.
attributes.references: Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA); CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: opt_out_reason
attributes.description: Free-text reason provided by customer for opting out of communications. Supports customer experience analysis and communication strategy improvement.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Data quality score for this contact record (0.00 to 100.00). Calculated based on verification status, recency, completeness, and delivery success rate. Used to prioritize contact data cleansing efforts.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this contact in the source system. Enables traceability back to the system of record and supports data reconciliation.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone associated with this contact location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles). Used to schedule communications at appropriate local times and comply with TCPA calling hour restrictions.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was last modified. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The actual contact information value - phone number, email address, mailing address, SMS number, portal username, or fax number. Format varies by contact_channel. This is the primary contact data point.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 4; U.S. Privacy Act

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact information was last verified. Used to track data quality and trigger re-verification workflows for stale contact data.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify this contact information. Tracks how the contact was validated to support audit and data quality reporting.

products.name: communication_preference

products.name: assistance_program
products.description: Reference catalog of customer assistance and affordability programs offered by the utility, including low-income rate assistance (LIRA), payment assistance, leak adjustment programs, senior citizen discounts, medical baseline allowances, and lifeline rates. Captures program code, program name, program type, eligibility criteria description, benefit type (rate discount, bill credit, payment plan, usage allowance), funding source (utility-funded, state-funded, federal LIHEAP), maximum benefit amount, program start and end dates, and administering agency. Distinct from account-level enrollment (captured in assistance_enrollment).

Tracks the full lifecycle of assistance program participation per account. Required for state public utilities commission reporting on affordability program reach and expenditure.

attributes.name: fund_id

products.name: account_note
products.description: Free-text and structured notes attached to a customer account by utility staff or automated systems. attributes.name: account_note_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account note record. Primary key.

attributes.name: secondary_account_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the utility staff member who created the note, or system identifier if the note was auto-generated (e.g., SYSTEM_AUTO, BILLING_ENGINE). Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: source_account_reviewed_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the supervisor or QA team member who reviewed the note. Null if not yet reviewed or review not required.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cip_project. Business justification: Notes documenting project-related customer communications, easement negotiations, temporary service arrangements, or construction impact acknowledgments. Critical for project stakeholder documentation

attributes.name: compliance_violation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_violation. Business justification: Account notes document compliance-related restrictions, violation history, or special handling requirements for accounts with regulatory issues—critical operational context for customer service and bi

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account to which this note is attached. Links to the service account in the billing system.

attributes.name: enforcement_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.enforcement_action. Business justification: Notes capture enforcement action impacts on customer accounts (payment plans, service restrictions, legal holds)—operational documentation requirement for coordinating compliance and customer service

attributes.name: primary_account_customer_complaint_id
attributes.description: Reference to a formal customer complaint record if this note documents or follows up on a complaint. Null if not associated with a complaint.

attributes.name: target_primary_account_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the utility staff member who created the note, or system identifier if the note was auto-generated (e.g., SYSTEM_AUTO, BILLING_ENGINE). Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: primary_account_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to a service order if this note was created in the context of a specific field service activity (e.g., meter installation, leak repair, disconnection). Null if not associated with a service order.

attributes.name: service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_service_agreement. Business justification: Notes may relate to specific service agreements (e.g., special billing arrangements for a particular service). This provides agreement-level note context. Nullable as many notes are account-level.

attributes.name: alert_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this note triggers an alert or pop-up notification when the account is accessed by customer service representatives or field crews. True if alert is active, False otherwise.

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of file attachments (documents, images, recordings) associated with this note. Zero if no attachments. Attachments are stored separately and linked to the note.

attributes.name: auto_generated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note was automatically generated by a system process (e.g., billing engine, workflow automation, IVR system) rather than manually entered by a user. True if auto-generated, False if manually created.

attributes.name: character_count
attributes.description: Total number of characters in the note_text field. Used for reporting and data quality monitoring. Calculated at note creation and update.

attributes.name: collections_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note places or documents a hold on collections activities (e.g., payment arrangement in place, dispute under review, bankruptcy filing). True if collections hold is active, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the note was originally created in the source system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: customer_visible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note is visible to the customer through self-service channels (web portal, mobile app). True if customer can view, False if internal only. Subset of visibility_level logic for simplified customer portal filtering.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the note is no longer relevant or should be archived. Null for notes with indefinite relevance. Used for time-bound alerts (e.g., temporary medical baseline, seasonal access restrictions). Follows format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: hazard_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note contains information about a safety hazard or dangerous condition at the service address (e.g., aggressive dog, unstable structure, hazardous materials). True if hazard is present, False otherwise. Used to alert field crews.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code indicating the language in which the note was written: ENG (English), SPA (Spanish), CHI (Chinese), VIE (Vietnamese), KOR (Korean), TGL (Tagalog), FRE (French). Supports multilingual customer service operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ENG|SPA|CHI|VIE|KOR|TGL|FRE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the note was last updated or edited. Null if the note has never been modified after creation. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note is subject to legal hold for litigation, regulatory investigation, or legal discovery. True if legal hold applies, False otherwise. Prevents deletion or modification of the note.

attributes.name: medical_baseline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note is related to a medical baseline or life-support equipment dependency at the service address. True if medical baseline applies, False otherwise. Triggers special handling for disconnection and outage notifications.
attributes.references: State Public Utilities Commission Medical Baseline Rules

attributes.name: note_author_name
attributes.description: Full name of the utility staff member who created the note, or system name if auto-generated. Provides human-readable identification of the note creator.

attributes.name: note_category
attributes.description: Broad business category for the note: BILLING (payment arrangements, billing disputes), SERVICE_DELIVERY (service quality, outages), SAFETY (hazardous conditions, dangerous animals), REGULATORY (compliance holds, legal restrictions), CUSTOMER_PREFERENCE (communication preferences, special requests), PROPERTY_ACCESS (gate codes, access instructions).

attributes.name: note_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the note: ACTIVE (currently relevant and visible), ARCHIVED (retained for history but not actively displayed), DELETED (soft-deleted, retained for audit), EXPIRED (past expiration date, no longer applicable).

attributes.name: note_text
attributes.description: Free-text content of the note entered by utility staff or generated by automated systems. May contain customer service observations, field crew instructions (e.g., dangerous dog, locked gate), dispute details, or special handling requirements.

attributes.name: note_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the note indicating its business purpose: GENERAL (routine account information), COLLECTIONS (payment or delinquency related), FIELD_SERVICE (field crew instructions or observations), COMPLAINT (customer complaint or dispute), LEGAL_HOLD (legal or regulatory restriction), MEDICAL_BASELINE (medical equipment dependency or special needs).

attributes.name: print_on_bill_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the note should be printed on the customer's bill or included in bill messaging. True if note should appear on bill, False otherwise. Used for important customer communications (e.g., rate change notices, service reminders).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Urgency or importance level assigned to the note: LOW (informational), MEDIUM (standard attention), HIGH (requires prompt action), CRITICAL (immediate action required, safety or legal concern).

products.name: interaction

Captures interaction date and time, channel, interaction type (billing inquiry, service request, complaint, outage report, payment arrangement, general inquiry, staff note, system alert), record subtype (structured interaction vs free-text note), duration, agent ID, note text (for unstructured entries), note visibility level (internal/external), resolution status, case or work order reference, workflow trigger flag, and customer satisfaction score if captured.
