attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; SAP ERP FI Asset Accounting; GASB Statement No. 34

attributes.name: diameter_mm
attributes.description: Nominal diameter of the asset in millimeters. For pipes and valves, this is the internal bore diameter. For pumps, this is the discharge diameter. Used for hydraulic capacity calculations, spare parts specification, and network modeling in Innovyze InfoWater.

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Elevation of the asset above mean sea level in meters. Critical for hydraulic modeling, pressure zone assignment, and gravity-fed system design. Used in Innovyze InfoWater hydraulic models and Esri ArcGIS 3D network analysis.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; Innovyze InfoWater; AWWA Distribution System Standards

attributes.name: expected_useful_life_years
attributes.description: The estimated total useful life of the asset in years as defined by engineering standards, manufacturer specifications, or utility policy. Used for depreciation calculations, Capital Improvement Program (CIP) planning, and asset renewal forecasting. Aligns with GASB Statement No. 34 infrastructure reporting requirements.
attributes.references: GASB Statement No. 34; GAAP; AWWA Asset Management Guidance; ISO 55001

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: Hierarchical functional location code representing the physical or functional position of the asset within the utility's infrastructure (e.g., WTP-PUMP-STATION-01-PUMP-03). Mirrors the SAP PM Functional Location (FLOC) structure and IBM Maximo Location field. Used for structured asset hierarchy navigation and maintenance cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP ERP PM Functional Location; IBM Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001

attributes.name: gis_feature_code
attributes.description: The unique feature identifier for this asset in the Esri ArcGIS geographic information system. Enables spatial queries, network tracing, and hydraulic model integration via Innovyze InfoWater. Used for field crew navigation and infrastructure mapping.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; Innovyze InfoWater; AWWA GIS Standards

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was physically installed and placed into service at its current location. Used as the baseline for age calculations, depreciation schedules, warranty period tracking, and remaining useful life (RUL) estimation. Sourced from IBM Maximo installation date field.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; GAAP; GASB Statement No. 34; ISO 55001

attributes.name: is_lead_service_line
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is a lead service line or contains lead components. Critical for compliance with the EPA Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) which requires utilities to inventory and replace lead service lines. True = confirmed lead service line; False = non-lead or unknown.
attributes.references: EPA Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR); Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA); EPA LCRR Service Line Inventory Requirements

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently completed maintenance activity (preventive or corrective) performed on this asset. Used to calculate maintenance intervals, identify overdue assets, and support compliance reporting for regulatory-mandated maintenance activities.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the asset record in the enterprise asset registry. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with IBM Maximo and SAP PM, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; Data Governance Best Practices; IBM Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the asset location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for GIS mapping, field crew navigation, spatial analysis, and hydraulic network modeling in Innovyze InfoWater. Sourced from Esri ArcGIS asset layer.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; WGS84 Geodetic Datum; Innovyze InfoWater

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the asset location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for GIS mapping, field crew navigation, spatial analysis, and hydraulic network modeling in Innovyze InfoWater. Sourced from Esri ArcGIS asset layer.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; WGS84 Geodetic Datum; Innovyze InfoWater

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy
attributes.description: The primary maintenance approach applied to this asset as defined in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). 'preventive' indicates time-based scheduled maintenance; 'predictive' indicates condition-monitoring-based maintenance; 'condition_based' indicates maintenance triggered by condition thresholds; 'run_to_failure' is applied to non-critical, easily replaceable assets.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was manufactured by the OEM. May differ from installation date for assets stored in inventory before deployment. Used for age-based condition assessment and manufacturer warranty calculations.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the asset (e.g., Xylem, Grundfos, Flowserve, Siemens, ABB). Used for warranty management, spare parts procurement, and vendor performance analysis. Sourced from IBM Maximo manufacturer field.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; SAP ERP MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: maximo_asset_num
attributes.description: The asset number as assigned and maintained in IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS). This is the operational cross-reference key used by maintenance crews and work order management. Must be unique within the Maximo instance.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: model_num
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or product number for the asset (e.g., 'LF 3196 STX', 'NK 65-200'). Used for spare parts identification, technical documentation retrieval, and procurement of replacement units. Sourced from IBM Maximo model field.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled preventive maintenance activity is due for this asset. Derived from the PM schedule and last maintenance date. Used for maintenance planning, resource scheduling, and compliance tracking in IBM Maximo.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the asset. 'in_service' indicates the asset is active and performing its intended function. 'standby' indicates the asset is available but not currently operating. 'out_of_service' indicates the asset is temporarily removed from service for maintenance or repair. 'decommissioned' indicates permanent retirement. Drives maintenance scheduling and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: pipe_material
attributes.description: Material composition of the asset (e.g., Ductile Iron, PVC, HDPE, Cast Iron, Concrete, Stainless Steel, Copper). Critical for corrosion risk assessment, Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) compliance, Cured-in-Place Pipe (CIPP) rehabilitation planning, and remaining useful life estimation. Applicable primarily to pipe and fitting assets.
attributes.references: EPA Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR); AWWA Standards; Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA)

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preventive maintenance schedule record in IBM Maximo that governs recurring maintenance activities for this asset. Links the asset to its O&M (Operations and Maintenance) task plans, frequencies, and resource requirements.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: power_rating_kw
attributes.description: Nameplate power rating of the asset in kilowatts (kW). Applicable to pumps, blowers, motors, generators, and other electrical equipment. Used for energy consumption analysis, Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) sizing, electrical load planning, and OPEX budgeting.
attributes.references: AWWA Energy Management Guidance; IBM Maximo Asset Management; OSHA Electrical Standards

attributes.name: pressure_zone
attributes.description: The hydraulic pressure zone or District Metered Area (DMA) in which the asset is located. Used for pressure management, Non-Revenue Water (NRW) analysis, and distribution network operations. Aligns with Innovyze InfoWater zone definitions and GIS pressure zone polygons.
attributes.references: Innovyze InfoWater; AWWA Distribution System Standards; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: rated_capacity
attributes.description: The manufacturer-rated operational capacity of the asset expressed in the appropriate unit of measure (see capacity_unit field). For pumps: Gallons per Minute (GPM); for treatment units: Million Gallons per Day (MGD); for tanks: gallons. Used for capacity planning, hydraulic modeling, and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: AWWA Standards; Innovyze InfoWater; IBM Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_code
attributes.description: Asset identifier assigned by a regulatory authority (e.g., state drinking water program, EPA) for compliance tracking and reporting purposes. Used in regulatory submissions such as the Consumer Confidence Report (CCR), Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR), and NPDES permit compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA); NPDES Permit Program; State Drinking Water Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: replacement_cost
attributes.description: Current estimated cost to replace the asset with a new equivalent unit in US dollars. Updated periodically based on market pricing and engineering estimates. Used for Capital Improvement Program (CIP) budgeting, insurance valuation, and risk-based asset management decision-making.
attributes.references: AWWA Asset Management Guidance; ISO 55001; GASB Statement No. 34

attributes.name: sap_equipment_num
attributes.description: The equipment number assigned in SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) module. Used for integration with SAP FI/CO for depreciation, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, and maintenance cost postings. Enables bidirectional synchronization between SAP PM and the asset registry.
attributes.references: SAP ERP PM Module; GAAP; GASB Statement No. 34

attributes.name: scada_tag
attributes.description: The Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) tag name used to identify this asset's data point(s) in the OSIsoft PI Historian system. Enables linkage between the physical asset registry and real-time operational data streams for performance monitoring, alarm management, and predictive maintenance analytics.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; SCADA System Integration Standards; IBM Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: serial_num
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific asset unit. Used for warranty claims, recall tracking, and precise asset identification when multiple identical units exist. Sourced from IBM Maximo serial number field.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; SAP ERP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer's warranty for the asset expires. Used to trigger warranty claim processes before expiry and to transition maintenance responsibility from warranty to O&M budget. Sourced from IBM Maximo warranty end date.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; SAP ERP PM Warranty Management

products.name: asset_class
products.description: Reference taxonomy defining the classification hierarchy for utility assets (e.g., Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Instrumentation, Vehicle). Each class carries default useful life, depreciation method, maintenance strategy, criticality weighting rules, and applicable regulatory standards. Used to drive preventive maintenance scheduling, CAPEX planning, and ISO 55001 asset management framework alignment.
products.reference: ISO 55001 Asset Classification / AWWA Asset Management Framework

attributes.name: asset_class_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the asset class record in the enterprise asset management system. Primary key for the asset_class reference taxonomy. [ROLE: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — this entity is a reference taxonomy/classification table defining the hierarchy of utility asset types; per-role minimums are exempt, but MASTER_RESOURCE categories are applied for completeness given the entity carries rich business metadata beyond a simple code list.]
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Asset class definition authorship for configuration management, subject matter expert identification, and asset hierarchy governance.

attributes.name: ami_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this class are part of the AMI/AMR metering infrastructure managed via the Sensus FlexNet AMI Platform. True for smart meters and communication endpoints; False for all other asset classes.
attributes.references: Sensus FlexNet AMI Platform; AWWA M6 Water Meters

attributes.name: asset_domain
attributes.description: Operational domain to which this asset class primarily belongs within the utility (e.g., Water Treatment, Water Distribution, Wastewater Collection, Wastewater Treatment, Metering, Fleet, Facilities, Cross-Domain). Drives domain-specific maintenance strategies and regulatory reporting alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Water Treatment|Water Distribution|Wastewater Collection|Wastewater Treatment|Metering|Fleet|Facilities|Cross-Domain — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AWWA Asset Management Guidance; EPA SDWA; EPA CWA

attributes.name: capex_threshold_usd
attributes.description: Minimum acquisition or renewal cost in USD above which expenditures on assets of this class are capitalized as CAPEX rather than expensed as OPEX. Aligned with GAAP/GASB capitalization policies and SAP FI/CO asset accounting rules.
attributes.references: GAAP; GASB 34; SAP FI/CO Asset Accounting

attributes.name: cip_program_category
attributes.description: CIP program category under which capital renewal projects for assets of this class are budgeted and tracked. Aligns with the utility's multi-year CIP planning structure in SAP PS and financial reporting to the Public Utilities Commission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Water Supply|Water Treatment|Water Distribution|Wastewater Collection|Wastewater Treatment|Metering|Facilities|Fleet|Cross-Program — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP PS; GASB 34; Public Utilities Commission; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the asset class within the enterprise taxonomy (e.g., MECH-PUMP, ELEC-TRANS, CIVIL-PIPE). Used as the externally-known business identifier in IBM Maximo, SAP PM, and GIS integrations.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); SAP PM; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: class_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the asset class, including its functional role within water or wastewater operations, typical installation context, and distinguishing characteristics from adjacent classes.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: class_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the asset class (e.g., 'Centrifugal Pump', 'Distribution Main Pipe', 'UV Disinfection Unit'). Used in reports, work orders, and CAPEX planning documents.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: class_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset class record within the reference taxonomy. 'Active' classes are available for new asset registrations; 'Deprecated' classes are retained for historical assets but cannot be assigned to new assets.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: condition_assessment_method
attributes.description: Default method used to assess the physical condition of assets in this class. CIPP and pipe assets typically use CCTV; rotating equipment uses vibration analysis; distribution mains may use acoustic leak detection. Drives field inspection work order types in Maximo. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Visual Inspection|CCTV|Acoustic Leak Detection|Vibration Analysis|Ultrasonic Testing|Hydraulic Testing|SCADA Monitoring|Not Applicable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); AWWA Asset Management Guidance; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: consequence_of_failure
attributes.description: Primary category of consequence if assets of this class fail. Drives risk-based maintenance prioritization and emergency response planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Service Interruption|Public Health Risk|Environmental Non-Compliance|Safety Hazard|Financial Loss|Reputational — promote to reference product]
attributes.value_regex: Service Interruption|Public Health Risk|Environmental Non-Compliance|Safety Hazard|Financial Loss|Reputational
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; EPA SDWA; EPA CWA; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset class record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS)

attributes.name: criticality_tier
attributes.description: Default criticality tier classification for assets of this class based on consequence of failure analysis. Critical assets (e.g., primary WTP pumps, transmission mains) receive highest maintenance priority and fastest response SLAs.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA Asset Management Guidance; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: criticality_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weighting factor (typically 0.00–10.00) applied to assets of this class during criticality assessment scoring. Higher values indicate greater consequence of failure on service delivery, public health, or regulatory compliance. Used in risk-based asset prioritization per ISO 55001.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Default accounting depreciation method applied to assets of this class for financial reporting purposes. Straight-Line is most common for utility infrastructure. Aligned with GAAP/GASB requirements for municipal utility financial statements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Straight-Line|Declining Balance|Units of Production|Sum-of-Years-Digits|Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery — promote to reference product]
attributes.value_regex: Straight-Line|Declining Balance|Units of Production|Sum-of-Years-Digits|Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery
attributes.references: GAAP; GASB 34; SAP FI/CO Asset Accounting

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this asset class definition became effective and available for use in asset registrations. Supports temporal validity tracking of the reference taxonomy.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: environmental_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure of assets in this class poses a direct environmental risk requiring regulatory notification (e.g., SSO, CSO, chemical spill, NPDES permit exceedance). True triggers mandatory environmental incident reporting workflows.
attributes.references: EPA CWA; NPDES; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: gis_feature_class
attributes.description: Corresponding feature class name in Esri ArcGIS geodatabase for assets of this class (e.g., 'wDistributionMain', 'wValve', 'wPump'). Enables spatial analysis, network modeling in Innovyze InfoWater, and GIS-CMMS integration for field crew dispatch.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; Innovyze InfoWater; AWWA GIS Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Default General Ledger account code in SAP FI/CO to which asset acquisitions, depreciation, and disposals for this class are posted. Ensures consistent financial reporting and CAPEX/OPEX tracking across the utility.
attributes.references: GAAP; GASB 34; SAP FI/CO Asset Accounting

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this class within the classification hierarchy (1 = top-level category, 2 = sub-category, 3 = class, 4 = sub-class). Drives roll-up aggregation logic in CAPEX planning and maintenance reporting.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: Default interval in calendar days between mandatory regulatory or condition inspections for assets of this class. Distinct from PM frequency — this is driven by regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., EPA, state primacy agency mandates) rather than maintenance strategy.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; State Drinking Water Programs; NPDES; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: iso_55001_aligned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the maintenance strategy, criticality assessment, and lifecycle management approach for this asset class have been formally aligned with ISO 55001 Asset Management System requirements. Used for ISO certification audit evidence.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset class record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with source systems (Maximo, SAP), and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS)

attributes.name: lcrr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this class are subject to EPA Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) compliance requirements, such as lead service line inventory and replacement tracking. Applicable to service lines, connectors, and plumbing components.
attributes.references: EPA LCRR; EPA SDWA; State Drinking Water Programs

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy
attributes.description: Default O&M maintenance strategy applied to assets of this class in IBM Maximo CMMS. Drives automatic PM schedule generation. Preventive and Condition-Based strategies are typical for critical water infrastructure; Run-to-Failure may apply to low-criticality ancillary assets.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA Asset Management Guidance

attributes.name: material_standard
attributes.description: Default material specification or construction standard applicable to assets of this class (e.g., 'AWWA C900 PVC', 'AWWA C200 Steel', 'ASTM A536 Ductile Iron', 'HDPE ASTM D3035'). Used in procurement specifications and asset registry for infrastructure renewal planning.

attributes.name: maximo_class_code
attributes.description: Corresponding asset class identifier in IBM Maximo Asset Management CMMS. Used for bidirectional synchronization between the Silver Layer lakehouse and Maximo for work order generation, PM scheduling, and asset lifecycle management.

attributes.name: mean_time_between_failures_days
attributes.description: Industry benchmark mean time between failures in days for assets of this class, used as a baseline for reliability-centered maintenance planning and failure probability modeling. Sourced from AWWA reliability benchmarks and historical Maximo work order data.
attributes.references: AWWA Asset Management Guidance; ISO 55001 Asset Management; IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS)

attributes.name: mean_time_to_repair_hours
attributes.description: Industry benchmark mean time to repair in hours for assets of this class, used for SLA setting, crew resource planning, and service restoration time estimation. Sourced from AWWA benchmarks and historical Maximo corrective work order durations.
attributes.references: AWWA Asset Management Guidance; ISO 55001 Asset Management; IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS)

attributes.name: number_sap
attributes.description: Corresponding asset class number in SAP FI/CO Asset Accounting module (transaction AS02/AS03). Enables direct cross-reference between the enterprise data lakehouse and the SAP ERP system of record for financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Asset Accounting; GAAP; GASB 34

attributes.name: pm_frequency_days
attributes.description: Default interval in calendar days between scheduled preventive maintenance activities for assets of this class. Used by IBM Maximo PM scheduling engine to auto-generate work orders. Overridable at the individual asset level.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); AWWA O&M Standards

attributes.name: primary_category
attributes.description: Top-level classification grouping for the asset class aligned with standard utility asset taxonomy: Mechanical (pumps, blowers, mixers), Electrical (transformers, switchgear), Civil (pipes, structures, tanks), Instrumentation (sensors, meters, SCADA RTUs), Vehicle (fleet), Information Technology, or Other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Mechanical|Electrical|Civil|Instrumentation|Vehicle|Information Technology|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AWWA Asset Management Guidance; ISO 55001 Asset Management; SAP PM

attributes.name: regulatory_standard_ref
attributes.description: Primary regulatory standard or code applicable to assets of this class (e.g., 'SDWA Section 1412', 'NPDES Permit', 'AWWA C900', 'ASME B31.3'). Drives compliance inspection scheduling and regulatory reporting requirements in DMR/MOR submissions.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; EPA CWA; NPDES; AWWA Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: renewal_strategy
attributes.description: Default end-of-life renewal strategy for assets of this class used in CIP planning. CIPP (Cured-in-Place Pipe) and trenchless methods are common for buried pipe rehabilitation; rotating equipment typically follows Replace-in-Kind or Upgrade strategies.
attributes.references: AWWA Asset Management Guidance; ISO 55001 Asset Management; CIP Planning

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which this asset class was retired or deprecated from the active taxonomy. Null for currently active classes. Retained for historical asset records that were registered under this class prior to retirement.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: safety_classification
attributes.description: Primary safety hazard classification for work activities on assets of this class. Drives OSHA-compliant safety permit requirements (e.g., confined space entry permits, lockout/tagout procedures) when generating work orders in Maximo.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; OSHA 29 CFR 1926; IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS)

attributes.name: salvage_value_pct
attributes.description: Default residual/salvage value expressed as a percentage of original acquisition cost at end of useful life for assets in this class. Used in depreciation calculations and asset disposal planning within SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: GAAP; GASB 34; SAP FI/CO Asset Accounting

attributes.name: scada_monitored
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this class are typically monitored via SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems integrated with OSIsoft PI Historian. True for pumps, valves, flow meters, and treatment equipment; False for passive civil assets such as buried pipes.

attributes.name: size_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure used to express the principal sizing attribute for assets of this class (e.g., 'inches' for pipe diameter, 'HP' for pump motor horsepower, 'kVA' for transformer capacity, 'GPM' for flow capacity). attributes.references: AWWA Standards; IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS)

attributes.name: spare_parts_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this class typically require dedicated spare parts inventory to be maintained in the storeroom (SAP MM / Maximo Inventory). True for critical rotating equipment and instrumentation; False for passive civil assets.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); SAP MM; AWWA O&M Standards

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Default expected useful life in years for assets belonging to this class, used as the baseline for depreciation schedules, CAPEX renewal planning, and CIP prioritization. Can be overridden at the individual asset level.
attributes.references: GASB 34 Infrastructure Reporting; AWWA Asset Management Guidance; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: work_order_type_default
attributes.description: Default work order type generated in IBM Maximo for assets of this class when a maintenance event is triggered. Drives labor planning, cost coding, and CAPEX vs OPEX classification of maintenance expenditures.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); SAP PM; AWWA O&M Standards

products.name: location

products.name: asset_meter
products.description: Tracks operational meters, counters, and their reading history for asset condition and usage monitoring — distinct from customer billing meters (owned by the metering domain). Examples include pump run-hours, motor starts, valve cycle counts, flow totalizers (MGD), pressure transducers (PSI), and vibration sensors. Captures meter type, unit of measure, current reading, rollover value, calibration status, and historical reading records (reading date/time, value, source — manual or SCADA/PI Historian automated, inspector ID, delta from previous reading). Feeds meter-based PM triggers, tracks asset utilization trends, and supports predictive maintenance analytics. Integrates with OSIsoft PI Historian.
