attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Type of laboratory certification held by the analyst. Categories include state drinking water analyst certification, wastewater operator certification, NELAC (National Environmental Laboratory Accreditation Conference) signatory authority, laboratory director certification, quality assurance officer certification, or specialty method certification.
attributes.references: NELAC Institute Standards, EPA Laboratory Certification Program, State Drinking Water Program Requirements

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization or agency that issued the certification. Examples include state environmental agencies, EPA regional offices, NELAC accreditation bodies, or professional associations such as AWWA or WEF.
attributes.references: EPA Laboratory Certification Program, State Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: continuing_education_hours
attributes.description: Total number of continuing education hours or professional development units earned by the analyst in the current certification period. Required for certification renewal.
attributes.references: State Certification Programs, Professional Development Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certified analyst record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 17025 Records Management Requirements, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the analyst. Used for official communications, training notifications, and certification renewal reminders.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Emergency contact phone number for the analyst. Used for urgent notifications related to laboratory incidents, sample integrity issues, or regulatory inquiries.
attributes.references: OSHA Emergency Response Requirements, GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification expires and must be renewed. Critical for compliance tracking to ensure only currently certified analysts perform regulated analytical work.
attributes.references: NELAC Institute Standards, State Certification Programs, EPA Laboratory Certification Requirements

attributes.name: instrument_qualifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of laboratory instruments the analyst is trained and qualified to operate. Examples include ICP-MS (Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry), GC-MS (Gas Chromatography Mass Spectrometry), IC (Ion Chromatography), UV-Vis spectrophotometer, TOC (Total Organic Carbon) analyzer, etc.
attributes.references: NELAC Institute Standards, Instrument Manufacturer Training Requirements

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this certified analyst record is currently active. Inactive records represent analysts who have left the organization or whose certifications are no longer maintained.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was originally issued to the analyst. Used to calculate tenure and experience with the certification.
attributes.references: NELAC Institute Standards, State Certification Programs

attributes.name: laboratory_assignment
attributes.description: Name or code of the laboratory facility or work center where the analyst is primarily assigned. Examples include Central Laboratory, WTP (Water Treatment Plant) Lab, WWTP (Wastewater Treatment Plant) Lab, or Field Testing Unit.
attributes.references: SAP PM Work Center Master, Facility Management Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certified analyst record was most recently updated. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 17025 Records Management Requirements, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: last_proficiency_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent proficiency testing event completed by the analyst. Used to track compliance with annual or semi-annual PT requirements.
attributes.references: NELAC Institute Standards, EPA Quality Assurance Requirements

attributes.name: lims_user_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) User ID
attributes.description: User identifier for the analyst in the Laboratory Information Management System (LabWare or similar). Links the certification record to the analysts login and activity in the LIMS for audit trail and data integrity purposes.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS, 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records Requirements

tag_set.value: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) User ID

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the analysts certification or qualifications. May include restrictions, accommodations, or historical context.

attributes.name: proficiency_testing_status
attributes.description: Status of the analysts participation in proficiency testing programs. Proficiency testing is required for NELAC accreditation and demonstrates the analysts ability to produce accurate results. Current status indicates successful completion of required PT samples.
attributes.references: NELAC Institute Standards, EPA Laboratory Quality Assurance Requirements

attributes.name: quality_control_role
attributes.description: Role of the analyst in the laboratorys quality assurance and quality control program. Roles include bench analyst, data reviewer, QA officer, or technical director with oversight responsibilities.
attributes.references: NELAC Institute Standards, ISO 17025 Quality Management Requirements

attributes.name: record_source
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this certified analyst record originated. Examples include LIMS (LabWare), SAP HR, or manual certification tracking system.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework, Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was most recently renewed. Tracks the analysts compliance with continuing education and renewal requirements.
attributes.references: State Certification Programs, Professional Development Requirements

attributes.name: safety_training_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent laboratory safety training completion. Required annually for OSHA compliance and includes topics such as chemical hygiene, hazardous waste handling, and emergency response.
attributes.references: OSHA Laboratory Standard 29 CFR 1910.1450, Chemical Hygiene Plan Requirements

attributes.name: shift_assignment
attributes.description: Work shift to which the analyst is assigned. Relevant for 24/7 laboratory operations and emergency response coverage.

attributes.name: signatory_authority
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the analyst has signatory authority to approve and sign laboratory reports for regulatory submission. Signatory authority is typically restricted to senior analysts or laboratory directors who meet specific qualification criteria.
attributes.references: NELAC Institute Standards, EPA Laboratory Certification Requirements

attributes.name: specialty_areas
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of analytical specialty areas or matrices the analyst is qualified to work with. Examples include drinking water microbiology, wastewater metals, organic compounds, radiochemistry, or specific contaminant groups such as PFAS (Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances) or DBPs (Disinfection Byproducts).
attributes.references: NELAC Fields of Accreditation, EPA Method Categories

products.name: lab_accreditation
products.description: Master record for the laboratorys accreditation and certification status with regulatory and accrediting bodies. Captures accrediting organization (state primacy agency, NELAC/TNI, A2LA, DoD ELAP), accreditation scope (list of accredited analytes and matrices), certificate number, accreditation status, initial accreditation date, current certificate expiry, last on-site assessment date, next assessment due date, and any conditions or deficiencies noted. Critical for demonstrating regulatory defensibility of analytical data.
products.reference: Laboratory Accreditation Certificate (NELAC TNI / A2LA / State Primacy)

attributes.name: lab_accreditation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the laboratory accreditation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.laboratory. Business justification: Each accreditation record belongs to a specific laboratory; adding laboratory_id FK enables direct navigation and eliminates need to infer via other tables. No existing FK from laboratory to lab_accre

attributes.name: accreditation_certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate number issued by the accrediting body for this accreditation.

attributes.name: accreditation_cost_usd
attributes.description: The total cost in US dollars for obtaining and maintaining this accreditation, including application fees, assessment fees, and proficiency testing costs.

attributes.name: accreditation_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the accreditation certificate and scope document.

attributes.name: accreditation_scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the accreditation scope, including the list of accredited analytes, matrices, and test methods covered under this accreditation.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the accreditation (active, suspended, revoked, expired, pending, provisional).

attributes.name: accreditation_type
attributes.description: The type or program of accreditation granted (e.g., state primacy, NELAC/TNI, A2LA, DoD ELAP, ISO 17025).
attributes.references: NELAC/TNI Standard, ISO/IEC 17025, A2LA, DoD ELAP

attributes.name: conditions_or_deficiencies_noted
attributes.description: Any conditions, limitations, or deficiencies noted by the accrediting body during the last assessment. May include corrective action requirements.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which corrective actions must be completed and submitted to the accrediting body.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required to maintain or restore accreditation status.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accreditation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: initial_accreditation_date
attributes.description: The date when the laboratory first received this accreditation from the accrediting body.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accreditation record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next on-site or surveillance assessment by the accrediting body.

products.name: proficiency_test
products.description: Record of each proficiency testing (PT) study participation event required to maintain laboratory accreditation. Captures the PT provider (ERA, NERL, LGC), study name and round, analyte(s) tested, sample matrix, assigned value (true concentration), reported value, z-score or performance score, pass/fail determination, and submission deadline. Tracks the laboratorys ongoing demonstration of analytical competency as required by NELAC/TNI and state primacy agencies.
products.reference: Proficiency Testing Study (NELAC TNI Standard Section 5 / EPA PT Requirements)

attributes.name: proficiency_test_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the proficiency testing study participation event.

attributes.name: analyte_id
attributes.description: Reference to the analyte or parameter tested (e.g., lead, pH, total coliform).

attributes.name: certified_analyst_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified analyst who performed the proficiency test analysis.

attributes.name: compliance_corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corrective action record initiated in response to proficiency test failure.

attributes.name: lab_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory instrument used for the proficiency test analysis.

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory that participated in this proficiency test.

attributes.name: primary_proficiency_lab_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique sample identifier assigned by the proficiency test provider.

attributes.name: primary_proficiency_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality assurance officer or supervisor who reviewed the proficiency test results.

attributes.name: secondary_proficiency_reviewed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality assurance officer or supervisor who reviewed the proficiency test results.

attributes.name: pt_provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the proficiency testing provider organization (ERA, NERL, LGC, etc.).

attributes.name: test_method_id
attributes.description: Reference to the analytical test method used for this proficiency test.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the proficiency testing provider organization (ERA, NERL, LGC, etc.).

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Acceptance limits or criteria defined by the proficiency test provider (e.g., z-score ±2.0, recovery 80-120%).

attributes.name: accreditation_field
attributes.description: Field of accreditation or testing category this proficiency test supports (e.g., Drinking Water Chemistry, Microbiology).

attributes.name: accreditation_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the impact of this proficiency test result on laboratory accreditation status.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: Date the proficiency test sample was analyzed by the laboratory.

attributes.name: assigned_value
attributes.description: True or reference concentration value assigned by the proficiency test provider.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional comments or notes regarding the proficiency test participation, analysis, or results.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required due to proficiency test failure or unacceptable performance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this proficiency test record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this proficiency test record was last modified.

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.description: Number of laboratories that participated in this proficiency test round.

attributes.name: peer_group_mean
attributes.description: Mean value reported by all participating laboratories in the peer group.

attributes.name: peer_group_standard_deviation
attributes.description: Standard deviation of values reported by all participating laboratories in the peer group.

attributes.name: percentile_rank
attributes.description: Percentile ranking of the laboratorys performance relative to all participants (0-100).

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Alternative performance metric used by some proficiency test providers (e.g., percent recovery, bias).

attributes.name: pt_round
attributes.description: Round or cycle identifier for the proficiency test (e.g., 2024-Q1, Round 45).

attributes.name: pt_study_name
attributes.description: Name of the proficiency testing study or program (e.g., WP-123, DMR-QA).

attributes.name: report_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the laboratory received the final proficiency test report from the provider.

attributes.name: reported_value
attributes.description: Concentration value reported by the laboratory for the proficiency test sample.

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Pass/fail determination or acceptability status of the proficiency test result.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date the proficiency test results were reviewed and approved by quality assurance.

attributes.name: sample_matrix
attributes.description: Type of sample matrix tested in the proficiency test. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drinking_water|wastewater|surface_water|groundwater|soil|sediment|sludge|biosolids|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sample_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the proficiency test sample was received by the laboratory.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Actual date the laboratory submitted results to the proficiency test provider.

attributes.name: submission_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline date by which the laboratory must submit results to the proficiency test provider.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the assigned and reported values (e.g., mg/L, ug/L, NTU, pH units).

attributes.name: z_score
attributes.description: Statistical z-score calculated from the reported value, assigned value, and standard deviation, indicating performance relative to peer laboratories.

products.name: result_validation
products.description: Record of the formal data validation review applied to a set of test results before release. Captures the validation level (level I through IV per EPA validation protocols), validator identity, validation datetime, validation criteria applied, findings (qualifiers applied, results rejected, flags raised), and final validation disposition (accepted, qualified, rejected). Ensures that all data released for regulatory reporting meets defensibility standards under SDWA, CWA, and NPDES requirements.
products.reference: Data Validation Report (EPA Functional Guidelines for Data Validation / NELAC TNI)

attributes.name: result_validation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the result validation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: analytical_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.analytical_result. Business justification: Laboratory's result_validation process validates quality domain's analytical_result records. Data validation workflow (Level II/III review) requires linking validation findings to final reported resul

attributes.name: primary_primary_result_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified analyst or data validator who performed the validation review. Must be a qualified individual per laboratory QA/QC protocols.
attributes.references: LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) Data Model

attributes.name: secondary_result_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified analyst or data validator who performed the validation review. Must be a qualified individual per laboratory QA/QC protocols.
attributes.references: LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) Data Model

attributes.name: source_reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to a secondary reviewer or quality assurance officer who performed independent review of the validation. Used in laboratories with multi-tier validation protocols.

attributes.name: reviewer_id
attributes.description: Reference to a secondary reviewer or quality assurance officer who performed independent review of the validation. Used in laboratories with multi-tier validation protocols.

attributes.name: test_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the test result record being validated. Links to the laboratory test result that underwent this validation review.
attributes.references: LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) Data Model

attributes.name: validation_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the validation batch if multiple results were validated together. Enables grouping of validation activities performed in a single review session.
attributes.references: LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) Data Model

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this validation requires formal approval by a laboratory director or quality assurance manager before data release. True if approval is required, False if validator authority is sufficient.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validation was formally approved for data release. Applicable when approval_required_flag is True.

attributes.name: calibration_verification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether instrument calibration was current and verified at the time of analysis. True if calibration was valid, False if calibration issues were identified.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chain of custody documentation was complete and verified during validation. True if COC is intact and verified, False if discrepancies were found.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Chain of Custody Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this validation record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: data_release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validated result was released for regulatory reporting, customer delivery, or internal use. Marks the completion of the validation and approval workflow.
attributes.references: LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) Workflow Standards

attributes.name: flags_raised_count
attributes.description: Number of quality flags or warnings raised during validation. Flags may indicate potential issues that do not necessarily result in rejection but require documentation.

attributes.name: holding_time_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sample holding time requirements were met per EPA method specifications. True if compliant, False if holding time was exceeded.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Method Holding Time Requirements

attributes.name: method_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the analytical method was performed in full compliance with the approved EPA or Standard Method protocol. True if compliant, False if deviations occurred.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Approved Methods

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this validation record. Audit trail field for tracking changes and maintaining data integrity.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this validation record was last modified. Audit trail field for tracking changes to validation decisions or documentation.

attributes.name: qc_acceptance_criteria_met_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Control (QC) Acceptance Criteria Met Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all quality control acceptance criteria (blanks, duplicates, spikes, surrogates, calibration verification) were met for this result. True if all QC passed, False if any QC failure occurred.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Laboratory QA/QC Standards

tag_set.value: Quality Control (QC) Acceptance Criteria Met Flag

attributes.name: qualifiers_applied
attributes.description: Data qualifiers or flags assigned to the result during validation. Common qualifiers include J (estimated value), U (non-detect), R (rejected), Q (quality control issue). Multiple qualifiers may be comma-separated.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Contract Laboratory Program (CLP) Data Qualifier Definitions

attributes.name: regulatory_defensibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the validated result meets the full defensibility standard required for regulatory reporting and potential legal proceedings. True if defensible, False if data quality issues compromise defensibility.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Data Quality Objectives (DQO) Process

attributes.name: regulatory_program
attributes.description: The regulatory program or compliance framework under which this validation was performed. Examples: SDWA compliance monitoring, NPDES permit monitoring, CWA industrial pretreatment, state-specific programs.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Regulatory Programs

attributes.name: results_rejected_count
attributes.description: Number of individual test results rejected during this validation review. Used for quality metrics and laboratory performance tracking.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the secondary review was completed. Applicable when laboratory protocols require independent QA review of validation decisions.

attributes.name: validation_criteria_applied
attributes.description: Description of the specific validation criteria, checklists, or protocols applied during the review. May reference EPA method requirements, laboratory SOP numbers, or regulatory program-specific validation rules.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Data Validation Guidelines

attributes.name: validation_disposition
attributes.description: Final outcome of the validation review. Accepted: result meets all quality criteria and is released without qualification. Qualified: result is usable but carries data qualifiers or flags. Rejected: result fails validation and cannot be used for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Data Validation Guidelines

attributes.name: validation_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes spent performing the validation review. Used for laboratory productivity metrics and resource planning.

attributes.name: validation_findings
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of validation findings, issues identified, corrective actions taken, and rationale for the final disposition. Critical for regulatory audit trail and data defensibility.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Data Validation Guidelines

attributes.name: validation_level
attributes.description: The EPA validation protocol level applied to this result. Level I: basic data verification; Level II: analytical QC review; Level III: method and holding time compliance; Level IV: full data package audit for regulatory defensibility.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Data Validation Guidelines

attributes.name: validation_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations recorded by the validator during the review process. May include references to supporting documentation, communications with analysts, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the validation process. Tracks whether the validation review is pending, in progress, completed, or on hold pending additional information.
attributes.references: LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) Workflow Standards

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validation review was completed. Critical for establishing data release timeline and regulatory reporting deadlines.

attributes.name: validator_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification or license number of the validator. Required for regulatory defensibility under SDWA and CWA compliance programs.
attributes.references: State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: validator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the validator who performed the review. Provides human-readable identification for audit trail and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Laboratory QA/QC Standards

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this validation record. Audit trail field for accountability and data governance.

products.name: reagent_standard
products.description: Master inventory record for laboratory reagents, chemical standards, and reference materials used in analytical testing. Captures reagent name, CAS number, supplier, lot number, concentration or purity, preparation date, expiry date, storage conditions, current stock quantity, reorder threshold, and associated test methods. Tracks the traceability of standards used in calibration and QC to ensure analytical data defensibility. Distinct from the supply domain which manages procurement; this entity owns the in-lab inventory and traceability record.
products.reference: Laboratory Reagent / Standard Inventory (LabWare Reagent Management)

attributes.name: reagent_standard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the laboratory reagent or chemical standard record. Primary key for the reagent standard master inventory.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General requirements for the competence of testing and calibration laboratories

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Reagent and standard purchases must be expensed to specific GL accounts (lab supplies, chemicals) for inventory management, monthly expense recognition, and financial reporting. Required for GASB-comp

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: QC/QA protocols require documented employee accountability for reagent preparation. Accreditation standards (TNI, NELAC) mandate traceable preparation records linking to qualified employees for method

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: Reagents and certified reference materials are procured from chemical suppliers. Tracking vendor is essential for COA verification, lot traceability, reordering, and quality control. Replaces denormal

attributes.name: associated_test_methods
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of analytical test method codes or names for which this reagent or standard is used. Supports traceability of reagents to specific analytical procedures and regulatory compliance demonstrations.
attributes.references: AWWA Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater, EPA analytical methods, ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance described in the open scientific literature. Used for unambiguous identification of reagents and standards.
attributes.references: CAS Registry, EPA Substance Registry Services (SRS)

attributes.name: catalog_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier catalog number for the reagent or standard. Used for reordering and traceability to supplier specifications.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate of analysis or certificate of conformance number provided by the manufacturer or certifying body. Documents the certified properties and traceability of the standard.
attributes.references: ISO Guide 31, ISO/IEC 17025, EPA QA/QC documentation requirements

attributes.name: certified_reference_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this standard is a certified reference material with traceability to national or international measurement standards. True if CRM, false otherwise. CRMs are required for certain regulatory compliance testing.
attributes.references: ISO Guide 30 - Reference materials, ISO Guide 31 - Contents of certificates of reference materials, EPA QA/QC requirements

attributes.name: concentration_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the concentration or purity value: milligrams per liter (mg/L), micrograms per liter (ug/L), percent (%), parts per million (ppm), parts per billion (ppb), molarity (M), or normality (N). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mg_l|ug_l|percent|ppm|ppb|molarity|normality — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AWWA Standard Methods, ISO 80000 - Quantities and units

attributes.name: concentration_value
attributes.description: Numeric concentration or purity of the reagent or standard as certified by the manufacturer or as prepared in the laboratory. Used in calibration calculations and quality control verification.
attributes.references: ISO Guide 34 - General requirements for the competence of reference material producers, AWWA Standard Methods

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reagent standard record was first created in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: current_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Current quantity of the reagent or standard available in laboratory inventory. Updated as material is consumed or replenished.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025, laboratory inventory management best practices

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Approved method for disposing of expired or unused reagent or standard, such as chemical waste collection, neutralization, incineration, or return to supplier. Ensures compliance with environmental and safety regulations.
attributes.references: EPA Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA), OSHA laboratory safety standards, state and local hazardous waste regulations

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the reagent or standard should no longer be used for analytical testing due to potential degradation or loss of certified properties. Determined by manufacturer specifications or laboratory stability studies.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025, AWWA laboratory best practices, EPA QA/QC requirements

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: Safety hazard classification of the reagent according to Globally Harmonized System (GHS) or OSHA Hazard Communication Standard. Examples include flammable, corrosive, toxic, oxidizer, or non-hazardous.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (29 CFR 1910.1200), GHS (Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals)

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this standard was last used for instrument calibration or quality control verification. Supports traceability and audit trail for analytical data defensibility.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025, EPA QA/QC protocols, AWWA laboratory standards

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned lot or batch number for the reagent or standard. Essential for traceability in the event of quality issues or recalls and for demonstrating chain of custody in regulatory audits.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025, EPA QA/QC requirements, AWWA laboratory standards

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this reagent standard record in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Supports accountability and audit compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reagent standard record was last modified in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, observations, or special handling instructions related to the reagent or standard. May include stability observations, usage restrictions, or audit findings.

attributes.name: preparation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reagent or standard was prepared or diluted in the laboratory. For commercially prepared standards, this is the manufacture date. Critical for determining shelf life and expiry.

attributes.name: reagent_name
attributes.description: Full chemical or commercial name of the reagent, standard, or reference material as provided by the manufacturer or as catalogued in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025, AWWA Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater

attributes.name: reagent_standard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reagent or standard: active (in use), expired (past expiry date), depleted (stock exhausted), quarantined (under investigation or hold), or disposed (removed from inventory).

attributes.name: reagent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the chemical material by its intended laboratory use: reagent for general analytical work, standard for calibration, reference material for quality control, buffer for pH adjustment, indicator for endpoint detection, or solvent for dilution and extraction.
attributes.references: ISO Guide 30 - Reference materials, AWWA laboratory best practices

attributes.name: reorder_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum stock quantity that triggers a reorder alert or procurement action. Ensures continuous availability of critical reagents and standards for analytical operations.
attributes.references: Laboratory inventory management best practices, ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: safety_data_sheet_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file location for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) associated with this reagent. SDS provides hazard information, handling instructions, and emergency procedures.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (29 CFR 1910.1200), ISO 11014 - Safety data sheet for chemical products

attributes.name: stock_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the stock quantity: milliliters (mL), liters (L), grams (g), kilograms (kg), units, or vials.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 - Quantities and units, laboratory inventory standards

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required environmental conditions for storing the reagent or standard to maintain stability and integrity: ambient temperature, refrigerated (2-8°C), frozen (<0°C), protected from light (dark), or under inert atmosphere.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025, manufacturer specifications, OSHA laboratory safety standards

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical location within the laboratory where the reagent or standard is stored, such as refrigerator ID, cabinet number, or shelf designation. Supports inventory management and retrieval.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025, laboratory safety and inventory management standards

attributes.name: verified_by

products.name: analyst_method_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the certification relationship between certified analysts and test methods in the laboratory quality assurance program. It captures the formal qualification of each analyst to perform specific analytical test methods, including certification dates, proficiency testing results, and signatory authority. Each record links one certified analyst to one test method with attributes that exist only in the context of this qualification relationship. This is a critical quality control entity audited by accreditation bodies (NELAC, TNI) and required for data defensibility in regulatory reporting.. Existence Justification: In water utility laboratories, analyst method qualification is a formal, audited business process required by accreditation bodies (NELAC, TNI). Each analyst must be individually certified to perform specific test methods, with documented training, proficiency testing, and supervisor approval. One analyst is qualified for multiple methods (e.g., an analyst qualified for EPA 200.8, SM 2130B, and EPA 524.2), and each method has multiple qualified analysts (e.g., EPA 200.8 can be performed by 5 different certified analysts). The laboratory quality manager actively manages this matrix of qualifications, tracking expiration dates, proficiency test results, and signatory authority for each analyst-method combination.

products.name: plan_analyte_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory monitoring requirement between sampling_plan and analyte. It captures the specific testing parameters, methods, and compliance thresholds that define which analytes must be tested under each sampling plan. Each record links one sampling plan to one analyte with attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory requirement, such as the specific test method to use, compliance threshold values, and preservation requirements for that analyte within that plan's context.. Existence Justification: Water utilities manage sampling plans that specify multiple analytes to be tested (e.g., a SDWA compliance plan tests for lead, copper, chlorine, THMs, HAA5, PFAS), and each analyte appears in multiple sampling plans (e.g., lead is tested under LCRR tap sampling, distribution system monitoring, and entry point monitoring plans). The relationship itself carries critical regulatory data: the specific test method required for that analyte under that plan, the compliance threshold value (which may differ from default MCL based on permit conditions), preservation requirements, holding times, and reporting obligations. This is actively managed in LIMS as the core configuration that drives sample analysis and compliance reporting.

products.description: This association product represents the formal accreditation grant issued by a regulatory agency to a laboratory for specific testing capabilities. Each record captures the certificate, scope, validity period, assessment schedule, and compliance status for one accreditation relationship. A laboratory holds multiple accreditations from different agencies (EPA, state primacy, NELAC, A2LA), and each agency accredits multiple laboratories. This is a core compliance artifact that laboratories actively manage for regulatory defensibility.. Existence Justification: In water utility laboratory operations, a single laboratory holds multiple simultaneous accreditations from different regulatory agencies (EPA, state primacy agency, NELAC/TNI, A2LA, DoD ELAP), and each regulatory agency accredits multiple laboratories across their jurisdiction. Each accreditation grant is a distinct compliance artifact with its own certificate number, scope, validity period, assessment schedule, and status. Laboratory managers actively manage their accreditation portfolio, tracking renewal dates, responding to agency-specific deficiencies, and ensuring regulatory defensibility of analytical data for each agency relationship.

products.description: This association product represents the bill-of-materials relationship between laboratory test methods and the materials, reagents, chemicals, and consumables required to perform each test. products.name: analyst_grant_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the labor allocation between certified laboratory analysts and grants. Each record links one certified analyst to one grant with attributes that track the analyst's role, effort percentage, labor costs, and allocation period for grant accounting and federal reporting requirements.. domains.name: compliance
domains.description: Regulatory compliance management including permit tracking (NPDES, IUP, state primacy agency permits), MOR/DMR preparation and submission, violation management, enforcement action tracking, audit trails, environmental reporting, SDWA and CWA compliance, CCR publication tracking, and regulatory correspondence. Ensures adherence to all federal, state, and local water and wastewater regulations.
domains.references: EPA SDWA, CWA, NPDES, state primacy agencies, NACWA

products.name: compliance_permit
products.description: Master record for all regulatory operating permits held by the utility, including NPDES discharge permits, state drinking water permits, IUPs (Industrial User Permits), air quality permits, and stormwater permits. Tracks permit number, issuing authority (EPA, state primacy agency, NPDES), permit type, facility covered, effective and expiration dates, permitted limits, renewal status, and associated regulatory program (SDWA, CWA). Serves as the authoritative registry of all regulatory authorizations required to operate water and wastewater facilities.
products.reference: NPDES Permit / State Operating Permit / IUP

Each condition is linked to its parent permit and tracks the parameter, limit type (daily max, monthly average), numeric threshold, units, monitoring location, and compliance evaluation method. Enables automated compliance checking against actual discharge monitoring results.
products.reference: NPDES Effluent Limitation / Permit Condition

attributes.name: permit_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the permit condition record. Primary key.

attributes.name: analytical_method
attributes.description: The specific EPA-approved or Standard Methods analytical procedure required for measuring this parameter (e.g., 'EPA Method 1664A', 'Standard Methods 5210B', 'EPA Method 200.8', 'EPA Method 537.1 for PFAS', 'SM 2540D for TDS', 'SM 4500-H+ for pH').
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Methods for Chemical Analysis of Water and Wastes

attributes.name: compliance_evaluation_method
attributes.description: The method used to determine compliance with this condition: single value comparison (each result compared to limit), rolling average (moving average over specified period), statistical analysis (percentile or confidence interval), narrative assessment (qualitative evaluation), or best professional judgment (case-by-case determination).
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Compliance Inspection Manual

attributes.name: compliance_schedule_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition is subject to a compliance schedule (phased implementation plan) that allows the permittee additional time to achieve full compliance. True if a compliance schedule is in effect, False otherwise.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: compliance_schedule_milestone
attributes.description: Description of the compliance schedule milestone associated with this condition (e.g., 'Submit engineering plans by 2024-06-30', 'Complete construction by 2025-12-31', 'Achieve interim limit of 30 mg/L BOD by 2024-12-31'). Null if no compliance schedule applies.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: condition_number
attributes.description: The official condition number or identifier as stated in the permit document (e.g., 'I.A.1', 'II.B.3', 'Condition 5').
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Numbering Convention

attributes.name: condition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the permit condition: active (currently enforceable), suspended (temporarily not enforced due to variance or stay), superseded (replaced by modified condition), expired (no longer in effect), or under appeal (contested by permittee).
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program

attributes.name: condition_text
attributes.description: The full verbatim text of the permit condition as written in the permit document. Includes all narrative requirements, qualifications, and regulatory language.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Document

attributes.name: condition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the permit condition: effluent limit (numeric discharge limit), monitoring requirement (sampling frequency and method), reporting requirement (MOR/DMR submission), technology-based standard (treatment technology mandate), narrative condition (qualitative requirement), or best management practice (operational control).
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this permit condition record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: detection_limit_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum detection limit (MDL) or practical quantitation limit (PQL) required for the analytical method. Ensures that the laboratory can measure the parameter at levels sufficiently below the permit limit to demonstrate compliance. Null if no specific detection limit is mandated.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Methods for Chemical Analysis of Water and Wastes

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this permit condition becomes enforceable. May differ from the parent permit effective date if the condition has a phased implementation schedule.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program

attributes.name: enforcement_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned by the regulatory agency for enforcement of this condition. Critical conditions (e.g., public health parameters like coliform, lead, PFAS) trigger immediate enforcement action upon violation. High priority conditions (e.g., BOD, TSS, pH) require prompt corrective action. Medium and low priority conditions may allow for compliance schedules.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Enforcement Management System (EMS)

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this permit condition expires or is superseded. Typically aligns with the parent permit expiration date unless the condition is time-limited or subject to modification.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: The statistical basis for the effluent limit: daily maximum (highest single-day value), monthly average (arithmetic mean over calendar month), weekly average (arithmetic mean over 7-day period), instantaneous maximum (single grab sample), annual average, or minimum (for parameters like dissolved oxygen).
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: mixing_zone_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a mixing zone (limited area where discharge is allowed to exceed water quality standards before achieving full dilution and compliance) is authorized for this condition. True if mixing zone is allowed, False if end-of-pipe compliance is required.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Water Quality Standards Handbook

attributes.name: mixing_zone_description
attributes.description: Description of the authorized mixing zone including dimensions, boundaries, and compliance monitoring points (e.g., '100 meters downstream of Outfall 001', 'Within 50-foot radius of discharge point', 'Compliance measured at edge of mixing zone'). Null if no mixing zone is allowed.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Water Quality Standards Handbook

attributes.name: modification_date
attributes.description: The date on which this permit condition was last modified through permit amendment, administrative order, or consent decree. Null if the condition has never been modified since the original permit issuance.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program

attributes.name: modification_reason
attributes.description: The reason for the most recent modification to this condition (e.g., 'Updated water quality standards', 'New analytical method approved', 'Compliance schedule adjustment', 'Facility upgrade completed', 'Enforcement action settlement', 'Anti-backsliding provision waiver'). Null if never modified.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for monitoring or sampling this parameter: continuous (real-time SCADA monitoring), daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annually, or as needed (event-driven). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continuous|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annually|as_needed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: monitoring_location
attributes.description: The specific location where monitoring or sampling must occur (e.g., 'Outfall 001', 'Effluent Discharge Point A', 'Influent to Primary Treatment', 'Final Effluent'). May reference a specific outfall, sampling point, or monitoring station.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or operational guidance related to this permit condition. May include cross-references to other permit sections, special instructions for compliance staff, or historical context.

attributes.name: numeric_limit
attributes.description: The numeric threshold value for the effluent limit or monitoring requirement. Null for narrative conditions or qualitative requirements.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the regulated parameter (e.g., '00310' for BOD, '00530' for TSS, '00400' for pH, '00600' for TDS). Uses EPA STORET or equivalent parameter coding system.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) STORET Parameter Code Registry

attributes.name: public_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether violations of this condition require public notification (e.g., inclusion in Consumer Confidence Report (CCR), public notice in local newspaper, notification to downstream water users). True if public notification is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) Public Notification Rule

attributes.name: quality_assurance_requirement
attributes.description: Specific quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) requirements for monitoring and sampling (e.g., 'EPA Method 1664A for FOG', 'Standard Methods 5210B for BOD', 'EPA Method 200.8 for metals', 'Chain of custody required', 'Laboratory must be state-certified', 'Duplicate samples required quarterly').
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Methods for Chemical Analysis of Water and Wastes

attributes.name: receiving_water_body
attributes.description: The name of the receiving water body (river, stream, lake, estuary, ocean, groundwater) into which the discharge occurs and for which this condition is designed to protect water quality (e.g., 'Mississippi River', 'Lake Michigan', 'Chesapeake Bay', 'Atlantic Ocean', 'Groundwater Aquifer Zone IIA').
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: record_retention_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days that monitoring records, laboratory results, and compliance documentation for this condition must be retained by the permittee. Typically 3 years (1095 days) for NPDES permits, but may be longer for certain parameters or enforcement actions.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program (40 CFR 122.41)

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: The legal or regulatory authority for this condition (e.g., 'Clean Water Act Section 301', 'SDWA Section 1412', '40 CFR 122.44', 'State Water Quality Standard Chapter 62-302', 'Technology-Based Effluent Limitation', 'Water Quality-Based Effluent Limitation', 'Best Available Technology (BAT)', 'Best Conventional Pollutant Control Technology (BCT)').
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Clean Water Act (CWA) and Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA)

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for reporting monitoring results to the regulatory agency via Monthly Operating Report (MOR) or Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR): monthly, quarterly, annually, event-based (for spills or exceedances), or not required (internal monitoring only).
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: The type of sample required for compliance monitoring: grab (single instantaneous sample), composite (time-weighted or flow-weighted composite over specified period), continuous (real-time monitoring), or flow-weighted (proportional to flow rate).
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: seasonal_period
attributes.description: The time period during which seasonal variations apply (e.g., 'May 1 - September 30', 'Winter: November 1 - March 31', 'Low Flow Season: June - August'). Null if no seasonal variation applies.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: seasonal_variation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition has seasonal variations in limits or monitoring requirements (e.g., more stringent limits during low-flow summer months, reduced monitoring during winter). True if seasonal variations apply, False otherwise.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: technology_requirement
attributes.description: Specific treatment technology or operational practice mandated by this condition (e.g., 'Secondary Treatment', 'Ultraviolet (UV) Disinfection', 'Granular Activated Carbon (GAC) Filtration', 'Reverse Osmosis (RO)', 'Microfiltration (MF)', 'Ultrafiltration (UF)', 'Fats Oils and Grease (FOG) Pretreatment', 'Best Management Practice (BMP) for Stormwater'). Null for non-technology-based conditions.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Effluent Guidelines and Standards

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the numeric limit (e.g., 'mg/L' for milligrams per liter, 'ug/L' for micrograms per liter, 'NTU' for Nephelometric Turbidity Units, 'SU' for Standard Units (pH), 'MPN/100mL' for Most Probable Number per 100 milliliters, 'lbs/day' for pounds per day, 'MGD' for Million Gallons per Day).
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) STORET Unit Code Registry

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this permit condition record was last updated in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: violation_threshold
attributes.description: The numeric value at which a violation is triggered. May differ from the numeric limit if the permit allows for measurement uncertainty, rounding conventions, or compliance margins. Null for narrative conditions.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Compliance Inspection Manual

attributes.name: water_quality_standard_basis
attributes.description: The specific water quality standard or criterion that this condition is designed to protect (e.g., 'Aquatic Life Chronic Criterion', 'Human Health - Fish Consumption', 'Drinking Water Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL)', 'Recreational Water Quality Standard', 'Anti-Degradation Policy Tier II'). Null for technology-based conditions.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Water Quality Standards Handbook

Tracks the regulation citation, regulatory program, effective date, compliance deadline, applicable facility types, and the specific operational or reporting obligation imposed. Serves as the master compliance obligation registry.

attributes.name: civil_penalty_amount

attributes.name: compliance_schedule_final_deadline

attributes.name: modified_by_user

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, internal discussions, negotiation history, or other relevant information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: penalty_payment_date

attributes.name: public_notice_date

attributes.description: Date the utility officially received the enforcement action notice. Used to calculate response deadlines and compliance timelines.

attributes.name: regulatory_citation

attributes.references: Clean Water Act, Safe Drinking Water Act, 40 CFR Parts 122-136, State Water Quality Regulations

attributes.name: resolution_date

attributes.name: resolution_outcome

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the utility must submit a formal response to the enforcement action. Typically specified in the enforcement notice or calculated based on regulatory timelines.

attributes.name: response_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date the utility submitted its formal response to the enforcement action. Tracks compliance with response deadlines.

attributes.name: supplemental_environmental_project_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enforcement action includes a Supplemental Environmental Project (SEP) as part of the settlement. SEPs are environmentally beneficial projects that go beyond compliance requirements and may offset civil penalties.

products.name: permit_vendor_service
products.description: This association product represents the service contract between compliance_permit and vendor. It captures the specific services provided by vendors in support of regulatory permit compliance, including engineering consulting, legal counsel, laboratory testing, environmental monitoring, and permit application preparation. Each record links one compliance_permit to one vendor with attributes that describe the service relationship, contract terms, deliverables, and performance metrics specific to that permit-vendor engagement.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, regulatory permits require multiple specialized vendors providing distinct services: engineering consultants for permit applications, legal counsel for regulatory compliance, laboratories for water quality testing, and environmental monitoring firms for ongoing compliance reporting. Each permit-vendor relationship represents a specific service engagement with its own contract terms, deliverables, scope, and performance metrics. Conversely, vendors (especially specialized consulting firms and testing laboratories) serve multiple permits across different facilities and regulatory programs (NPDES, SDWA, air quality). The utility actively manages these service relationships, tracking contract dates, deliverable status, and vendor performance for each permit-vendor engagement.

products.name: material_compliance_certification
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory compliance certification relationship between regulatory requirements and materials/chemicals used in water treatment. It captures the NSF/ANSI 60/61 certification status, state approvals, and regulatory compliance documentation for each material-requirement pair. Each record links one regulatory requirement to one material with certification dates, approval status, and applicable standards that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, regulatory requirements (such as Lead and Copper Rule, DBP rules, SDWA MCLs, PFAS standards) apply to multiple treatment chemicals and materials, and each chemical/material must comply with multiple regulatory requirements. Utilities actively manage NSF/ANSI 60/61 certifications, state approvals, and regulatory compliance status for each material-requirement pair as a distinct operational record with certification dates, approval status, expiration tracking, and dosage limits. This is a genuine operational M:N relationship where compliance officers create, monitor, and renew certifications as part of regulatory compliance workflows.

products.name: permit_grant_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the funding allocation between compliance permits and grants in water utilities. It captures the financial relationship where grants fund permit-related compliance activities and capital improvements. Each record links one compliance permit to one grant with allocation amounts, eligible activities, drawdown schedules, compliance milestones, and reporting periods that exist only in the context of this funding relationship.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, compliance permits frequently require capital improvements and ongoing compliance activities funded by multiple grants (e.g., a NPDES discharge permit may receive funding from both CWSRF for treatment upgrades and EPA grants for monitoring equipment). Conversely, single grants commonly fund compliance activities across multiple permits (e.g., a DWSRF loan funds upgrades for both drinking water permits and NPDES permits at the same facility). Utilities actively manage these allocations, tracking specific dollar amounts, eligible activities, drawdown schedules, compliance milestones, and reporting periods for each permit-grant pairing to ensure grant compliance and audit readiness.

products.name: crew_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between compliance_obligation and crew. It captures the operational assignment of field service crews to specific compliance obligations, tracking crew-specific progress, effort allocation, and role in fulfilling regulatory requirements. Each record links one compliance_obligation to one crew with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, complex compliance obligations (such as system-wide valve exercising programs, annual hydrant flushing campaigns, or multi-site NPDES monitoring) routinely require multiple specialized crews working concurrently or sequentially, each contributing specific expertise or covering different geographic areas. Simultaneously, field service crews are assigned to multiple compliance obligations throughout the year, balancing regulatory work with emergency response and routine maintenance. The business actively manages these assignments, tracking crew-specific progress, effort allocation, roles, and completion status for regulatory reporting and labor cost allocation.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll / Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the timesheet record was last modified. Updated whenever any field changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the timesheet entry. May include supervisor comments, exception explanations, or audit notes.

attributes.name: overtime_hours

attributes.name: pay_code

attributes.name: payroll_period

attributes.name: regular_hours

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work shift. Determines pay rate multiplier and labor cost allocation rules.

attributes.name: standby_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours employee was on standby or on-call status. May be compensated at a different rate than regular hours.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the employee submitted the timesheet entry for approval.

attributes.name: task_description

attributes.name: timesheet_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the labor hours were worked. Used for payroll period assignment and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: training_hours

attributes.name: work_location

products.name: position
products.description: Organizational position master defining authorized roles within the utility's workforce structure. Captures position title, job code, department, facility, required operator license grade, required certifications, pay grade range, FTE count authorized, union classification, FLSA status (exempt/non-exempt), and whether the position requires 24/7 on-call availability. Supports workforce planning and succession management. Sourced from SAP HR Organizational Management.
products.reference: SAP HR Organizational Management (Infotype 1000/1001)

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organizational position. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: facility_id

attributes.name: primary_position_department_org_unit_id

attributes.name: secondary_position_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department or division to which this position is assigned (e.g., Water Treatment Operations, Distribution Maintenance, Wastewater Collections).

attributes.name: supervisor_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position that supervises this position in the organizational hierarchy. Enables reporting structure and span-of-control analysis.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this position was officially approved by the governing authority. Used for audit trails and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive or governing body that approved the creation or modification of this position (e.g., Utility Director, Board of Commissioners).

attributes.name: bargaining_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the collective bargaining unit to which this position belongs, if applicable (e.g., AFSCME Local 123, Teamsters Local 456). Null for non-union positions.

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the position used in SAP HR and workforce planning systems. Unique alphanumeric code assigned to each authorized position.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: position_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the position's responsibilities, duties, and accountabilities. Typically includes essential functions, working conditions, and physical requirements.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this position was eliminated or became inactive. Null for active positions. Used for historical workforce analysis and organizational change tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this position was created or became effective in the organizational structure. Used for workforce planning and historical analysis.

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act. Exempt positions are salaried and not eligible for overtime pay; non-exempt positions are eligible for overtime compensation for hours worked beyond 40 per week.

attributes.name: fte_count
attributes.description: Number of full-time equivalent employees authorized for this position. Typically 1.0 for full-time positions; may be fractional for part-time or shared positions (e.g., 0.5 FTE).

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized job classification code linking the position to a job family and career ladder. Used for compensation benchmarking and workforce analytics.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this position record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: organizational_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of this position within the organizational structure. Level 1 is typically executive leadership; higher numbers represent deeper levels in the hierarchy. Used for span-of-control analysis and reporting structure visualization.

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation grade or band assigned to this position. Links to the utility's compensation structure and defines the salary range for the position.

attributes.name: pay_range_maximum

attributes.name: pay_range_minimum

attributes.name: position_status

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Classification of the position by employment type. Full-time positions are permanent and year-round; seasonal positions support peak demand periods (e.g., summer water demand); temporary positions are project-based.

attributes.name: required_certifications

attributes.references: OSHA, AWWA, WEF, State Licensing Boards

attributes.name: required_operator_license_grade
attributes.description: Minimum water or wastewater operator license grade required for this position as mandated by state drinking water or wastewater discharge programs. Grades typically range from 1 (entry-level) to 4 (advanced treatment plant operations). Critical for regulatory compliance under Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) and Clean Water Act (CWA).
attributes.references: State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies, EPA

attributes.name: requires_cdl
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires a valid Commercial Driver License (CDL) for operating utility vehicles (e.g., tanker trucks, heavy equipment). CDL class and endorsements are specified in required_certifications.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration

attributes.name: requires_confined_space_entry
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires confined space entry certification and training for work in tanks, manholes, vaults, and other permit-required confined spaces. Critical for safety compliance under OSHA 1910.146.

attributes.name: requires_on_call
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires 24/7 on-call availability for emergency response (e.g., water main breaks, treatment plant alarms, wastewater overflows). Critical for Operations and Maintenance (O&M) workforce planning.

attributes.name: safety_sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position is classified as safety-sensitive under OSHA or Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations, requiring enhanced safety training, drug testing, and incident tracking.

attributes.name: shift_rotation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires rotating shift work (e.g., 24/7 treatment plant operations with day/evening/night shifts). Used for crew scheduling and workforce planning.

attributes.name: succession_criticality
attributes.description: Assessment of the criticality of this position for succession planning. Critical positions have limited internal talent pools and require proactive succession planning (e.g., licensed operators, specialized engineers).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official job title for the position as defined in the organizational structure (e.g., Water Treatment Plant Operator II, Distribution System Supervisor, Wastewater Compliance Manager).

attributes.name: union_classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Union positions are subject to negotiated labor contracts; management positions are typically excluded from union representation.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level

products.name: safety_incident
products.description: Comprehensive EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) records for utility workforce covering OSHA-recordable and non-recordable safety incidents, near-misses, workplace safety inspections, and inspection findings. Incident aspects capture incident date/time, location (facility, field site, GIS coordinates), incident type (injury, near-miss, property damage, environmental release, vehicle accident), OSHA recordability determination, body part affected, root cause classification, corrective actions, days away from work, restricted duty days, and OSHA 300/300A log reference. Inspection aspects capture inspection date, inspector, facility/location, inspection type (routine, pre-task, regulatory, third-party), checklist items evaluated, findings/deficiencies, severity rating, corrective action required, and closure status. Mandatory for OSHA compliance, utility safety program management, and regulatory audit documentation.
products.reference: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 Recordkeeping; OSHA 300 Log

attributes.name: safety_incident_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: primary_primary_safety_employee_id

attributes.name: secondary_safety_employee_id

attributes.name: source_tertiary_safety_reported_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who reported the incident. May be the affected employee, a witness, or a supervisor.

attributes.name: body_part_affected

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date when corrective actions were completed and verified.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: days_away_from_work

attributes.name: days_of_restricted_duty
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the employee was on restricted or light duty as a result of the incident. Used for OSHA 300 log.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit where the employee was assigned at the time of the incident (e.g., Water Treatment, Distribution Operations, Wastewater Collection).

attributes.name: environmental_release_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident involved an environmental release (spill, discharge, or emission). True if release occurred, False if no release.

attributes.name: environmental_release_volume
attributes.description: Volume of environmental release in gallons, if applicable. Used for regulatory reporting and environmental impact assessment.

attributes.name: field_location_description

attributes.name: gis_latitude

attributes.name: incident_time

attributes.name: incident_type

attributes.name: investigation_status

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: location_type

attributes.name: last_modified_date

attributes.name: lead_time_days

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer or chemical producer. Used for warranty tracking, technical support, and approved vendor management.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number

attributes.name: material_description

attributes.name: material_group

attributes.name: material_number

attributes.name: material_status

attributes.name: material_type

attributes.name: maximum_stock_quantity

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days

attributes.name: moving_average_price

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional material information including technical specifications, usage instructions, cross-reference notes, or special handling requirements not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: price_unit
