attributes.description: Composite rating summarizing vendor performance across all Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) during the evaluation period. Used for vendor qualification decisions and contract renewals.

attributes.name: overall_performance_score
attributes.description: Numeric composite score (typically 0-100 scale) calculated from weighted individual Key Performance Indicator (KPI) scores. Supports quantitative vendor comparison and ranking.

attributes.name: pricing_accuracy_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of invoices that matched contracted pricing without discrepancies during the evaluation period. Measures vendor adherence to contract terms and billing accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP MM Invoice Verification / Contract Management

attributes.name: quality_conformance_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of delivered goods or services that met quality specifications and acceptance criteria during the evaluation period. Critical for chemical procurement (chlorine, coagulants, polymers, fluoride) where quality directly impacts water treatment efficacy.
attributes.references: SAP MM Quality Management (QM) / AWWA Standards

attributes.name: recommendation
attributes.description: Evaluator recommendation for future business relationship with the vendor based on performance evaluation results (e.g., continue current relationship, renew contract, renegotiate terms, place on probation, discontinue).
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Evaluation (ME61/ME6B) / Procurement Policy

attributes.name: responsiveness_score
attributes.description: Qualitative score (typically 1-5 or 1-10 scale) rating vendor responsiveness to inquiries, issue resolution, and communication timeliness during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: total_order_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all purchase orders from the vendor during the evaluation period. Provides spend context for vendor importance and risk assessment.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Evaluation (ME61/ME6B) / SAP FI

attributes.name: total_orders_evaluated
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders from the vendor included in this performance evaluation period. Provides context for the statistical significance of Key Performance Indicator (KPI) scores.

products.name: material_requisition
products.description: Reservation or issue request for materials from warehouse stock to support a specific work order, maintenance activity, or treatment operation. Captures reservation number, requesting department, work order or project reference, material, required quantity, required date, issue status, issuing warehouse location, and issued quantity. Bridges the asset/maintenance domain demand with supply domain fulfillment. Aligns with SAP MM Reservation (RESB/RKPF).
products.reference: SAP MM Material Reservation (RESB/RKPF)

attributes.name: material_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material requisition record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project if the requisition supports capital work. Null for Operations and Maintenance (O&M) activities.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Cost center to which the material consumption will be charged. Used for financial tracking and budget allocation.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Material issues may charge specific funds to distinguish capital vs operating expenses. Relevant for CIP work orders where materials charge capital project funds per GASB requirements.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: General ledger account to which the material cost is posted. Used for financial accounting and expense tracking.

attributes.name: primary_material_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset or equipment for which the material is being requisitioned. Links to asset registry for maintenance context.

attributes.name: secondary_material_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset or equipment for which the material is being requisitioned. Links to asset registry for maintenance context.

attributes.name: primary_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record being requisitioned. Links to inventory item, spare part, or chemical.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order for which materials are being requisitioned. Links maintenance demand to supply fulfillment.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number of the material being requisitioned. Critical for chemicals and materials requiring traceability for quality and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material requisition record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Creation Date and Time (ERDAT/ERZET)

attributes.name: deleted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reservation has been marked for deletion. Deleted reservations are retained for audit purposes but excluded from active processing.

attributes.name: final_issue_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reservation is marked for final issue. When true, no further material withdrawals are expected and the reservation can be closed.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the material was physically issued from the warehouse. Null if not yet issued.

attributes.name: issued_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the warehouse personnel who fulfilled the requisition and issued the material. Null if not yet issued.

attributes.name: issued_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material actually issued from warehouse to fulfill this requisition. May differ from requested quantity due to stock availability or adjustments.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material being requisitioned. Provides human-readable context for the item.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: Material document number generated upon goods issue. Links the requisition to the actual inventory transaction in SAP MM.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year of the material document. Used in combination with material document number for unique identification.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material in the source system. Stock keeping unit or material code.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material requisition record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.
attributes.references: SAP MM Change Date and Time (AEDAT/AEZET)

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code that defines the nature of the material transaction: goods issue, return, scrap, etc.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the material requisition. May include special handling instructions, substitution approvals, or issue explanations.

attributes.name: outstanding_quantity
attributes.description: Remaining quantity yet to be issued. Calculated as requested quantity minus issued quantity.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Plant or facility code where the material will be consumed. Aligns with Water Treatment Plant (WTP) or Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) organizational structure.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Urgency level of the material requisition. Emergency requisitions support critical failures; high priority supports urgent maintenance; normal and low support planned work.

attributes.name: requested_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who created the material requisition. Typically a maintenance planner, operator, or project manager.

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material requested for reservation. Original demand quantity before any adjustments or partial issues.

attributes.name: requesting_department
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit that initiated the material requisition. Typically the maintenance, operations, or project team.
attributes.references: SAP MM Cost Center / Functional Location

attributes.name: required_date
attributes.description: Date by which the material is needed to support the work order or operation. Drives warehouse picking and fulfillment priority.

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material requisition: open (not yet fulfilled), partially issued (some materials released), fully issued (complete), cancelled, or closed.

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the requisition based on its purpose: maintenance work, treatment operations, capital improvement program, emergency response, or planned activity.

attributes.name: reservation_date
attributes.description: Date when the material reservation was created in the system. Represents the business event timestamp for demand registration.

attributes.name: reservation_item_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the reservation document. Identifies individual material line within a multi-line reservation.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material reservation in the source system. Externally-known unique code for tracking and reference.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator for special stock types such as consignment, project stock, or vendor-managed inventory. Blank for standard warehouse stock.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the material quantity is expressed: gallons, pounds, each, feet, etc. Aligns with material master base unit.
attributes.references: SAP MM Base Unit of Measure (MEINS)

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Material valuation category used for inventory accounting. Distinguishes between different stock types or procurement sources.

attributes.name: warehouse_location
attributes.description: Warehouse or storage location from which the material will be issued. Identifies the physical inventory source.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure element for Capital Improvement Program (CIP) projects. Enables project cost tracking and reporting.

products.name: rfq
products.description: Request for Quotation issued to one or more vendors to solicit competitive pricing for materials or services, and the vendor responses received. Captures RFQ number, issue date, closing date, commodity description, quantity, delivery requirements, evaluation criteria, invited vendors, vendor-submitted pricing, delivery lead times, payment terms, technical compliance notes, bid comparison scores, and award decision. Supports the full solicitation-to-award lifecycle for chemicals, equipment, and construction services. Aligns with SAP MM RFQ/Quotation (EKKO doc type AN / ME41-ME49).
products.reference: SAP MM Request for Quotation (ME41/EKKO doc type AN)

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the request for quotation record. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP MM RFQ (EKKO with doc type AN / ME41)

attributes.name: awarded_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor selected and awarded the contract resulting from this RFQ. Populated when rfq_status = 'awarded'. Links to supply.vendor.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cip_project. Business justification: RFQs for project-specific equipment, materials, or services must track the driving CIP project for sourcing decisions, budget validation, and procurement documentation. Water utilities issue project-s

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: RFQs validate budget before solicitation for procurement planning. Budget control ensuring competitive solicitations only proceed when budget exists, preventing unauthorized commitments.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: RFQs verify fund availability before solicitation to ensure budget exists. Procurement control preventing solicitations for purchases without appropriated funds in governmental accounting.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record if this RFQ is for a specific cataloged material or spare part. Links to supply.material_master for materials procurement.

attributes.name: procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_category. Business justification: RFQs are classified by procurement category for routing to appropriate buyers and compliance with category-specific sourcing rules. Currently uses denormalized procurement_category STRING; should be p

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_requisition. Business justification: RFQs are often created FROM purchase requisitions to source materials or services. Currently uses denormalized requisition_number STRING; should be proper FK to trace sourcing back to business need. C

attributes.name: awarded_amount
attributes.description: Total contract value or purchase order amount awarded to the selected vendor. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: awarded_date
attributes.description: Date the RFQ was awarded to the selected vendor and purchase order was issued or contract was executed.

attributes.name: bonding_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors must provide bid bonds, performance bonds, or payment bonds. Common for construction and large equipment procurements. True if bonding is required.

attributes.name: buyer_email
attributes.description: Email address of the buyer for vendor inquiries and communication. Confidential organizational contact information.

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement specialist or buyer responsible for managing this RFQ process, vendor communication, and quote evaluation.

attributes.name: buyer_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the buyer for vendor inquiries. Confidential organizational contact information.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the RFQ was cancelled if rfq_status = 'cancelled'. Examples: 'Insufficient vendor response', 'Budget unavailable', 'Requirements changed', 'Procurement method changed'.

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: Deadline date by which vendors must submit their quotations. After this date, the RFQ is typically closed to new submissions.

attributes.name: closing_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp (date and time) when the RFQ closes for quote submissions. Used when exact time matters for competitive bidding.

attributes.name: competitive_bidding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RFQ is part of a formal competitive bidding process requiring multiple vendor quotes. True if competitive bidding is required, False if sole-source or limited competition.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center or department code responsible for this procurement. Used for budget tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFQ record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the RFQ and expected quotations (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Physical location or facility where materials or equipment should be delivered, or where services should be performed (e.g., 'Main WTP', 'North WWTP', 'Central Warehouse').

attributes.name: delivery_required_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the materials or services must be delivered or completed. Critical for operational planning and vendor evaluation.

attributes.name: rfq_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the materials, services, or scope of work being solicited. May include technical specifications, performance requirements, and background context.

attributes.name: diversity_preference_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RFQ includes preference or set-aside provisions for minority-owned, woman-owned, or small business vendors. True if diversity preferences apply.

attributes.name: estimated_budget_amount
attributes.description: Internal estimated budget or cost target for this procurement. Typically not disclosed to vendors but used for internal approval and evaluation. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: evaluation_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria and weighting factors used to evaluate and compare vendor quotations (e.g., 'Price 50%, Delivery Time 20%, Quality 20%, Vendor Experience 10%'). Ensures transparent and objective vendor selection.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the procurement cost will be charged. Used for financial accounting and expense classification (OPEX vs CAPEX).

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard trade terms defining responsibilities for shipping, insurance, and risk transfer between buyer and seller (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). Applicable for equipment and chemical procurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors must provide proof of insurance (general liability, workers compensation, professional liability) to be eligible for award. True if insurance is required.

attributes.name: invited_vendor_count
attributes.description: Total number of vendors invited to submit quotations for this RFQ. Used to track solicitation breadth and competitive participation.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date the RFQ was officially issued and distributed to invited vendors. Marks the start of the quotation period.

attributes.name: minimum_vendors_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of vendor quotations required to satisfy competitive procurement policies. Typically 3 for formal competitive bids.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this RFQ record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFQ record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about the RFQ process, vendor interactions, evaluation decisions, or special circumstances. Used for audit trail and knowledge capture.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms offered to vendors (e.g., 'Net 30', 'Net 60', '2/10 Net 30'). Defines when payment is due after invoice receipt.

attributes.name: pre_bid_attendance_mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendor attendance at the pre-bid meeting is mandatory to submit a valid quotation. True if mandatory, False if optional.

attributes.name: pre_bid_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date of optional pre-bid or pre-proposal meeting where vendors can ask questions and clarify requirements before submitting quotes. Common for complex procurements.

attributes.name: pre_bid_meeting_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location of the pre-bid meeting (e.g., 'Main Office Conference Room', 'Microsoft Teams Virtual Meeting').

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: Total quantity of materials or units of service being solicited in this RFQ. Used for vendor pricing and capacity evaluation.

attributes.name: quotes_received_count
attributes.description: Number of vendor quotations actually received in response to this RFQ. Used to assess vendor interest and competitive response rate.

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Expected date by which vendors should respond with their quotations. May differ from closing_date if there is a grace period or clarification window.

attributes.name: rfq_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the RFQ document, externally visible and used for vendor communication and tracking. Typically system-generated sequential or pattern-based number.

attributes.name: rfq_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RFQ: draft (being prepared), issued (sent to vendors), open (accepting quotes), closed (quote period ended), cancelled (RFQ withdrawn), awarded (vendor selected and purchase order issued).

attributes.name: rfq_type
attributes.description: Classification of the RFQ by procurement category: materials (spare parts, consumables), services (maintenance, consulting), equipment (capital assets), chemicals (treatment chemicals), construction (infrastructure projects), or professional services (engineering, legal).

attributes.name: technical_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the technical contact for vendor technical inquiries. Confidential organizational contact information.

attributes.name: technical_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the technical subject matter expert (e.g., plant operator, engineer) who can answer technical questions about specifications and requirements.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title or subject line for the RFQ, summarizing the procurement need (e.g., 'Chlorine Gas Supply Q2 2024', 'SCADA Upgrade Services').

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the quantity is expressed (e.g., EA for each, LB for pounds, GAL for gallons, TON for tons, HR for hours of service).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this RFQ record. Audit trail for accountability.

products.name: approved_vendor_list
products.description: Registry of vendors pre-qualified and approved to supply specific materials or service categories to the water utility. Captures vendor, material or service category, approval status, qualification date, expiry date, qualification criteria met (financial, technical, safety, insurance), approved spend limit, and reviewing authority. Enforces procurement compliance and ensures only vetted suppliers are used for critical chemicals and infrastructure materials.
products.reference: Approved Vendor List (AVL) / SAP MM Source List (EORD)

attributes.name: approved_vendor_list_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the approved vendor list entry. Primary key for this registry of pre-qualified vendors authorized to supply specific materials or service categories.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who granted final approval for this vendor qualification. Links to the HR employee master for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_category. Business justification: Vendor approvals are category-specific (e.g., approved for chemicals, not for construction services). Currently uses denormalized material_category_code STRING; should be proper FK to procurement_cate

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: Vendor approvals can be tied to specific contracts (e.g., pre-qualified under a master service agreement). Currently uses denormalized contract_number STRING; should be proper FK to enable contract-ba

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor entity that has been pre-qualified and approved for specific procurement categories. Links to the vendor master record in SAP MM.

attributes.name: approval_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale and supporting documentation summary for why this vendor was approved for the specified category. May reference evaluation scores, past performance, unique capabilities, or sole-source justifications.

attributes.name: approval_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier assigned to this vendor approval record for tracking and audit purposes. Used in procurement compliance reporting.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor approval. Approved vendors may be used in procurement; suspended or revoked vendors are blocked from new purchase orders until reinstated.

attributes.name: approval_type
attributes.description: Classification of the approval level. Preferred vendors receive priority consideration; emergency vendors are pre-approved for urgent procurements; conditional approvals have restrictions; trial approvals are temporary for evaluation.

attributes.name: approved_spend_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative purchase amount authorized for this vendor in the approved category without requiring additional approval authority. Null indicates no limit. Used to enforce procurement controls and delegation of authority.

attributes.name: approved_spend_limit_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency in which the approved spend limit is denominated, using ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: approved_spend_limit_period
attributes.description: The time period over which the approved spend limit applies. Per-transaction limits apply to individual purchase orders; annual limits reset each fiscal year; contract lifetime limits apply to the duration of the approval.

attributes.name: awwa_standards_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Standards Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor supplies materials or services that comply with AWWA standards for water treatment chemicals, pipes, valves, and equipment. Critical for ensuring product quality and regulatory compliance.

tag_set.value: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Standards Compliance Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approved vendor list record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this vendor approval becomes active and the vendor may be used for procurement in the approved category. May differ from qualification date due to administrative processing.

attributes.name: environmental_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has met environmental compliance criteria including EPA permits, waste disposal certifications, and environmental management system standards (ISO 14001). Required for chemical suppliers and waste management vendors.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this vendor approval expires and must be renewed. Ensures periodic re-evaluation of vendor qualifications, insurance, and compliance status. Null for indefinite approvals.

attributes.name: financial_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has met financial stability criteria including credit rating, financial statements review, and bonding capacity. Required for high-value or critical procurements.

attributes.name: insurance_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor maintains required insurance coverage including general liability, professional liability, and workers compensation at levels specified in procurement policy.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approved vendor list record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal performance evaluation for this vendor. Used to ensure periodic assessment of vendor performance against service level agreements and quality standards.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this vendor approval was reviewed for continued compliance with qualification criteria. Used to track periodic vendor performance and compliance audits.

attributes.name: local_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is located within the utility's service area or designated local procurement zone. Used to support local economic development and reduce transportation costs and lead times.

attributes.name: minority_owned_business_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise. Used to track diversity spend and meet regulatory or policy goals for supplier diversity.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of this vendor approval. Ensures timely re-evaluation of vendor qualifications and performance before expiration.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information about this vendor approval, including special conditions, restrictions, preferred use cases, or historical context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: nsf_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor supplies products certified by NSF International for use in drinking water systems. NSF 60 certification is required for treatment chemicals; NSF 61 for materials in contact with drinking water.

attributes.name: performance_rating_score
attributes.description: Quantitative performance score for this vendor in the approved category, based on delivery timeliness, quality, responsiveness, and compliance. Used for vendor selection and re-qualification decisions. Typically on a scale of 0-100 or 1-5.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor successfully completed the qualification process and was approved for the specified category. Used to track vendor tenure and re-qualification cycles.

attributes.name: quality_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has demonstrated quality management capabilities including ISO 9001 certification, quality control procedures, and product testing protocols. Critical for treatment chemicals and critical spare parts.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously suspended or revoked vendor approval was reinstated after corrective actions were completed and verified. Null if never suspended or not yet reinstated.

attributes.name: reviewing_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or committee that reviewed and approved this vendor qualification. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: reviewing_authority_title
attributes.description: The job title or role of the reviewing authority who approved this vendor qualification (e.g., Procurement Manager, Director of Supply Chain, Vendor Review Committee Chair).

attributes.name: safety_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has met safety requirements including OSHA compliance, safety training records, and incident history review. Mandatory for vendors providing on-site services or hazardous materials.

attributes.name: service_category_code
attributes.description: The service category for which this vendor is approved, such as construction, engineering, laboratory testing, or maintenance services. Used when approval is for services rather than materials.

attributes.name: small_business_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a small business. Used to track small business spend and meet regulatory requirements for small business participation in public utility procurement.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which this vendor approval was suspended or revoked. Used to track the duration of suspension and enforce procurement blocks in SAP MM.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this vendor approval was suspended or revoked, such as performance issues, compliance violations, insurance lapse, or safety incidents. Null when approval status is active.

attributes.name: technical_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has demonstrated technical competence for the approved category, including certifications, past performance, and capability assessments. Critical for specialized materials and services.

attributes.name: woman_owned_business_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a woman-owned business enterprise. Used to track diversity spend and meet regulatory or policy goals for supplier diversity.

products.name: procurement_category
products.description: Master reference table for procurement_category.

attributes.name: procurement_category_id

attributes.name: category_manager_employee_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Default cost center code for budget tracking and cost allocation of procurement in this category.
attributes.references: SAP CO Controlling Standards, GASB Fund Accounting

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Categories may link to standing budgets for recurring commodity purchases. Supports automated budget checking for routine purchases like chemicals, ensuring ongoing budget authority.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Categories may default to specific funds (capital vs operating) for automated fund assignment. Supports procurement configuration ensuring chemicals charge operating fund, equipment charges capital fu

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Default general ledger account code for financial posting of expenditures in this procurement category. Used for integration with SAP FI/CO financial accounting.
attributes.references: GASB Chart of Accounts, SAP FI/CO Standards

attributes.name: parent_procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on procurement_category (parent_procurement_category_id)

attributes.name: parent_procurement_category_id_legacy
attributes.description: Reference to the parent category in the hierarchical taxonomy. Null for top-level categories.

attributes.name: annual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total annual procurement spend for this category in the most recent fiscal year, used for spend analytics and sourcing prioritization.

attributes.name: approval_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount above which purchases in this category require additional management or executive approval per delegation of authority matrix.

attributes.name: average_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Typical procurement lead time in days for items in this category, used for materials planning and inventory management.

attributes.name: awwa_standards_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials in this category must comply with American Water Works Association (AWWA) standards for water utility infrastructure and equipment.

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Default budget or cost center code for purchases in this category, used for financial planning and cost allocation.

attributes.name: capital_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category are eligible for capitalization under GAAP or GASB accounting standards as part of Capital Improvement Program (CIP) expenditures.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 34, GAAP Fixed Asset Accounting

attributes.name: capital_vs_opex_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) vs Operating Expenditure (OPEX) Classification
attributes.description: Accounting classification indicating whether purchases in this category are typically capitalized as assets or expensed as operations and maintenance costs.

tag_set.value: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) vs Operating Expenditure (OPEX) Classification

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the procurement category. Used for classification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the goods and services included in this procurement category, including scope and boundaries.

attributes.name: category_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the category in the taxonomy tree. Level 1 is top-level, increasing numbers represent deeper nesting.

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the procurement category. Human-readable label for the category.

attributes.name: category_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the procurement category. Active categories are available for use in requisitions and purchase orders.

attributes.name: category_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the procurement category distinguishing between materials, services, chemicals, equipment, utilities, and professional services.

attributes.name: chemical_category_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category includes water or wastewater treatment chemicals (chlorine, coagulants, polymers, fluoride, etc.) requiring specialized procurement and inventory management.

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Standard commodity classification code aligned with NIGP (National Institute of Governmental Purchasing) or UNSPSC (United Nations Standard Products and Services Code) for procurement standardization.

attributes.name: commodity_group
attributes.description: High-level commodity grouping for the category. Aligns with water utility operational needs including treatment chemicals, infrastructure components, and support services.

attributes.name: competitive_bid_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category require competitive bidding process per procurement regulations and internal policy.
attributes.references: State Procurement Code and Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: competitive_bidding_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category require competitive bidding or request for quotation (RFQ) processes per regulatory or organizational procurement policies.
attributes.references: Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), State Procurement Codes

attributes.name: contract_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category must be made under an established contract or blanket purchase agreement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this procurement category record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_spare_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category are classified as critical spare parts essential for maintaining water and wastewater infrastructure operations and minimizing downtime.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for monetary thresholds and budgets associated with this procurement category (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: default_lead_time_days

attributes.name: diversity_preference_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement category has organizational or regulatory preferences for minority-owned, woman-owned, or small business enterprise (MBE/WBE/SBE) vendors.
attributes.references: Federal Small Business Act, State Diversity Procurement Programs

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this procurement category was retired or deprecated. Null for currently active categories.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this procurement category became active and available for use in requisitions and purchase orders.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether procurement in this category requires environmental compliance documentation such as Safety Data Sheets (SDS), EPA certifications, or environmental impact assessments.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether procurement in this category requires environmental compliance certifications or assessments (e.g., ISO 14001, EPA environmental standards).
attributes.references: ISO 14001 - Environmental Management, EPA Environmental Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Default general ledger account code for expenses in this category, used for financial accounting and reporting per GASB standards.
attributes.references: GASB Chart of Accounts and SAP FI

attributes.name: hazardous_material_category_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category includes hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, and regulatory compliance per OSHA and EPA standards.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials in this category are classified as hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, and regulatory compliance per OSHA and EPA standards.

attributes.name: insurance_requirement_description
attributes.description: Description of insurance coverage requirements for vendors supplying goods or services in this category, including liability limits and coverage types.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Management and Insurance Policy

attributes.name: inventory_managed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category are tracked in inventory management systems and subject to stock level monitoring, reorder points, and cycle counting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this procurement category record was last updated, used for change tracking and data lineage.

attributes.name: local_preference_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category has a local sourcing preference to support regional economic development and reduce supply chain risk.

attributes.name: material_group_code

attributes.name: minimum_order_threshold_amount

attributes.name: minimum_order_value

attributes.name: minority_business_enterprise_goal_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage of spend in this category to be directed to certified minority-owned businesses to support supplier diversity objectives.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to procurement in this category.

attributes.name: nsf_certification_required_flag

attributes.name: preferred_sourcing_strategy
attributes.description: Recommended procurement approach for this category based on market dynamics, risk profile, and spend characteristics.

attributes.name: procurement_category_status

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code

attributes.name: quality_certification_required
attributes.description: Industry or regulatory quality certifications required for suppliers in this category, such as ISO 9001, NSF/ANSI 60/61 for water treatment chemicals, or AWWA standards.

attributes.name: responsible_buyer_email

attributes.name: responsible_buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement specialist or buyer responsible for managing vendor relationships and purchase orders for this category.

attributes.name: spend_visibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category is included in executive spend analytics dashboards and strategic sourcing reviews.

attributes.name: standard_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Default unit of measure for procurement and inventory tracking of items in this category (e.g., EA, LB, GAL, FT, TON).

attributes.name: strategic_category_flag

products.name: project_vendor_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual engagement between a vendor and a CIP project. It captures the specific role, contract terms, performance, and financial details for each vendor participating in a capital improvement project. Each record links one vendor to one CIP project with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific engagement, such as contract value, dates, performance ratings, and the vendor's role (general contractor, design engineer, materials supplier, testing lab, specialty consultant).. Existence Justification: In water utility capital improvement programs, CIP projects engage multiple vendors simultaneously in different roles (general contractor, design engineer, materials suppliers, testing labs, specialty consultants), and each vendor typically works on multiple projects concurrently across the utility's CIP portfolio. The utility actively manages these engagements as distinct business entities, tracking contract-specific data such as awarded value, performance ratings, role assignments, and contract dates for each vendor-project combination.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: project_vendor_engagement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this project-vendor engagement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Project Vendor Engagement - Cip Project Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the CIP project master record

tag_set.value: Project Vendor Engagement - Cip Project Id

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vendor master record in the supply domain

attributes.name: actual_amount_paid
attributes.description: Cumulative actual payments made to this vendor for work on this project. Used to track contract spend against awarded value.

attributes.name: change_order_count
attributes.description: Number of change orders issued to this vendor for this project. Indicator of scope changes and contract modifications.

attributes.name: contract_award_date
attributes.description: Date the construction contract was awarded to the general contractor. Marks the formal start of the construction procurement phase. [Moved from cip_project: This attribute on the CIP project appears to reference a single contract award date, but projects have multiple contracts with different vendors awarded at different times. Each vendor engagement has its own contract_start_date. This project-level attribute is ambiguous when multiple vendors are involved.]

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The date this vendor's contract or engagement ended (or is planned to end) for this specific project. Identified in detection reasoning as relationship data.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The date this vendor's contract or engagement began for this specific project. Identified in detection reasoning as relationship data.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current status of this vendor's contract for this project. Tracks the lifecycle of the engagement from award through completion or termination.

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: The total awarded contract value for this vendor's engagement on this project. Identified in detection reasoning as relationship data. Represents the financial commitment for this specific vendor-project combination.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this engagement record was created in the system.

attributes.name: design_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the engineering or architectural firm contracted to provide design services for the project. Null if design is performed in-house. [Moved from cip_project: This attribute currently stores a single design firm name on the CIP project, but in reality multiple vendors can serve in design roles (architectural, civil, electrical, environmental). This should be captured as vendor engagements with role_type='design_engineer' rather than a single text field on the project.]

attributes.name: general_contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the general contractor or construction manager awarded the construction contract. Null if project has not reached construction phase or is performed by utility forces. [Moved from cip_project: This attribute currently stores a single general contractor name on the CIP project, but this is actually a vendor engagement relationship. The general contractor is a vendor with role_type='general_contractor'. Storing the name redundantly on the project creates data integrity issues when the same information exists in the vendor master.]

attributes.name: insurance_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether required insurance certificates (general liability, workers comp, professional liability) have been verified for this vendor on this project.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this engagement record.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this engagement record.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Performance evaluation rating for this vendor's work on this specific project. Identified in detection reasoning as relationship data. Used for future vendor selection and contract award decisions.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order or contract number issued to this vendor for this project. Links to procurement and accounts payable systems.

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: The specific role this vendor plays in the CIP project. Identified in detection reasoning as relationship data. Examples: general_contractor, design_engineer, specialty_subcontractor, materials_supplier, testing_lab, environmental_consultant.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this engagement record.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Enterprise financial management including general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, cost center accounting, capital and operating budgets, financial reporting, rate case preparation, GASB compliance, grant management, debt service tracking, and financial planning and analysis. Integrates with SAP FI/CO and Tyler Munis for fund accounting and municipal financial statements.
domains.references: SAP FI/CO, GASB standards, Tyler Munis, GAAP

products.name: general_ledger
products.description: Chart of accounts and general ledger account master for the water utility, defining all GL accounts used in fund accounting. Captures account code, account name, account type (asset, liability, net position, revenue, expense), GASB account category, fund assignment rules, normal balance indicator, account hierarchy/rollup structure, active/inactive status, and SAP FI/Tyler Munis account mapping. Serves as the single source of truth for all financial posting targets across AP, AR, payroll, and asset accounting.
products.reference: GASB Chart of Accounts / SAP FI General Ledger

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: GL accounts may be associated with cost centers. The cost_center_code STRING should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: GL accounts are associated with funds in municipal accounting. The fund_code STRING should be replaced with FK to fund.fund_id.

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code identifying the general ledger account in the chart of accounts. Typically follows a hierarchical structure (e.g., 1000-5000 for assets, 6000-8000 for revenues).

attributes.name: account_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the purpose and usage of the general ledger account, including what types of transactions should be posted to this account.

attributes.name: account_level
attributes.description: The level of the account in the chart of accounts hierarchy (e.g., 1 for top-level summary accounts, 2 for sub-accounts, 3 for detail accounts). Used for financial statement roll-ups and drill-down reporting.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the general ledger account (e.g., 'Water Revenue - Residential', 'Wastewater Treatment Operating Expense').

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the general ledger account. Active accounts accept postings, inactive accounts are temporarily disabled, blocked accounts prevent new postings but retain history, and closed accounts are permanently retired.

attributes.name: account_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification within the account type (e.g., 'Current Asset', 'Fixed Asset', 'Operating Revenue', 'Non-Operating Revenue', 'Operating Expense', 'Capital Expense'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: current_asset|fixed_asset|intangible_asset|current_liability|long_term_liability|net_position|operating_revenue|non_operating_revenue|capital_contribution|operating_expense|capital_expense|debt_service — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the account: asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense. Determines normal balance (debit or credit) and financial statement placement.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: The date when this general ledger account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this account (e.g., 'USD' for United States Dollar). Most water utilities operate in a single currency, but multi-national utilities may maintain accounts in multiple currencies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this general ledger account was closed or became inactive. Null for currently active accounts. Used for temporal validity and historical chart of accounts tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this general ledger account became active and available for transaction postings. Used for temporal validity and historical chart of accounts tracking.

attributes.name: external_reporting_code
attributes.description: The standardized account code used for external regulatory reporting to EPA, state agencies, AWWA benchmarking, or other regulatory bodies. May differ from internal account codes.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - Financial Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: The classification of the fund per GASB standards. Water utilities primarily operate as enterprise funds (self-supporting through user charges) but may maintain other fund types for capital projects, debt service, or restricted grants.

attributes.name: gasb_category
attributes.description: The GASB financial statement category for reporting purposes (e.g., 'Net Investment in Capital Assets', 'Restricted for Debt Service', 'Unrestricted Net Position', 'Operating Revenue', 'Non-Operating Revenue'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_investment_capital_assets|restricted_debt_service|restricted_capital_projects|restricted_other|unrestricted_net_position|operating_revenue|non_operating_revenue|operating_expense|non_operating_expense|capital_contributions|transfers — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GASB 34 - Statement of Net Position and Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position

attributes.name: is_budget_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to budget controls and variance monitoring (True). Typically applies to operating expense accounts and capital project accounts where budget compliance is mandatory.

attributes.name: is_capital_expenditure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used to track capital expenditures (CAPEX) that will be capitalized and depreciated (True) versus operating expenditures (OPEX) that are expensed immediately (False).

attributes.name: is_grant_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses posted to this account are eligible for grant reimbursement or cost allocation to grant-funded projects (True). Used for grant management and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - Grant Compliance

attributes.name: is_operating_expenditure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used to track operating expenditures (OPEX) that are expensed in the current period (True) versus capital expenditures (CAPEX) that are capitalized (False).

attributes.name: is_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct transaction postings are allowed to this account (True) or if it is a summary-only account (False). Summary accounts typically block direct postings to ensure data integrity.

attributes.name: is_rate_case_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs in this account are eligible for inclusion in rate case filings and cost-of-service calculations for regulatory rate-setting (True). Critical for Public Utilities Commission (PUC) rate proceedings.
attributes.references: Public Utilities Commission (PUC) - Rate Case Filing Requirements

attributes.name: is_reconciliation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires periodic reconciliation to external records or sub-ledgers (True). Typically applies to balance sheet accounts such as cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and fixed assets.

attributes.name: is_summary_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is a summary/parent account (True) that aggregates child accounts or a detail/leaf account (False) that receives direct transaction postings. Summary accounts typically do not allow direct postings.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this general ledger account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: GASB 34 - Internal Controls and Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The date when this general ledger account record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: The normal balance side for this account type: debit for assets and expenses, credit for liabilities, equity, and revenues. Determines how increases and decreases are recorded.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special instructions, or clarifications about the use and purpose of this general ledger account. Used for internal documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center identifier for internal management reporting and profitability analysis. Used to segment financial performance by business line (e.g., 'WATER-RES' for residential water, 'WATER-IND' for industrial water, 'WASTEWATER' for wastewater services).

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: The SAP ERP company code that owns this general ledger account. Company code is the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for external reporting purposes.

attributes.name: statistical_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical account (True) used to track non-monetary metrics (e.g., gallons treated, customer count, work orders completed) versus a financial account (False) that tracks monetary values.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code or tax category applicable to transactions posted to this account. Used for sales tax, use tax, and other tax compliance reporting. May be null for non-taxable accounts.

attributes.name: tyler_munis_account_code
attributes.description: The corresponding account identifier in Tyler Technologies Munis system for municipalities that use Munis for financial and utility billing. Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration.
attributes.references: Tyler Technologies Munis - Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for statistical accounts (e.g., 'MGD' for Million Gallons per Day, 'EA' for Each, 'KWH' for Kilowatt Hours). Null for financial accounts that track monetary values only.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) - Standard Units

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this general ledger account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: GASB 34 - Internal Controls and Audit Trail

products.name: fund

attributes.name: fund_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: appropriation_authority
attributes.description: The legal or governing body that authorized the creation and appropriation of this fund (e.g., City Council, Board of Directors, State Legislature). Identifies the source of budgetary authority.

attributes.name: appropriation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appropriation authority formally approved the fund and its budget.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 2200 - Budgetary Accounting and Reporting

attributes.name: balance_policy
attributes.description: Description of the utility's policy governing the minimum and maximum fund balance levels, reserve requirements, and conditions under which fund balance may be used. Critical for financial planning and rate case preparation.

attributes.name: capital_project_name

attributes.name: closed_date

attributes.name: fund_code

attributes.name: component_unit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund belongs to a component unit (a legally separate organization for which the primary government is financially accountable). True if component unit; False if primary government.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Data Governance and Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: debt_service_bond_issue
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the bond issue if this fund is a debt service fund established to repay specific bonds (e.g., 2020 Water Revenue Bonds). Null if not a debt service fund.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the department or division responsible for managing this fund (e.g., WATER, WWTR for wastewater, FIN for finance). Used for organizational reporting and accountability.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fund was officially established and began operations.

attributes.name: external_audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund is subject to external audit requirements (e.g., Single Audit Act for federal grants, bond covenant audits). True if required; False otherwise.
attributes.references: Single Audit Act; GASB Statement 34 - Audit Requirements

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this fund record applies, expressed as a four-digit year (e.g., 2024). Water utilities typically follow calendar year or July-June fiscal cycles.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the fiscal year for this fund (e.g., 2024-12-31 for calendar year or 2025-06-30 for July start).

attributes.name: fiscal_year_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the fiscal year for this fund (e.g., 2024-01-01 for calendar year or 2024-07-01 for July start).

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the fund. Active funds are in use; inactive funds are dormant but may be reactivated; closed funds are permanently closed; suspended funds are temporarily halted pending review or restructuring.

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fund based on its purpose and accounting treatment. Enterprise funds are used for business-type activities; capital projects for major construction; debt service for bond repayment; special revenue for restricted purposes; general for unrestricted operations; internal service for inter-departmental services.

attributes.name: gasb_fund_classification

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_prefix

attributes.name: grant_award_number

attributes.name: grant_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the grant program if this fund is associated with a specific federal, state, or local grant (e.g., EPA Clean Water State Revolving Fund, USDA Rural Development Grant). Null if not grant-funded.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section G60 - Grants and Entitlements

attributes.name: interfund_transfer_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transfers between this fund and other funds are permitted under the utility's financial policies and legal restrictions. True if allowed; False if restricted.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund record was last updated in the system.
attributes.references: Data Governance and Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the fund manager for official correspondence and reporting inquiries.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual responsible for managing and overseeing this fund (e.g., Finance Director, Capital Projects Manager). Used for accountability and contact purposes.

attributes.name: minimum_fund_balance_amount
attributes.description: The minimum fund balance amount (in USD) that must be maintained per the fund balance policy. Used to ensure liquidity and financial stability.

attributes.name: minimum_fund_balance_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum fund balance expressed as a percentage of annual operating expenditures or revenues, per the fund balance policy (e.g., 15.00 for 15%).

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the fund (e.g., Water Enterprise Fund, Wastewater Enterprise Fund, Capital Projects Fund, Debt Service Fund).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the fund (e.g., unique accounting treatments, historical context, pending policy changes).

attributes.name: rate_case_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund's financial data is included in rate case filings and cost-of-service studies submitted to the Public Utilities Commission. True if included; False otherwise.
attributes.references: Public Utilities Commission Rate Case Filing Requirements

attributes.name: reporting_entity
attributes.description: Name of the legal or organizational entity that reports this fund in its financial statements (e.g., City of Springfield Water Department, Regional Water Authority). Used for consolidation and component unit reporting.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 14 - The Financial Reporting Entity

attributes.name: restricted_purpose
attributes.description: Description of any legal or contractual restrictions on the use of fund resources (e.g., bond covenants, grant conditions, regulatory mandates). Null if the fund is unrestricted.

attributes.name: cost_element_group

attributes.name: department_code

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: General ledger journal entry document capturing all financial postings in the water utility's books, including both header metadata and individual debit/credit line items. Header captures journal type (standard, adjusting, closing, reversing), posting date, accounting period, fiscal year, originating module, document number, posting user, approval status, and narrative. Each line item records GL account, fund, cost center, WBS element, functional area, debit/credit indicator, amount in transaction and functional currency, tax code, and line text. Supports full double-entry bookkeeping, GASB fund-level reporting, and integration with SAP FI and Tyler Munis posting documents.
