products.name: milestone
products.description: Scheduled and actual milestone events within a CIP project lifecycle including design completion, permit issuance, notice to proceed (NTP), substantial completion, final completion, and asset handover. Tracks milestone type, baseline date, forecast date, actual date, responsible party, completion status, and any variance commentary. Used for schedule performance reporting and regulatory deadline tracking (e.g., consent order milestones).
products.reference: Project Schedule Milestone — SAP PS Network Activity / MS Project

attributes.name: milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project milestone record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent CIP project to which this milestone belongs. Links milestone to the overall infrastructure expansion, rehabilitation, or renewal project.

attributes.name: primary_predecessor_milestone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preceding milestone that must be completed before this milestone can begin. Used for schedule dependency tracking. Null if no predecessor.

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Specific criteria or conditions that must be met for the milestone to be considered complete and accepted. Used for quality control and stakeholder sign-off.

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the milestone was achieved or completed. Null if milestone is not yet completed. Used for schedule performance measurement.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role who approved the milestone completion. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the milestone completion was formally approved. Null if not yet approved. Used for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Original planned date for milestone completion as established in the approved project baseline schedule. Used as the reference point for schedule variance analysis.

attributes.name: budget_impact_amount
attributes.description: Financial impact or cost associated with achieving this milestone, expressed in US dollars. May include design fees, permit costs, contractor payments, or other milestone-specific expenditures.

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of work completed toward achieving this milestone, expressed as a decimal (0.00 to 100.00). Used for progress tracking and earned value analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this milestone record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: deliverable_description
attributes.description: Description of the tangible deliverable or outcome associated with this milestone (e.g., signed design drawings, issued permit, executed contract, commissioned asset). Defines what constitutes milestone completion.

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: Current projected date for milestone completion based on latest schedule updates and progress assessments. May differ from baseline due to delays or accelerations.

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this milestone is on the project critical path. True if any delay to this milestone will delay the overall project completion; false otherwise.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_milestone
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this milestone is tied to a regulatory requirement or consent order deadline (e.g., EPA consent decree, state compliance order). True if regulatory; false otherwise.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Consent Decrees

attributes.name: milestone_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or sequence number for the milestone within the project (e.g., M-001, M-002). Used for external reporting and communication.

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the milestone. Indicates whether the milestone is planned, in progress, completed, delayed, cancelled, or on hold.

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Category of milestone within the project lifecycle. Classifies the phase or functional area of the milestone event.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this milestone record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the milestone event (e.g., Design Completion, Permit Issuance, Notice to Proceed, Substantial Completion, Final Completion, Asset Handover).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context related to the milestone. May include lessons learned, stakeholder feedback, or other relevant information for project team reference.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or citation for the regulatory requirement or consent order associated with this milestone (e.g., consent decree docket number, permit condition reference). Null if not a regulatory milestone.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Consent Decrees

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the party responsible for achieving this milestone (e.g., design consultant, contractor, utility staff, regulatory agency). May be individual or organization.

attributes.name: responsible_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the responsible party. Indicates whether the party is internal utility staff, external contractor, consultant, vendor, or regulatory agency.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the risk level associated with achieving this milestone on schedule. Considers factors such as complexity, dependencies, resource availability, and external constraints.

attributes.name: variance_commentary
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of any schedule variance, including root causes of delays or early completions, corrective actions taken, and impact on downstream milestones. Used for project status reporting.

attributes.name: variance_days
attributes.description: Number of days between baseline date and actual or forecast date. Positive values indicate delay; negative values indicate early completion. Used for schedule performance reporting.

products.name: project_budget
products.description: Authorized budget record for a CIP project or WBS element capturing total project appropriation, budget by phase (planning, design, construction, contingency, inspection), CAPEX vs OPEX split, funding source allocations, budget revision history, and current approved budget. Tracks original budget, approved amendments, current budget, encumbrances, actual expenditures, and remaining budget. Integrates with SAP FI/CO for financial control and Tyler Munis for municipal budget appropriation.
products.reference: SAP PS Project Budget (BPGE/BPJA) / CIP Appropriation

attributes.name: project_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project budget record. Primary key for the project budget entity.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project or capital project for which this budget is authorized.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Project budgets allocate to cost centers for overhead allocation, departmental accountability, and indirect cost recovery calculations required for rate-making and grant compliance.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Project budgets must tie to specific utility funds for GASB fund accounting compliance, rate case documentation, and fund balance management. Essential for governmental accounting standards.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Project budgets map to GL accounts for financial reporting, budget-to-actual variance analysis, and GASB capital asset classification. Critical for financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: actual_expenditure_amount
attributes.description: Total actual expenditures posted to this budget to date. Sum of all invoices, payments, and costs charged against this project budget.

attributes.name: appropriation_ordinance_number
attributes.description: Municipal ordinance or resolution number that legally authorized this budget appropriation. Required for public sector utilities subject to legislative budget approval.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this budget was formally approved by the governing authority such as the utility board, city council, or public utilities commission.

attributes.name: approved_amendments_amount
attributes.description: Total cumulative amount of approved budget amendments, change orders, and supplemental appropriations that have been added to or subtracted from the original budget.

attributes.name: bond_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the budget funded by municipal bonds, revenue bonds, or general obligation bonds issued to finance capital improvements.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level budget category classification such as treatment plant upgrades, distribution system expansion, wastewater collection rehabilitation, or meter replacement program.
attributes.references: AWWA M1 Principles of Water Rates

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget record indicating approval state and whether the budget is active for expenditure tracking.

attributes.name: capex_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the budget classified as capital expenditure (CAPEX) that will be capitalized as a fixed asset. Represents investment in long-term infrastructure assets.

attributes.name: contingency_amount
attributes.description: Budget amount set aside as contingency reserve for unforeseen costs, scope changes, or risk mitigation. Typically a percentage of the base construction budget.
attributes.references: AWWA M1 Principles of Water Rates

attributes.name: contingency_percentage
attributes.description: Contingency reserve expressed as a percentage of the base project budget. Common practice is 10-20% for water utility CIP projects depending on project complexity and risk.
attributes.references: AWWA M1 Principles of Water Rates

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and budget lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget record. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: current_approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Current total authorized budget amount including original budget plus all approved amendments. This is the active budget ceiling for expenditure control.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this budget becomes effective and available for expenditure authorization. May differ from approval date due to fiscal year or appropriation timing.

attributes.name: encumbered_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of budget that has been encumbered through purchase orders, contracts, or commitments but not yet expended. Represents committed but unspent funds.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this budget authorization expires if not fully expended or encumbered. Multi-year CIP budgets may have extended expiration dates.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which this budget is authorized, typically a four-digit year (e.g., 2024). Aligns with municipal or utility fiscal calendar.

attributes.name: funding_source_primary
attributes.description: Primary funding source for this budget allocation such as revenue bonds, general obligation bonds, grants, rate revenue, developer contributions, or state revolving fund loans.

attributes.name: funding_source_secondary
attributes.description: Secondary or supplemental funding source if the project budget is financed from multiple sources. Supports blended financing structures common in large CIP projects.

attributes.name: grant_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the budget funded by federal, state, or local grants such as EPA Water Infrastructure Finance and Innovation Act (WIFIA) or state drinking water revolving fund grants.

attributes.name: is_multi_year_budget
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this budget spans multiple fiscal years. True for large CIP projects with multi-year appropriations; false for single-year budgets.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was last updated or modified. Tracks most recent change to budget amounts, status, or attributes.

attributes.name: last_revision_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent budget revision, amendment, or change order that modified the approved budget amount or allocation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting budget assumptions, constraints, special conditions, or explanations for amendments and revisions. Supports audit trail and budget justification.

attributes.name: opex_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the budget classified as operating expenditure (OPEX) that will be expensed in the current period. Represents operational costs not capitalized.

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: Initial authorized budget amount at the time of project appropriation or budget approval. Baseline budget before any amendments or revisions.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the project manager, department head, or budget owner responsible for managing expenditures against this budget allocation.

attributes.name: phase
attributes.description: Project phase to which this budget allocation applies. CIP projects typically have budgets segmented by planning, design, construction, contingency, and inspection phases.
attributes.references: AWWA M1 Principles of Water Rates

attributes.name: rate_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the budget funded directly from water and wastewater rate revenue collected from customers. Pay-as-you-go financing from operating cash flow.
attributes.references: AWWA M1 Principles of Water Rates

attributes.name: remaining_budget_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unencumbered and unexpended budget available for future commitments. Calculated as current approved budget minus encumbrances minus actual expenditures.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number tracking the count of budget amendments or changes. Starts at 0 for original budget and increments with each approved revision.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version type of the budget record indicating whether this is the original appropriation, a revised budget after amendments, or the current approved budget.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure element code from SAP PS representing the project phase or deliverable to which this budget applies. Hierarchical project structure identifier.

products.name: budget_amendment
products.description: Formal record of an approved change to a project budget appropriation including amendment number, reason code (scope change, contingency draw, emergency authorization), amount delta (increase or decrease), approval authority, approval date, and resulting revised budget total. Maintains a complete audit trail of all budget modifications from original appropriation through project closeout. Supports board/commission approval workflows for amendments exceeding threshold amounts.
products.reference: Budget Transfer / Supplemental Appropriation — SAP PS Budget Supplement

attributes.name: budget_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget amendment record. Primary key for the budget amendment entity.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CIP project for which this budget amendment applies. Links the amendment to the parent capital project.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budget amendments adjust cost center budgets and require cost center manager approval for budget reallocation. Essential for departmental budget control.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Budget amendments adjust fund appropriations and require fund manager approval. Critical for fund balance management and compliance with appropriation ordinances.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Budget amendments adjust GL account budgets for financial planning and control. Required for budget-to-actual reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: amendment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar value of the budget change. Positive values indicate budget increases; negative values indicate budget decreases or deobligations.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential or coded identifier for this amendment within the project lifecycle. Used for tracking and referencing specific budget modifications.

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current state of the amendment in the approval workflow. Tracks progression from draft through final approval or rejection. attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the amendment based on the nature of the budget change. Indicates whether the amendment is due to scope changes, contingency usage, emergency needs, cost overruns, schedule adjustments, or funding reallocations.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The governance level or role authorized to approve this amendment. Indicates whether board/commission approval was required or if the amendment was within delegated authority thresholds.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the budget amendment received final approval from the designated authority. Establishes the effective date for the revised budget.

attributes.name: approval_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The dollar threshold that determines the required approval authority level for this amendment. Amendments exceeding this threshold require higher-level governance approval.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or governance body that granted final approval for the amendment. Documents authorization in the approval workflow.

attributes.name: audit_trail_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional audit and compliance notes related to the amendment. Supports regulatory reporting and internal controls documentation.

attributes.name: board_resolution_number
attributes.description: Official resolution or ordinance number issued by the governing board or commission authorizing the amendment. Required for amendments exceeding delegated authority thresholds.

attributes.name: contingency_amount_used
attributes.description: The dollar amount of project contingency reserve consumed by this amendment. Tracks depletion of risk mitigation funds.

attributes.name: contingency_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment draws from or affects the project contingency reserve. True if contingency funds are utilized; false otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget amendment record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record inception.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this amendment record. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the amended budget is in force and governs project financial management. May differ from approval date based on governance rules.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget amendment record was most recently updated. Tracks the latest change to the record for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: meeting_date
attributes.description: The date of the board or commission meeting at which the amendment was presented and approved. Provides governance audit trail.

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The project budget amount prior to this amendment. Provides baseline for calculating the revised budget and tracking cumulative changes.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific reason for the budget amendment. Used for categorization, reporting, and trend analysis of budget modifications.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the business justification and circumstances necessitating the budget amendment. Provides context for audit and governance review.

attributes.name: remaining_contingency
attributes.description: The balance of contingency funds available after this amendment. Provides visibility into remaining risk buffer for the project.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The date on which the budget amendment was formally requested. Marks the initiation of the amendment approval workflow.

attributes.name: requested_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role who initiated the budget amendment request. Provides accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: The resulting total project budget after applying this amendment. Calculated as original budget plus amendment amount.

attributes.name: schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days by which the project schedule is extended or compressed as a result of this amendment. Positive values indicate delays; negative values indicate acceleration.

attributes.name: scope_change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any project scope modifications associated with this budget amendment. Documents changes to deliverables, specifications, or project boundaries.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to supporting documentation for the amendment, such as cost estimates, change orders, engineering reports, or board memos.

products.name: design_contract

Distinct from construction contracts — design contracts follow a professional services procurement workflow.

attributes.name: cip_project_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: fund_id

attributes.name: pressure_zone_id

attributes.name: source_primary_design_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the professional engineering firm or consultant providing design services under this contract. Links to the vendor or party master record.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Design contracts must incorporate specific regulatory standards (Ten States Standards, EPA design criteria, state-specific requirements). Engineers reference requirements during design review and subm

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which all design services were completed and final deliverables were accepted by the utility. Used to measure schedule performance.

attributes.name: amendment_value

attributes.name: construction_administration_included
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the design contract includes construction administration (CA) services during the build phase. CA services typically include shop drawing review, site visits, request for information (RFI) responses, and substantial completion certification.

attributes.name: contract_duration_days

attributes.name: design_standard_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the primary design standards and codes governing the engineering work. Typically includes AWWA standards, Ten States Standards (for water and wastewater), state-specific design manuals, and local utility design criteria.
attributes.references: AWWA Design Standards, Ten States Standards, State Design Manuals

attributes.name: disadvantaged_business_enterprise_participation
attributes.description: Percentage of contract value committed to disadvantaged business enterprise (DBE) or minority/women-owned business enterprise (M/WBE) participation. Required for federally-funded projects to meet EPA and USDA diversity goals.
attributes.references: EPA DBE Requirements, USDA Civil Rights Compliance

attributes.name: engineering_firm_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the engineering firm or consultant providing design services. Captured for reporting and audit purposes.

attributes.name: environmental_review_status
attributes.description: Status of environmental review and compliance documentation required for the project. May include National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) review, State Environmental Quality Review Act (SEQRA), or equivalent state-level environmental assessment.
attributes.references: NEPA (42 U.S.C. 4321 et seq.), State Environmental Review Requirements

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the design services contract was fully executed (signed by all parties). Establishes the legal effective date of the agreement.

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: Identifier for any federal or state grant funding supporting this design contract. Used for compliance tracking and reporting to funding agencies such as EPA, USDA, or state environmental agencies.
attributes.references: EPA Grant Compliance Requirements, USDA Rural Development Guidelines

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_received
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the engineering firm has provided required professional liability insurance and general liability insurance certificates. Required before notice to proceed can be issued.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the engineering firm's professional liability insurance policy. Monitored to ensure continuous coverage throughout the contract period.

attributes.name: invoiced_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative amount in US dollars invoiced by the engineering firm to date. Used to track contract spend and remaining budget.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this design contract record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the design contract. May include lessons learned, performance observations, or administrative notes.

attributes.name: notice_to_proceed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the utility issued formal notice to proceed (NTP) authorizing the engineering firm to begin design work. Triggers contract performance period and milestone schedule.

attributes.name: original_contract_value
attributes.description: Initial total contract value in US dollars as executed at contract award, before any amendments or change orders. Represents the baseline budget for design services.

attributes.name: paid_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative amount in US dollars paid to the engineering firm to date. May differ from invoiced amount due to payment processing lag or retainage.

attributes.name: performance_bond_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a performance bond is required for this design services contract. Typically not required for professional services but may be mandated for high-value or high-risk projects.

attributes.name: permit_support_included
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the design contract includes services for preparing and submitting regulatory permit applications. Common permits include NPDES discharge permits, Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) construction permits, wetland permits, and local building permits.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES Permit Requirements, SDWA Construction Permit Guidelines

attributes.name: procurement_method
attributes.description: Method used to select and award the design services contract. Qualifications-based selection (QBS) is the standard for professional engineering services per Brooks Act; competitive sealed proposals may be used for design-build; sole source for unique expertise; emergency for urgent needs; cooperative purchasing leverages existing contracts.
attributes.references: Brooks Act (40 U.S.C. 1101-1104), AWWA Procurement Standards

attributes.name: quality_assurance_review_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether an independent quality assurance (QA) or quality control (QC) review of design documents is required. Often mandated for large or complex projects, or when using federal funding.
attributes.references: EPA Quality Assurance Requirements, AWWA Design Standards

attributes.name: retainage_amount
attributes.description: Amount in US dollars withheld from payments as retainage to ensure contract performance and deliverable quality. Typically released upon final acceptance of design documents.

attributes.name: retainage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of each invoice withheld as retainage. Common values are 5% or 10% for professional services contracts.

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date
attributes.description: Contractually scheduled date for completion of all design services and delivery of final deliverables. Baseline date established at contract execution.

attributes.name: scope_of_services
attributes.description: Detailed description of the engineering and design services to be provided under this contract. Typically includes phases such as preliminary engineering report (PER), conceptual design, detailed design, construction documents, permitting support, bidding assistance, and construction administration.

attributes.name: subconsultant_list
attributes.description: List of subconsultants and specialty firms engaged by the prime engineering firm to support design services. May include geotechnical engineers, environmental consultants, surveying firms, and other specialists.

products.name: construction_contract
products.description: Construction contract record for a CIP project covering agreements with general contractors and specialty subcontractors for infrastructure construction, rehabilitation, or renewal work. Tracks contract number, contractor, contract type (lump sum, unit price, GMP), bid amount, awarded contract value, current contract value (including change orders), retainage percentage, bonding and insurance requirements, NTP date, substantial completion date, final completion date, and liquidated damages provisions. Manages the full construction procurement lifecycle from bid advertisement through final payment.
products.reference: Construction Contract — AIA A101/A102 / EJCDC C-520

attributes.name: construction_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the construction contract record. Primary key for the construction contract entity.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent CIP project for which this construction contract was awarded. Links the contract to the broader capital project scope.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_permit. Business justification: Construction contracts must comply with permit conditions (NPDES discharge limits during construction, erosion control, stormwater management). Contract administrators track permit compliance and ensu

attributes.name: primary_construction_contractor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general contractor or prime contractor awarded this construction contract. Links to the vendor/contractor master record.

attributes.name: primary_construction_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility employee serving as project manager responsible for contract administration, progress monitoring, and contractor coordination.

attributes.name: secondary_construction_project_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility employee serving as project manager responsible for contract administration, progress monitoring, and contractor coordination.

attributes.name: secondary_construction_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general contractor or prime contractor awarded this construction contract. Links to the vendor/contractor master record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Construction contracts charge to cost centers for project cost allocation and overhead recovery. Essential for full-cost accounting and departmental performance measurement.

attributes.name: dma_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.dma. Business justification: DMA-specific construction (meter installations, valve replacements, main rehabilitation) requires DMA attribution for NRW program tracking, performance measurement, and before/after leakage comparison

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Construction contracts are funded from specific utility funds and require multi-year fund commitment tracking for appropriation control and cash flow planning.

attributes.name: pressure_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pressure_zone. Business justification: Construction contracts for zone-specific infrastructure need pressure zone attribution for operations coordination, isolation planning, SCADA integration, and hydraulic model updates during constructi

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_territory. Business justification: Construction contracts are executed within specific service territories for permitting, prevailing wage compliance (varies by jurisdiction), and asset handover to the correct operations district. Cont

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date the construction contract was officially awarded to the contractor by the utility's governing authority (board, commission, or management).

attributes.name: awarded_contract_value
attributes.description: Contract value at the time of award, after any bid negotiations or adjustments. This is the baseline contract amount before any change orders.

attributes.name: bid_advertisement_date
attributes.description: Date the construction contract opportunity was publicly advertised for competitive bidding. Marks the start of the procurement process.

attributes.name: bid_amount
attributes.description: Original bid amount submitted by the contractor during the competitive bidding process, before any negotiations or adjustments. Represents the contractor's initial price proposal.

attributes.name: bid_opening_date
attributes.description: Date when sealed bids were publicly opened and read. Establishes the official bid prices for evaluation.

attributes.name: change_order_count
attributes.description: Total number of change orders issued against this construction contract. Indicates scope volatility and contract management complexity.

attributes.name: contract_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the construction scope of work, including infrastructure type (water main, wastewater treatment, pump station), work type (new construction, rehabilitation, replacement), and key deliverables.

attributes.name: contract_duration_days
attributes.description: Original contract duration in calendar days from NTP to substantial completion. Used to calculate original completion date and assess schedule performance.

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the construction contract, typically reflecting the scope of work (e.g., 'Main Street Water Main Replacement', 'WWTP Clarifier Rehabilitation').

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique contract identifier assigned by the utility for procurement tracking and reference. Used in all contract documentation, invoices, and correspondence.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the construction contract. Tracks progression from bid advertisement through contract closeout and final payment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|advertised|bid_received|awarded|executed|active|substantially_complete|final_complete|closed — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of construction contract pricing structure. Lump sum = fixed price for entire scope; unit price = payment per measured unit of work; GMP = guaranteed maximum price with cost sharing; cost plus = reimbursable costs plus fee; time and materials = hourly labor plus materials.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Procurement Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this construction contract record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this contract. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: current_completion_date
attributes.description: Current contractual deadline for substantial completion, adjusted for any approved time extensions due to change orders, weather delays, or other contract modifications.

attributes.name: current_contract_value
attributes.description: Current total contract value including all approved change orders and amendments. Represents the up-to-date financial commitment for the construction work.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date the construction contract was fully executed (signed by both parties). Establishes the legally binding agreement.

attributes.name: final_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date all contract work including punch list items was completed and accepted by the utility. Triggers final payment and contract closeout.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Contract Administration Standards

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractor has provided proof of required insurance coverage (general liability, workers compensation, auto liability) per contract requirements.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this construction contract record was last updated. Tracks most recent change for audit and synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_assessed
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of liquidated damages assessed against the contractor for late completion. Calculated as days late multiplied by daily rate.

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_rate
attributes.description: Daily dollar amount of liquidated damages assessed for each calendar day the contractor fails to achieve substantial completion by the contract deadline. Pre-agreed damages for delay, not a penalty.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Contract Administration Standards

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: Date the utility issued the Notice to Proceed authorizing the contractor to begin construction work. Starts the contract time clock for completion deadlines.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Contract Administration Standards

attributes.name: original_completion_date
attributes.description: Original contractual deadline for substantial completion of the work, calculated from NTP date plus contract duration. Baseline for schedule performance tracking.

attributes.name: payment_bond_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the payment bond, typically 100% of the contract value. Ensures subcontractors and material suppliers are paid.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Procurement Standards

attributes.name: payment_bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a payment bond (labor and material bond) is required to protect subcontractors and suppliers from non-payment by the general contractor.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Procurement Standards

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Current percentage of contract work completed based on earned value or physical progress assessment. Used for progress reporting and payment calculations.

attributes.name: performance_bond_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the performance bond, typically 100% of the contract value. Provides financial protection if contractor fails to complete the work.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Procurement Standards

attributes.name: performance_bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a performance bond is required from the contractor to guarantee completion of the work per contract terms. Typically required for contracts above a threshold amount.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Procurement Standards

attributes.name: retainage_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount currently held in retainage. Calculated as cumulative payments multiplied by retainage percentage, less any retainage released.

attributes.name: retainage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of each progress payment withheld by the utility until substantial or final completion to ensure contractor performance and warranty obligations. Typical range 5-10%.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Contract Administration Standards

attributes.name: substantial_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date the work reached substantial completion, meaning the facility can be used for its intended purpose despite minor punch list items remaining. Triggers warranty period start and retainage release milestones.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Contract Administration Standards

attributes.name: time_extensions_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days of approved time extensions granted through change orders or contract modifications. Adjusts the completion deadline.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Contract Administration Standards

attributes.name: total_change_order_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar value of all approved change orders (positive and negative). Represents the net change from awarded contract value to current contract value.

attributes.name: total_paid_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative amount paid to the contractor through all progress payments and partial payments, excluding retainage. Used to track payment status and remaining contract balance.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the contractor's warranty period expires. Calculated as substantial completion date plus warranty period months. After this date, the utility assumes full maintenance responsibility.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Contract Administration Standards

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of the contractor's warranty period for workmanship and materials, starting from substantial completion date. Typical range 12-24 months for water utility construction.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Contract Administration Standards

products.name: change_order
products.description: Formal change order record documenting approved modifications to a construction or design contract including scope additions, deletions, or substitutions, time extensions, and associated cost adjustments. Tracks change order number, originating contract, change order type (owner-directed, differing site conditions, design error, unforeseen conditions), description of change, cost impact (add/deduct), schedule impact (days), approval status, approval authority, and execution date. Maintains running total of all change orders against original contract value for cost control reporting.
products.reference: Change Order — AIA G701 / EJCDC C-941

attributes.name: change_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the change order record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_change_contractor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contractor or vendor responsible for executing the work described in the change order.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions of the Contract for Construction

attributes.name: primary_change_design_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the engineering firm or design professional who reviewed or prepared technical specifications for the change order, if applicable.

attributes.name: secondary_change_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the engineering firm or design professional who reviewed or prepared technical specifications for the change order, if applicable.

attributes.name: secondary_change_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contractor or vendor responsible for executing the work described in the change order.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions of the Contract for Construction

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent CIP project under which this change order is issued.

attributes.name: construction_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating construction or design contract to which this change order applies.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Change orders affect cost center budgets and require cost center manager approval for budget reallocation. Essential for departmental budget control.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Change orders impact fund budgets and require fund availability verification before approval. Critical for fund balance management and appropriation control.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Change orders adjust GL account budgets and require GL coding for proper capitalization vs. expense classification. Required for accurate financial reporting.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated work order or field service ticket in the CMMS that tracks the physical execution of the change order scope, if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name, title, or role of the individual or governing body authorized to approve this change order (e.g., Director of Engineering, Board of Commissioners, City Council) based on approval thresholds and delegation of authority.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the change order was formally approved by the designated approval authority, authorizing execution of the modified scope.

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents attached to the change order record, such as revised drawings, cost estimates, technical specifications, or approval memos.

attributes.name: change_order_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique identifier for the change order, typically sequential within a contract (e.g., CO-001, CO-002).
attributes.references: AWWA M1 Principles of Water Rates, Fees, and Charges

attributes.name: change_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the change order: draft (being prepared), submitted (sent for review), under review (being evaluated by stakeholders), approved (authorized for execution), rejected (denied), executed (work completed and invoiced), or closed (final reconciliation complete). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|executed|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the change order by originating cause: owner-directed modifications, differing site conditions discovered during construction, design errors or omissions, unforeseen subsurface or environmental conditions, scope additions or deletions, time extensions without cost impact, value engineering proposals, or force majeure events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: owner_directed|differing_site_conditions|design_error|unforeseen_conditions|scope_change|time_extension|value_engineering|force_majeure — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: Net financial impact of the change order on the contract value. Positive values represent cost additions; negative values represent cost deductions or credits to the owner.

attributes.name: cost_impact_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost impact amount. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the change order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_change_order_value
attributes.description: Running total of all approved change order cost impacts for this contract through the current change order, used to track total contract growth or reduction.

attributes.name: change_order_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the scope change, including work to be added, deleted, or substituted, technical specifications, and justification for the modification.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions of the Contract for Construction

attributes.name: environmental_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change order has environmental implications requiring additional permitting, mitigation, or compliance documentation. True if environmental impact exists; False otherwise.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA Clean Water Act (CWA), ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the change order was fully executed by all parties (owner and contractor signatures obtained) and became a binding contract amendment.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions of the Contract for Construction

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role who originated the change order request (e.g., project manager, contractor, design engineer, regulatory inspector).

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the change order request was formally initiated or drafted.

attributes.name: justification
attributes.description: Business and technical rationale for the change order, including regulatory requirements, operational needs, safety considerations, or cost-benefit analysis supporting the modification.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified the change order record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the change order record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, clarifications, or internal coordination notes related to the change order processing and execution.

attributes.name: original_contract_value
attributes.description: The baseline contract value at the time of original award, before any change orders. Used to calculate cumulative change order percentage for cost control reporting.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the change order based on urgency, regulatory compliance requirements, safety impact, or operational criticality.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change order is driven by a regulatory compliance requirement (e.g., EPA mandate, state permit condition, SDWA or CWA obligation). True if regulatory-driven; False otherwise.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA), Clean Water Act (CWA)

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the change order was formally rejected or denied by the approval authority, if applicable.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or rationale provided for the rejection of the change order, including budgetary constraints, scope misalignment, or technical concerns.

attributes.name: revised_completion_date
attributes.description: Updated contract substantial completion date after applying the schedule impact of this change order.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions of the Contract for Construction

attributes.name: safety_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change order addresses a safety hazard or improves worker or public safety conditions. True if safety-related; False otherwise.

attributes.name: schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days added to or subtracted from the contract completion date as a result of this change order. Positive values extend the schedule; negative values accelerate it.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions of the Contract for Construction

attributes.name: scope_addition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change order adds new work scope to the contract. True if scope is added; False if scope is deleted or substituted.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions of the Contract for Construction

attributes.name: scope_deletion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change order removes or deletes work scope from the contract. True if scope is deleted; False otherwise.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions of the Contract for Construction

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the change order was formally submitted to the owner or approval authority for review.
attributes.references: AIA A201 General Conditions of the Contract for Construction

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title summarizing the nature of the change order for quick identification and reporting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created the change order record.

products.name: pay_application

products.name: cost_transaction
products.description: Individual cost transaction posted against a CIP project or WBS element including labor charges, material purchases, equipment rentals, contractor invoices, and overhead allocations. Tracks transaction date, cost type (labor, material, equipment, subcontract, overhead), vendor or employee reference, purchase order or work order reference, amount, cost center, fund, GL account, and posting period. Provides the granular cost ledger for project cost control, earned value management, budget vs actual reporting, and capitalization at project closeout. Sourced from SAP FI/CO actual cost postings and integrated with pay application approvals.

attributes.name: cost_transaction_id

attributes.name: primary_approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this cost transaction for posting. Null for transactions that do not require approval or are auto-approved.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CIP project or WBS element against which this cost transaction is posted. Links to the parent capital project for infrastructure expansion, rehabilitation, or renewal.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Project costs allocate to cost centers for indirect cost recovery, overhead distribution, and departmental performance tracking. Essential for full-cost pricing and rate-making.

attributes.name: secondary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this cost transaction for posting. Null for transactions that do not require approval or are auto-approved.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Project costs must be charged to specific funds for regulatory reporting, rate base calculations, and fund financial statements. Required for GASB 34 compliance.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Project costs post to GL accounts for financial statement preparation, audit trails, and asset capitalization decisions. Required for proper GAAP/GASB accounting.

attributes.name: original_cost_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original project cost transaction ID that this reversal transaction is correcting. Null for original postings; populated only for reversal entries.

attributes.description: Reference to the employee who performed the labor charged in this transaction. Applicable only for labor cost types. Null for material, equipment, or subcontract costs.

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The asset class code to which this cost will be capitalized upon project closeout (e.g., water treatment plant, distribution mains, pumping stations). Null for non-capitalizable costs.

attributes.name: capitalization_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this cost transaction is eligible for capitalization as a fixed asset upon project completion. True indicates the cost will be capitalized; False indicates it will be expensed.

attributes.name: change_order_number
attributes.description: The change order number associated with this cost transaction if it results from a project scope or budget change. Enables change order cost tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: commitment_item
attributes.description: Reference to the budget commitment or encumbrance item that this actual cost is drawn against. Enables commitment vs. actual cost tracking for budget control.
attributes.references: SAP PS Budgeting and Commitment Management

attributes.name: cost_element
attributes.description: The SAP CO cost element code that categorizes the nature of the expense (e.g., direct labor, materials, external services). Maps to the chart of accounts for financial reporting.

attributes.name: cost_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost transaction by type: labor charges, material purchases, equipment rentals, subcontractor invoices, overhead allocations, or other miscellaneous costs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this cost transaction record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-currency project accounting for international projects or vendors.

attributes.name: cost_transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the cost transaction providing additional context about the work performed, materials purchased, or services rendered. Supports audit and cost review processes.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which this cost transaction was posted. Supports monthly cost control and earned value reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this cost transaction was posted. Enables year-over-year cost analysis and budget variance reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on the vendor invoice or billing document. Used for payment terms calculation and aging analysis.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor invoice number or billing document number that supports this cost transaction. Provides audit trail for accounts payable reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was made to the vendor for this cost transaction. Supports cash flow analysis and vendor payment tracking.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current status of the cost transaction in the financial system. Posted indicates the transaction is final; Pending indicates it is awaiting approval; Reversed indicates it has been reversed; Rejected indicates it was not accepted.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number associated with this cost transaction for materials, equipment, or services procured from external vendors. Enables procurement traceability.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the resource consumed or purchased in this transaction (e.g., labor hours, material units, equipment rental days). Enables unit cost analysis and earned value calculations.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this transaction is a reversal or correction of a previously posted cost. True indicates a reversal entry; False indicates an original posting.

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: The unique document identifier in the source system (e.g., SAP document number, Maximo work order ID). Enables traceability back to the originating transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the cost transaction in the project currency. Represents the actual cost incurred for labor, materials, equipment, or services.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the cost transaction was posted to the project ledger. This is the accounting date for financial reporting and cost control purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: The externally-known document number or voucher number from the source financial system (SAP FI/CO) that uniquely identifies this cost posting.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the transaction quantity (e.g., hours, each, linear feet, cubic yards). Standardizes quantity reporting across different cost types.
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this cost transaction record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer. Tracks the most recent modification for change data capture and audit purposes.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The specific WBS element code within the project hierarchy to which this cost is allocated. Enables granular cost tracking at the work package or task level.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: The work order or maintenance order number that generated this cost transaction. Links project costs to field work execution and asset maintenance activities.

Links temporary project permits to permanent facility permits for comprehensive compliance tra

attributes.name: territory_id

attributes.description: Current status of any administrative appeal or legal challenge. Null if no appeal was filed.

attributes.name: application_fee_amount

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, lessons learned, or special conditions documented during the commissioning activity execution.

attributes.name: operations_sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date when operations staff signed off on the commissioning activity, certifying readiness to accept the asset into operational service and assume maintenance responsibility.

attributes.name: pressure_test_result_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pressure Test Result in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Maximum pressure achieved during hydrostatic pressure testing of pipelines, tanks, or pressure vessels during commissioning. Used to verify structural integrity and leak-tightness.
attributes.references: AWWA M11 Steel Pipe, AWWA C600 Installation of Ductile-Iron Mains

tag_set.value: Pressure Test Result in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the commissioning activity based on project criticality, regulatory deadlines, operational impact, and schedule dependencies.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory approval or clearance was received from the governing body, authorizing the asset to enter operational service.
attributes.references: EPA Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA), State Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory notification was submitted to the appropriate governing body for the commissioning activity.
attributes.references: EPA Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA), State Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory notification to EPA, state drinking water program, or other governing body is required for this commissioning activity (e.g., new water treatment plant startup, major distribution system expansion).
attributes.references: EPA Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA), State Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: responsible_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person responsible for the commissioning activity.

attributes.name: responsible_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person responsible for coordinating and executing the commissioning activity.

attributes.name: responsible_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person responsible for the commissioning activity.

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization or individual responsible for executing the commissioning activity (e.g., contractor name, engineering firm, operations manager).

attributes.name: responsible_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the party responsible for executing the commissioning activity. Contractor indicates construction contractor. Engineer indicates design engineer or commissioning engineer. Operations staff indicates utility operations personnel. Vendor indicates equipment supplier. Consultant indicates third-party specialist. Regulatory agency indicates government oversight body.

attributes.name: scada_integration_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration Status
attributes.description: Status of SCADA system integration for the commissioned asset. Not applicable if asset does not require SCADA connectivity. Operational indicates successful integration and data flow to central control system.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Enterprise-Control System Integration, AWWA Standards

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration Status

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the commissioning activity to be completed, including all testing, documentation, and sign-off requirements.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the commissioning activity to begin, as defined in the project schedule or commissioning plan.

attributes.name: sign_off_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the commissioning activity. Tracks progression through required sign-offs from contractor, engineer, and operations staff before final acceptance.

attributes.name: test_procedure_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the test procedure document, standard operating procedure (SOP), or industry standard that governs the commissioning activity execution (e.g., AWWA C651, manufacturer startup manual).

attributes.name: test_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the commissioning activity test. Pass indicates all acceptance criteria met. Fail indicates criteria not met. Conditional pass indicates minor deficiencies that do not prevent operational turnover. Not tested indicates activity was not performed. In progress indicates testing is ongoing.

attributes.name: water_quality_sample_collected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether water quality samples were collected during the commissioning activity for laboratory analysis (e.g., bacteriological testing after main disinfection, process performance verification).
attributes.references: EPA Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA), AWWA Standards

products.name: asset_handover
products.description: Asset handover record documenting the formal transfer of a newly constructed or rehabilitated infrastructure asset from the project/construction domain to the operations and asset management domain (IBM Maximo). Captures handover date, asset identifier (linking to asset domain), as-built drawing references, O&M manual references, warranty start date, warranty expiration date, installed cost for capitalization, depreciation class, responsible operations group, and acceptance sign-off by operations management. Triggers asset creation in Maximo and capitalization in SAP FI.
products.reference: Asset Turnover / Capitalization Record — SAP PS Settlement / IBM Maximo Asset Creation

attributes.name: asset_handover_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset handover record. Primary key for this entity representing the formal transfer event from project/construction to operations.

attributes.name: agreement_id

attributes.name: secondary_asset_vendor_id

attributes.name: cip_project_id

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_permit. Operations staff need permit reference at handover for

attributes.name: source_primary_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the infrastructure asset being transferred to operations. Links to the asset registry in IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS).

attributes.name: pump_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pump_station. Business justification: Pump station handovers must link to the specific station asset for SCADA integration verification, O&M manual association, spare parts inventory setup, warranty management, and operational acceptance

attributes.name: quality_sampling_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.sampling_point. Business justification: Asset handover to operations must document associated sampling points for ongoing compliance monitoring. Operations acceptance requires knowing which sampling points are now their responsibility and w

attributes.name: sampling_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.sampling_location. Business justification: Asset handover transfers sampling locations from construction to operations, including compliance monitoring points, access procedures, and regulatory designation. Required for operational readiness a
