attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.storage_tank. Business justification: Tank handovers require direct linkage to the storage_tank asset for regulatory inspection records, coating warranty tracking, mixing system documentation, level sensor calibration records, and operati

attributes.name: as_built_drawing_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or hyperlink to the as-built engineering drawings reflecting the final constructed condition of the asset, stored in the document management system or GIS.

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: Classification code identifying the asset category for maintenance planning, depreciation, and asset management purposes (e.g., water treatment plant, distribution main, pump station).

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the asset being handed over including type, capacity, specifications, and functional characteristics relevant to operations.

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical asset tag or equipment number affixed to the asset for field identification and tracking in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was capitalized in SAP FI fixed assets module, triggering depreciation and inclusion in rate base for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 34, SAP FI Asset Accounting

attributes.name: commissioning_report_reference
attributes.description: Document reference to the commissioning report verifying that the asset has been tested, started up, and is operating according to design specifications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset handover record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the installed cost amount. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: depreciation_class
attributes.description: Depreciation category or class code used in SAP FI to determine useful life and depreciation method for financial reporting and rate-making purposes.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 34, SAP FI Asset Accounting

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the asset meets all applicable environmental compliance requirements under Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA), Clean Water Act (CWA), and state regulations.

attributes.name: final_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when operations management formally accepted the asset after inspection and verification of all handover documentation and commissioning results.

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: Hierarchical functional location code in IBM Maximo representing the assets position within the utility infrastructure hierarchy (e.g., WTP-01/Filtration/Filter-3).

attributes.name: geographic_location
attributes.description: Geographic location description or address where the asset is physically installed (e.g., facility name, street address, service area).

attributes.name: gis_feature_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this asset to its spatial feature in the Esri ArcGIS Geographic Information System (GIS) for network modeling and mapping.

attributes.name: handover_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the asset was formally transferred from the project/construction team to the operations and maintenance team. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: handover_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special conditions, outstanding issues, lessons learned, or other relevant information about the asset handover process.

attributes.name: handover_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or document number for this asset handover transaction, used for tracking and reference in project closeout documentation.

attributes.name: handover_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset handover process indicating workflow stage from draft through final completion and acceptance.

attributes.name: installed_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total capitalized cost of the asset including construction, materials, labor, equipment, and overhead allocated for capitalization in SAP FI fixed assets module.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset handover record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: om_manual_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or hyperlink to the Operations and Maintenance (O&M) manual provided by the contractor or equipment vendor for operational guidance.

attributes.name: operations_acceptance_signature
attributes.description: Digital signature or sign-off indicator confirming that the operations manager has formally accepted the asset and all associated documentation.

attributes.name: operations_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the operations manager or supervisor who accepted responsibility for the asset on behalf of the operations team.

attributes.name: project_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the project manager or construction manager who delivered the asset and initiated the handover process.

attributes.name: regulatory_permit_number
attributes.description: Environmental or construction permit number issued by EPA, state primacy agency, or local authority authorizing the construction and operation of the asset.

attributes.name: responsible_operations_group
attributes.description: Name or code of the operations department, work center, or functional group that will assume ownership and maintenance responsibility for the asset (e.g., Water Treatment Operations, Distribution Maintenance).

attributes.name: safety_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the asset has received all required safety certifications and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) compliance approvals.

attributes.name: sap_asset_number
attributes.description: SAP FI fixed asset master record number assigned upon capitalization for financial accounting and depreciation tracking.

attributes.name: scada_integration_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration Flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the asset has been integrated into the OSIsoft PI Historian or SCADA system for real-time monitoring and control.

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration Flag

attributes.name: spare_parts_stocked_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether critical spare parts for the asset have been procured and stocked in inventory for maintenance support.

attributes.name: substantial_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset reached substantial completion per the construction contract, typically preceding final handover and marking readiness for beneficial use.
attributes.references: American Institute of Architects (AIA) Contract Documents

attributes.name: training_completion_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether operations staff have completed all required training on the operation and maintenance of the new asset.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years for depreciation calculation and long-term asset management planning.

attributes.name: warranty_duration_months
attributes.description: Duration of the warranty period in months as specified in the construction contract or equipment purchase agreement.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer or contractor warranty period ends, after which the utility assumes full responsibility for repairs and maintenance costs.

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer or contractor warranty period begins, typically aligned with substantial completion or handover date.

products.name: funding_source
products.description: Funding source master record defining the financial mechanisms used to fund CIP projects including revenue bonds, state revolving fund (SRF) loans (DWSRF/CWSRF), federal grants (BRIC, WIFIA, ARPA), general obligation bonds, developer contributions, impact fees, and pay-as-you-go (PAYGO) reserves. Tracks funding source type, program name, administering agency, total available amount, interest rate (for debt instruments), compliance requirements, eligible project types, reporting obligations, and drawdown restrictions. Essential for CIP financial planning and grant compliance.
products.reference: CIP Funding Source — DWSRF / CWSRF / Revenue Bond / Federal Grant

attributes.name: funding_source_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the funding source record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: add column fund_id (BIGINT) with FK to finance.fund.fund_id - funding sources map to specific accounting funds

attributes.name: administering_agency
attributes.description: Government agency or financial institution that administers and oversees the funding source. Examples: 'U.S. Environmental Protection Agency', 'State Department of Environmental Quality', 'USDA Rural Development', 'State Infrastructure Bank', 'Municipal Bond Authority'.
attributes.references: EPA SRF Program Guidelines; Federal Grant Management Standards

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: Total amount already allocated or committed to specific CIP (Capital Improvement Program) projects from this funding source. Sum of all project allocations.

attributes.name: arra_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this funding source originated from ARRA (American Recovery and Reinvestment Act) stimulus funding. True if ARRA funding; False otherwise. ARRA funds had additional reporting and Buy American requirements.
attributes.references: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009 (Public Law 111-5)

tag_set.value: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA) Flag

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when the funding source was officially authorized or approved. For bonds, the issuance date; for loans, the loan agreement date; for grants, the award date.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unallocated funding available for new project assignments. Calculated as total_authorized_amount minus allocated_amount.

attributes.name: bond_insurance_provider
attributes.description: Name of the insurance company providing credit enhancement for bond issues. Bond insurance guarantees payment and can improve credit rating. Null if no insurance or not applicable.

attributes.name: bond_rating
attributes.description: Credit rating assigned by rating agencies (Moody's, S&P, Fitch) for bond issues. Examples: 'AAA', 'AA+', 'A1', 'Baa2'. Higher ratings indicate lower credit risk and typically lower interest rates. Null for non-bond funding.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 62 - Debt Reporting; Municipal Bond Rating Standards

attributes.name: buy_american_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects funded by this source must comply with Buy American provisions requiring use of domestically produced iron, steel, and manufactured goods. True if Buy American applies; False otherwise. Common for federal funding.
attributes.references: Build America, Buy America Act (BABA); EPA SRF Buy American Requirements

attributes.name: funding_source_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the funding source used in financial systems and project documentation. Examples: DWSRF-2024-001, GOB-2023-SERIES-A, WIFIA-2025-LOAN.

attributes.name: compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Summary of key compliance obligations associated with this funding source. Examples: 'NEPA (National Environmental Policy Act) review required; State Environmental Review Process; Disadvantaged Business Enterprise goals; Prevailing wage compliance; Single Audit Act requirements'.
attributes.references: EPA SRF Compliance Requirements; Federal Grant Compliance (2 CFR 200); NEPA (42 U.S.C. 4321)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this funding source record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this funding source record. Typically 'USD' for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: davis_bacon_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects funded by this source must comply with Davis-Bacon prevailing wage requirements. True if Davis-Bacon applies; False otherwise. Typically required for federal grants and some SRF loans.
attributes.references: Davis-Bacon Act (40 U.S.C. 3141-3148); EPA SRF Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: disadvantaged_community_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this funding source is specifically designated for disadvantaged communities (typically defined by median household income thresholds). True if designated for disadvantaged communities; False otherwise. Affects eligibility for principal forgiveness and subsidized rates.
attributes.references: EPA SRF Disadvantaged Community Guidelines; SDWA Section 1452(d)

attributes.name: disbursed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount actually disbursed or drawn down from this funding source to date. For loans and grants, this tracks actual cash received; for bonds, proceeds distributed.

attributes.name: drawdown_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of limitations or conditions on fund disbursement. Examples: 'Reimbursement only after costs incurred; Requires pre-approval for each draw; Maximum monthly draw limit; Construction milestone-based disbursement; Retainage held until project completion'.
attributes.references: EPA SRF Program Guidelines; Federal Grant Management Standards

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when funds become available for allocation and drawdown. May differ from authorization date due to closing procedures or program launch delays.

attributes.name: eligible_cost_categories
attributes.description: Description of cost categories eligible for reimbursement or funding. Examples: 'Design, Construction, Equipment, Land Acquisition' or 'Construction Only' or 'Planning, Design, Construction, Inspection'. Some funding sources restrict soft costs or administrative expenses.
attributes.references: EPA SRF Program Guidelines; Federal Grant Cost Principles (2 CFR 200)

attributes.name: eligible_project_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of CIP project types eligible for funding from this source. Examples: 'Water Treatment Plant Expansion, Distribution System Rehabilitation, Lead Service Line Replacement' or 'Wastewater Treatment Upgrades, CSO (Combined Sewer Overflow) Abatement, Green Infrastructure'. DWSRF (Drinking Water SRF) and CWSRF (Clean Water SRF) have specific eligible use categories.
attributes.references: EPA SRF Eligible Use Guidelines; SDWA Section 1452; CWA Section 603

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the funding source expires or must be fully allocated. For grants, this is the period of performance end date; for bonds, the final maturity date; for loans, the commitment expiration. Null for perpetual funding sources.
attributes.references: Federal Grant Management Standards; GASB Statement 62

attributes.name: final_maturity_date
attributes.description: Date when all principal and interest must be fully repaid for debt instruments. Null for grants and PAYGO funding.

attributes.name: first_payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the first principal or interest payment is due for debt instruments. Null for grants and non-debt funding. SRF loans often have deferred payment periods during construction.

attributes.name: funding_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the funding mechanism. Revenue bonds are secured by utility revenues; general obligation bonds by tax revenues; SRF (State Revolving Fund) loans include DWSRF (Drinking Water) and CWSRF (Clean Water); federal grants include WIFIA (Water Infrastructure Finance and Innovation Act), BRIC (Building Resilient Infrastructure and Communities), ARPA (American Rescue Plan Act); impact fees are one-time charges on new development; PAYGO (pay-as-you-go) uses current revenues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue_bond|general_obligation_bond|srf_loan|federal_grant|state_grant|developer_contribution|impact_fee|paygo_reserve|wifia_loan|arpa_grant|bric_grant|other — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GASB Statement 62 - Debt Reporting; EPA State Revolving Fund Guidelines

attributes.name: funding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the funding source. Available: funds can be allocated to projects; Committed: allocated but not yet disbursed; Fully Allocated: no remaining capacity; Closed: program ended; Suspended: temporarily unavailable; Pending Approval: awaiting authorization.

attributes.name: green_project_reserve_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this funding source is part of the Green Project Reserve, which prioritizes environmentally innovative projects (green infrastructure, water efficiency, energy efficiency). True if GPR funding; False otherwise. SRF programs must allocate at least 10% to GPR projects.
attributes.references: EPA Green Project Reserve Guidelines; ARRA Section 1602

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate for debt instruments (bonds, loans) expressed as a decimal percentage. For example, 3.5% is stored as 3.5000. Null for grants and non-debt funding sources. SRF (State Revolving Fund) loans typically have below-market rates.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 62 - Debt Reporting; EPA SRF Interest Rate Guidelines

attributes.name: interest_rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of interest rate structure. Fixed: rate does not change; Variable: rate adjusts based on index; Zero: no interest charged (some grants); Subsidized: below-market rate (common for SRF loans and federal programs).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this funding source record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: match_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of project cost that must be funded from other sources (local match). For example, a 20% match means the utility must provide 20% and the funding source covers 80%. Zero for funding sources with no match requirement. Common for federal grants.

attributes.name: funding_source_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the funding source including program name, series, and year. Example: 'Drinking Water State Revolving Fund 2024 Series A' or 'General Obligation Bond 2023 Infrastructure Series'.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to this funding source. Free-text field for capturing unique requirements, historical context, or operational guidance.

attributes.name: prepayment_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether early repayment of principal is permitted without penalty for debt instruments. True if prepayment allowed; False if prepayment prohibited or penalized. Null for non-debt funding.

attributes.name: prepayment_penalty_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage penalty charged for early repayment if prepayment is restricted. Zero if no penalty applies. Null for non-debt funding or if prepayment is not allowed.

attributes.name: principal_forgiveness_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of loan principal that is forgiven (does not require repayment). Common in SRF programs for disadvantaged communities or specific project types (e.g., lead service line replacement). Zero if no forgiveness applies.
attributes.references: EPA SRF Principal Forgiveness Guidelines; SDWA Section 1452(d)

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Official name of the funding program or initiative. Examples: 'EPA Drinking Water State Revolving Fund', 'USDA Water and Waste Disposal Loan Program', 'State Infrastructure Bank', 'Bipartisan Infrastructure Law Grant Program'.
attributes.references: EPA SRF Program Guidelines; USDA Rural Development Programs

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for progress and financial reporting to the funding agency. SRF loans typically require quarterly reports; federal grants often require quarterly or semi-annual reports; bonds may require annual disclosure.
attributes.references: EPA SRF Reporting Requirements; Federal Grant Management Standards (2 CFR 200)

attributes.name: reporting_requirements
attributes.description: Detailed description of reporting obligations including report types, submission deadlines, and required content. Examples: 'Quarterly progress reports due 30 days after quarter end; Annual financial audit; DBE (Disadvantaged Business Enterprise) utilization reports; Environmental compliance certifications'.
attributes.references: EPA SRF Reporting Requirements; Federal Grant Management Standards (2 CFR 200)

attributes.name: term_months
attributes.description: Total term or duration of the funding instrument in months. For bonds and loans, this is the repayment period. SRF loans typically have 20-30 year terms (240-360 months). Null for grants and PAYGO (pay-as-you-go) funding.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 62 - Debt Reporting; EPA SRF Program Guidelines

attributes.name: total_authorized_amount
attributes.description: Total funding amount authorized or available under this funding source. For bonds, this is the par value; for loans, the principal amount; for grants, the award amount; for PAYGO, the budgeted reserve allocation.

attributes.name: trustee_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution serving as trustee for bond proceeds and debt service payments. The trustee holds funds and ensures compliance with bond covenants. Null for non-bond funding.

products.name: funding_allocation
products.description: Association record linking a CIP project to one or more funding sources with the specific dollar amount allocated from each source. Supports multi-source funding scenarios where a single project draws from SRF loans, grants, and rate revenue simultaneously. Tracks allocation amount, percentage of total project cost, drawdown schedule, conditions precedent to drawdown, amount drawn to date, and remaining available balance. Enables funding compliance reporting and ensures projects do not exceed authorized funding limits.
products.reference: Project Funding Allocation — CIP Financial Plan

attributes.name: funding_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project funding allocation record. Primary key for this association entity linking a Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project to a specific funding source.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project receiving funding from this allocation. Links to the parent project entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Funding allocations may restrict use to specific cost centers or departments per grant or loan covenants. Required for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: funding_source_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific funding source providing capital for this project allocation. May represent State Revolving Fund (SRF) loans, federal grants, municipal bonds, rate revenue, or other capital sources.

attributes.name: tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.tariff. Business justification: Project funding from rate revenue or bonds is tied to specific tariff structures and rate cases that authorized the revenue. Regulatory financial reporting and rate case filings require linking projec

attributes.name: allocation_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount allocated from this funding source to the project. Represents the authorized funding limit that may be drawn down over the project lifecycle.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for this funding allocation, typically assigned by the finance department or funding agency. Used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total project cost represented by this funding allocation. Enables analysis of funding mix and source diversification across the Capital Improvement Program (CIP).

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the funding allocation. Tracks progression from initial proposal through approval, commitment, active drawdown, and final closure or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: proposed|approved|committed|active|drawn|closed|cancelled|suspended — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: american_iron_steel_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Iron and Steel Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether American Iron and Steel requirements apply to materials procured with this funding allocation. Mandated for State Revolving Fund (SRF) and many federal grant programs.

tag_set.value: American Iron and Steel Required Flag

attributes.name: amount_drawn_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount that has been drawn down or disbursed from this funding allocation as of the current date. Updated as project expenditures are incurred and reimbursement requests are processed.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this funding allocation was officially approved by the funding authority, board of directors, or governing body. Establishes the effective start of the allocation.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount committed through purchase orders, contracts, or other encumbrances against this funding allocation but not yet drawn. Represents funds obligated but not yet disbursed.

attributes.name: compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Description of regulatory, environmental, and administrative compliance requirements imposed by the funding source. May include Davis-Bacon prevailing wage, American Iron and Steel requirements, environmental reviews, or other federal and state mandates.

attributes.name: conditions_precedent
attributes.description: Description of conditions that must be satisfied before funds from this allocation may be drawn. May include regulatory approvals, environmental clearances, matching fund requirements, or other prerequisites imposed by the funding source.

attributes.name: conditions_precedent_met_date
attributes.description: Date when all conditions precedent were satisfied and the allocation became available for drawdown. Establishes the start of the active funding period.

attributes.name: conditions_precedent_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all conditions precedent have been satisfied and the allocation is available for drawdown. True when all prerequisites are met; false when conditions remain outstanding.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this funding allocation record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocation amount. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: davis_bacon_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Davis-Bacon prevailing wage requirements apply to construction work funded by this allocation. True for most federal funding sources; false for purely local funding.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor Davis-Bacon Act

attributes.name: drawdown_schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the drawdown schedule governing when and how funds may be requested from this allocation. Defines the timing and frequency of fund disbursements.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this funding allocation expires or must be fully drawn. Critical for State Revolving Fund (SRF) loans and grants with time-limited availability.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this funding allocation becomes available for drawdown. May differ from approval date based on funding source terms and conditions precedent.

attributes.name: eligible_cost_categories
attributes.description: Description of project cost categories that are eligible for reimbursement from this funding allocation. May restrict use to construction, engineering, land acquisition, or other specific categories based on funding source rules.

attributes.name: first_payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the first repayment installment is due for loan-based funding allocations. Null for grants and equity funding.

attributes.name: forgiveness_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of principal forgiveness granted as part of this funding allocation. Common in State Revolving Fund (SRF) programs for disadvantaged communities or green infrastructure projects.

attributes.name: forgiveness_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the allocation amount that is forgiven and does not require repayment. Represents the grant portion of a subsidized loan.

attributes.name: funding_agency_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person at the funding agency. Used for submitting reports and coordinating drawdown requests.

attributes.name: funding_agency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the funding agency responsible for administering this allocation. Used for coordination and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: funding_agency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person at the funding agency. Used for coordination and issue resolution.

attributes.name: funding_priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this funding allocation relative to other allocations for the same project. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for drawdown when multiple sources are available.

attributes.name: grant_agreement_number
attributes.description: Official agreement or contract number assigned by the funding agency for grant-based allocations. Used for tracking and reporting to federal and state agencies.

attributes.name: ineligible_cost_categories
attributes.description: Description of project cost categories that are explicitly ineligible for reimbursement from this funding allocation. Common exclusions include administrative overhead, legal fees, or operations and maintenance (O&M) costs.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applicable to this funding allocation if it represents a loan or bond. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.50 percent). Null for grants and equity funding.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this funding allocation record was most recently updated. Audit trail field for tracking changes and data lineage.

attributes.name: loan_agreement_number
attributes.description: Official loan agreement or promissory note number assigned by the lending institution for loan-based allocations. Used for tracking State Revolving Fund (SRF) and other loan programs.

attributes.name: matching_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of matching funds required from other sources to satisfy the matching requirement for this allocation.

attributes.name: matching_percentage
attributes.description: Required percentage of project cost that must be funded from other sources to satisfy matching requirements. Common for federal and state grant programs.

attributes.name: matching_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this funding allocation requires matching funds from other sources. True for grants and loans with local match requirements; false for fully-funded allocations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information, special conditions, or administrative notes related to this funding allocation. Used to capture context not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: reimbursement_basis
attributes.description: Method by which drawdown requests are calculated and approved. Determines whether reimbursements are based on actual incurred costs, percentage of work complete, achievement of milestones, or advance payments.

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Remaining available balance in this funding allocation calculated as allocation amount minus amount drawn to date. Represents uncommitted funds still available for project expenditures.

attributes.name: repayment_term_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which this funding allocation must be repaid if it represents a loan. Typical State Revolving Fund (SRF) loans have 20-30 year terms (240-360 months). Null for grants.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for submitting progress and financial reports to the funding source. Defines compliance reporting obligations for this allocation.

products.name: land_acquisition
products.description: Real property acquisition record for land, easements, and rights-of-way required for CIP project construction and permanent infrastructure operation. Tracks parcel identifier, property owner, acquisition type (fee simple, permanent easement, temporary construction easement, right-of-way), parcel area, appraised value, negotiated acquisition cost, relocation assistance obligations, title search status, environmental assessment status, deed recording date, and project association. Supports eminent domain proceedings and just compensation documentation.
products.reference: Real Property Acquisition — Uniform Relocation Act / Right-of-Way Record

attributes.name: land_acquisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the land acquisition record. Primary key for the land acquisition entity.

attributes.name: acquisition_agent_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Land acquisition agents are utility real estate staff. Tracking which employee manages property negotiations, appraisals, and eminent domain proceedings is essential for legal accountability, audit tr

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CIP project requiring this land acquisition. Links the property acquisition to the infrastructure project that necessitates it.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Land acquisitions charge to cost centers for project cost tracking and departmental accountability. Required for full-cost accounting.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Land acquisitions are capital expenditures funded from specific utility funds. Required for fund accounting and capital asset tracking.

attributes.name: pipe_main_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pipe_main. Business justification: Easement acquisitions for pipeline corridors must be linked to the specific main alignment for right-of-way management, future maintenance access, encroachment prevention, and legal documentation of a

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_territory. Business justification: Land parcels acquired for utility infrastructure (treatment plants, pump stations, easements) are within specific service territories. GIS asset management, franchise compliance, and property tax repo

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the property owner accepted the utility's acquisition offer, forming the basis for the purchase agreement.
attributes.references: Contract Law; Real Property Transaction Standards

attributes.name: acquisition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting negotiation history, special conditions, owner concerns, unique circumstances, or other relevant information about the acquisition process.

attributes.name: acquisition_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for completing this acquisition based on project schedule criticality and construction sequencing requirements.

attributes.name: acquisition_purpose
attributes.description: Detailed description of why this property acquisition is required for the CIP project. Examples: water main installation, treatment plant expansion, pump station construction, access road, permanent facility site.

attributes.name: acquisition_status
attributes.description: Current status of the land acquisition process. Tracks progression from initial identification through final deed recording. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: identified|negotiation|appraisal_ordered|appraisal_complete|offer_made|accepted|rejected|condemnation_filed|acquired|recorded — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: acquisition_type
attributes.description: Type of property interest being acquired. Fee simple represents full ownership; permanent easement grants perpetual use rights; temporary construction easement allows limited-duration construction access; right-of-way grants passage rights; license grants revocable permission; lease grants time-limited possession.
attributes.references: Real Property Law; Eminent Domain Statutes

attributes.name: appraisal_date
attributes.description: Date when the certified appraisal was completed by a qualified real estate appraiser, establishing fair market value for just compensation purposes.
attributes.references: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP)

attributes.name: appraised_value_amount
attributes.description: Fair market value of the property interest as determined by a certified real estate appraiser. Establishes baseline for just compensation under eminent domain law.
attributes.references: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP); Fifth Amendment Just Compensation Clause

attributes.name: appraiser_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified real estate appraiser who performed the property valuation. Used for documentation and potential testimony in condemnation proceedings.
attributes.references: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP)

attributes.name: condemnation_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the utility filed a condemnation petition or complaint with the court to acquire the property through eminent domain. Null if voluntary acquisition was successful.
attributes.references: State Eminent Domain Statutes; Civil Procedure Rules

attributes.name: court_case_number
attributes.description: Official court case number assigned to the eminent domain condemnation proceeding. Used for tracking legal proceedings and court-ordered compensation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this land acquisition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this acquisition record. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: deed_book_reference
attributes.description: Official recording reference including deed book number and page number where the instrument is recorded in county land records. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., Book 1234, Page 567 or Document Number 2023-12345).

attributes.name: deed_recording_date
attributes.description: Date when the deed, easement, or other property instrument was officially recorded with the county recorder's office, completing the legal transfer of property rights.
attributes.references: Real Property Recording Statutes; County Recorder Standards

attributes.name: eminent_domain_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether eminent domain (condemnation) proceedings were initiated or required because voluntary acquisition negotiations failed. True if condemnation was filed; false if acquired through voluntary negotiation.
attributes.references: Fifth Amendment Takings Clause; State Eminent Domain Statutes

attributes.name: environmental_assessment_status
attributes.description: Status of Phase I or Phase II environmental site assessment to identify potential contamination, hazardous materials, or environmental liabilities on the property.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) ASTM E1527 Standard; Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act (CERCLA)

attributes.name: environmental_findings_summary
attributes.description: Summary of environmental assessment findings including any recognized environmental conditions, contamination, or remediation requirements that affect property value or acquisition feasibility.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) ASTM E1527 Standard

attributes.name: infrastructure_asset_type
attributes.description: Type of water or wastewater infrastructure asset that will be constructed on or require this acquired property. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: water_main|transmission_main|distribution_main|pump_station|treatment_plant|storage_tank|well_site|access_road|utility_corridor — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Asset Classification Standards

attributes.name: just_compensation_award
attributes.description: Final compensation amount awarded by the court in condemnation proceedings. Represents the court's determination of just compensation under the Fifth Amendment.
attributes.references: Fifth Amendment Just Compensation Clause; State Eminent Domain Statutes

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this land acquisition record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: legal_counsel_name
attributes.description: Name of the attorney or law firm providing legal counsel for this acquisition, including title review, contract preparation, and condemnation representation if required.

attributes.name: negotiated_acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Final negotiated purchase price or compensation amount agreed upon between the utility and property owner. May differ from appraised value based on negotiation outcomes.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP); Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) Statement 34

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: Date when the utility made its initial written offer to purchase or acquire the property interest from the owner.
attributes.references: Uniform Relocation Assistance and Real Property Acquisition Policies Act (URA)

attributes.name: parcel_area_acres
attributes.description: Total area of the parcel or portion being acquired, measured in acres. Used for valuation and compensation calculations.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Asset Management Standards

attributes.name: parcel_area_square_feet
attributes.description: Total area of the parcel or portion being acquired, measured in square feet. Provides precise measurement for engineering and legal documentation.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Asset Management Standards

attributes.name: parcel_identifier
attributes.description: Official tax assessor parcel number or legal property identifier assigned by the county or municipal tax authority. Used for legal property identification and title search.

attributes.name: property_owner_contact_address
attributes.description: Mailing address for the property owner used for official correspondence, notices, and negotiation communications.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 4; Uniform Relocation Assistance Act

attributes.name: property_owner_email
attributes.description: Email address for electronic communication with the property owner regarding acquisition matters.

attributes.name: property_owner_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the property owner or entity holding title as recorded in county land records. May be individual, corporation, trust, or government entity.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 4; Real Property Recording Standards

attributes.name: property_owner_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for contacting the property owner during acquisition negotiations.

attributes.name: property_use_type
attributes.description: Current use classification of the property being acquired. Affects valuation methodology, relocation assistance requirements, and environmental assessment scope. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|commercial|industrial|agricultural|vacant_land|government|institutional — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: relocation_assistance_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual cost of relocation assistance benefits owed to displaced persons or businesses under the Uniform Relocation Assistance Act. Includes moving expenses, replacement housing payments, and business re-establishment costs.
attributes.references: Uniform Relocation Assistance and Real Property Acquisition Policies Act (URA); 49 CFR Part 24

attributes.name: survey_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the professional land survey was completed, establishing precise legal boundaries, area measurements, and identifying any encroachments or easements.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA) Survey Standards

attributes.name: title_issues_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any title defects, liens, mortgages, easements, or other encumbrances discovered during title examination that must be resolved before acquisition.

attributes.name: title_search_status
attributes.description: Status of the title search and examination process to verify clear ownership and identify any liens, encumbrances, or defects that could affect acquisition.

attributes.name: zoning_classification
attributes.description: Municipal or county zoning classification code for the property (e.g., R-1, C-2, M-1). Affects permitted uses and property valuation.

products.name: risk
products.description: Project risk register entry documenting identified risks that could impact CIP project scope, schedule, cost, or quality. Tracks risk identifier, risk category (geotechnical, regulatory, design, contractor performance, supply chain, environmental, community opposition), risk description, probability rating, impact rating (cost and schedule), risk score, mitigation strategy, contingency plan, risk owner, status (open, mitigated, closed, realized), and residual risk assessment. Supports proactive project risk management and contingency budget justification.
products.reference: Project Risk Register — PMI PMBOK Risk Management

attributes.name: risk_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project risk register entry. Primary key for the project risk product.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project to which this risk applies. Links risk to the parent infrastructure expansion, rehabilitation, or renewal project.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Risk owners are project team members (employees). PMI and utility capital project standards require assigning accountability for risk mitigation to specific employees. Essential for risk register repo

attributes.name: actual_cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: Actual financial impact incurred if the risk was realized, measured as the incremental cost to the project. Used for contingency reserve tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: actual_schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Actual schedule delay in calendar days incurred if the risk was realized. Used for schedule variance analysis and lessons learned.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Classification of the risk by source or domain. Categories include geotechnical (soil conditions, subsurface unknowns), regulatory (permit delays, compliance changes), design (engineering errors, scope gaps), contractor performance (quality, schedule adherence), supply chain (material availability, price volatility), environmental (contamination, protected species), community opposition (public hearings, legal challenges), financial, schedule, safety, quality, and technology risks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: geotechnical|regulatory|design|contractor_performance|supply_chain|environmental|community_opposition|financial|schedule|safety|quality|technology — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk was formally closed, either because the threat passed, mitigation was successful, or the risk was realized and consequences managed. Used for risk lifecycle tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: contingency_plan
attributes.description: Reactive response plan to be executed if the risk event occurs despite mitigation efforts. Describes the specific actions, resources, and decision authorities required to minimize damage and restore project progress.

attributes.name: contingency_reserve_allocated_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the project contingency budget allocated to this specific risk based on its risk exposure amount. Used for contingency budget management and justification to funding authorities.

attributes.name: cost_impact_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the potential financial impact to the project budget if the risk is realized. Ratings range from negligible (minimal budget variance) to severe (significant budget overrun requiring board approval or funding reallocation).

attributes.name: cost_impact_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the cost impact rating, typically on a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 is negligible and 5 is severe. Used for quantitative risk scoring.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk register entry was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this risk entry (e.g., USD for United States Dollar). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency projects.

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the risk event, including the nature of the threat, potential triggers, and context within the project lifecycle.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: Quantitative estimate of the potential cost increase to the project if the risk event occurs, expressed in the project currency. Used for contingency budget planning and financial exposure analysis.

attributes.name: estimated_schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Quantitative estimate of the potential delay in calendar days if the risk event occurs. Used for critical path analysis and project completion forecasting.

attributes.name: exposure_amount
attributes.description: Expected monetary value of the risk, calculated as probability (percentage) multiplied by estimated cost impact. Represents the statistically expected financial exposure and is used for contingency reserve allocation.

attributes.name: identification_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk was first identified and entered into the project risk register. Used for tracking risk discovery patterns and audit trails.

attributes.name: identified_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team who identified the risk. Supports knowledge management and lessons learned processes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk register entry was last updated. Tracks the currency of risk information and supports change management processes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent risk review or reassessment. Risks should be reviewed regularly (typically monthly for active CIP projects) to update probability, impact, and mitigation status.

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: Detailed description of the proactive actions, controls, or process changes planned to reduce the probability or impact of the risk. Includes preventive measures, early warning systems, and risk transfer mechanisms (e.g., insurance, performance bonds).

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal risk review. Ensures risks are monitored on a regular cadence and not overlooked during project execution.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes, comments, or context regarding the risk, mitigation progress, stakeholder concerns, or lessons learned. Supports comprehensive risk documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: owner_role
attributes.description: Organizational role or title of the risk owner (e.g., Project Manager, Design Engineer, Construction Manager, Regulatory Compliance Manager). Provides context for accountability and escalation paths.

attributes.name: probability_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the likelihood that the risk event will occur during the project lifecycle. Ratings typically follow a five-point scale: very low (0-10%), low (10-30%), medium (30-50%), high (50-70%), very high (70-100%).

attributes.name: probability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the probability rating, typically on a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 is very low and 5 is very high. Used for quantitative risk scoring and prioritization.

attributes.name: quality_impact_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the potential impact to project deliverable quality, asset performance, or operational reliability if the risk is realized. Includes impacts to water quality compliance, treatment capacity, or asset lifespan.

attributes.name: realization_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk event actually occurred. Populated only if risk status is realized. Used for lessons learned analysis and contingency reserve reconciliation.

attributes.name: residual_cost_impact_rating
attributes.description: Reassessed cost impact rating after mitigation actions have been implemented. Reflects the reduced financial exposure given the controls in place.

attributes.name: residual_probability_rating
attributes.description: Reassessed probability rating after mitigation actions have been implemented. Reflects the reduced likelihood of the risk event occurring given the controls in place.

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Recalculated composite risk score after mitigation, using residual probability and impact ratings. Used to assess the effectiveness of risk response actions and determine if additional mitigation is required.

attributes.name: residual_schedule_impact_rating
attributes.description: Reassessed schedule impact rating after mitigation actions have been implemented. Reflects the reduced schedule exposure given the controls in place.

attributes.name: response_strategy
attributes.description: High-level strategy for managing the risk. Avoid: eliminate the threat by changing project scope or approach. Mitigate: reduce probability or impact. Transfer: shift risk to third party (insurance, contract terms). Accept: acknowledge risk and allocate contingency. Escalate: elevate to program or executive level for decision.

attributes.name: risk_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the risk entry, typically formatted as project code plus sequential risk number (e.g., WTP-2024-R001). Used for external communication and reporting.

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk. Open: identified but mitigation not yet started. Active: mitigation actions in progress. Mitigated: mitigation complete, residual risk accepted. Closed: risk no longer applicable or threat passed. Realized: risk event occurred. Monitoring: low-priority risk under passive observation.

attributes.name: schedule_impact_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the potential delay to the project schedule if the risk is realized. Ratings range from negligible (no material delay) to severe (critical path delay, missed regulatory deadlines, or substantial commissioning postponement).

attributes.name: schedule_impact_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the schedule impact rating, typically on a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 is negligible and 5 is severe. Used for quantitative risk scoring.

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Composite quantitative risk score calculated as the product of probability score and impact scores (cost, schedule, quality). Used for risk prioritization and ranking within the project risk register. Higher scores indicate higher priority risks requiring active management.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Optional secondary classification providing additional granularity within the primary risk category (e.g., under regulatory: NPDES permit, SDWA compliance, wetlands permit).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Concise title or name of the identified risk for quick reference and reporting.

attributes.name: trigger_event_description
attributes.description: Description of the specific conditions, milestones, or indicators that signal the risk is about to occur or has increased in likelihood. Used for early warning and proactive response activation.

products.name: issue
products.description: Active project issue record tracking problems, conflicts, or decisions requiring resolution during project execution. Distinct from risks (which are potential future events) — issues are current, active problems impacting the project. Tracks issue number, date identified, issue type (design conflict, contractor dispute, permit delay, utility conflict, community complaint, regulatory requirement change), description, priority, assigned resolver, target resolution date, actual resolution date, resolution description, and impact on schedule/cost. Supports project manager decision-making and escalation workflows.
products.reference: Project Issue Log — PMI PMBOK Issue Management

attributes.name: issue_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project issue record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital improvement program (CIP) project to which this issue belongs.

attributes.name: construction_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction or service contract under which the issue arose, if applicable. Null if issue is not contract-related.

attributes.name: identified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Issue identifiers are project team employees. Tracking who identified issues is essential for lessons learned, quality improvement, and employee performance reviews. Standard project management practi

attributes.name: primary_issue_contractor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contractor involved in or responsible for the issue, if applicable. Null if issue does not involve a contractor.

attributes.name: issue_request_for_information_id
attributes.description: Reference to the RFI that preceded or is associated with this issue, if applicable. Null if no RFI relationship exists.

attributes.name: issue_rfi_request_for_information_id
attributes.description: Reference to the RFI that preceded or is associated with this issue, if applicable. Null if no RFI relationship exists.

attributes.name: secondary_issue_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contractor involved in or responsible for the issue, if applicable. Null if issue does not involve a contractor.

attributes.name: primary_issue_change_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the change order generated as a result of this issue, if applicable. Null if no change order was required.

attributes.name: actual_resolution_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date when the issue was resolved and solution implemented. Null if issue is still open or in progress.

attributes.name: asset_class_affected
attributes.description: Type of infrastructure asset impacted by the issue (e.g., water main, pump, valve, treatment equipment, SCADA system). Used for asset management integration and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date when the issue was assigned to the current resolver.

attributes.name: assigned_resolver
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or team responsible for investigating and resolving the issue. May be reassigned during escalation.

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents, photos, drawings, or other files attached to the issue record (e.g., site photos, correspondence, technical drawings, inspection reports).

attributes.name: corrective_action
attributes.description: Description of the immediate corrective measures taken to resolve the issue and prevent recurrence on this project.

attributes.name: cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual financial impact of the issue on project budget, expressed in the project currency. Includes direct costs (rework, materials, labor) and indirect costs (delay penalties, escalation). Positive values indicate cost increase; negative values indicate cost savings.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the issue record was first created in the project management system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for cost impact amount (e.g., USD for United States Dollar).

attributes.name: date_identified
attributes.description: Calendar date when the issue was first discovered or reported. Distinct from when the issue record was created in the system.

attributes.name: issue_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the problem, conflict, or decision requiring resolution. Includes context, background, and any relevant technical or operational details.

attributes.name: environmental_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issue has environmental consequences (e.g., potential discharge violation, habitat disturbance, contamination risk). True if environmental impact exists; false otherwise.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the issue was escalated to a higher authority level. Null if no escalation has occurred.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Current escalation tier for the issue: none (handled at working level), supervisor (escalated to first-line supervisor), manager (escalated to department manager), director (escalated to division director), executive (escalated to C-suite), board (escalated to governing board or commission).

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the issue was escalated (e.g., missed target resolution date, cost impact exceeds threshold, requires executive decision, regulatory urgency).

attributes.name: issue_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique issue tracking number assigned sequentially or per project numbering scheme. Used for communication and reference in project documentation.

attributes.name: issue_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the issue: open (newly identified), in_progress (actively being worked), pending_approval (awaiting decision or sign-off), resolved (solution implemented), closed (issue finalized and archived), escalated (elevated to higher authority).

attributes.name: issue_type
attributes.description: Classification of the issue by nature: design conflict (engineering or architectural discrepancy), contractor dispute (disagreement with contractor), permit delay (regulatory approval holdup), utility conflict (interference with existing water/wastewater/other utilities), community complaint (public or stakeholder concern), or regulatory requirement change (new compliance mandate).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the issue record was most recently updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, observations, or context not captured in structured fields. Used for audit trail and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: preventive_action
attributes.description: Description of systemic changes or process improvements implemented to prevent similar issues on future projects (e.g., updated design standards, enhanced review procedures, training programs).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Urgency and importance classification for resolution sequencing. Critical issues threaten project viability or safety; high issues impact schedule or budget significantly; medium issues require attention but have workarounds; low issues are minor inconveniences.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issue has regulatory or compliance implications (e.g., affects NPDES permit, SDWA compliance, environmental discharge limits). True if regulatory impact exists; false otherwise.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the specific regulation, permit condition, or compliance requirement affected by the issue (e.g., NPDES Permit Section 3.2, SDWA MCL for lead).

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the solution implemented, actions taken, decisions made, and any corrective measures applied to resolve the issue.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis
attributes.description: Detailed investigation findings explaining the fundamental reason the issue occurred. Used for lessons learned and process improvement.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Classification of the underlying cause of the issue: design_error (engineering or architectural mistake), construction_defect (workmanship problem), material_failure (defective or unsuitable materials), coordination_failure (communication or sequencing breakdown), scope_ambiguity (unclear requirements), external_factor (third-party or force majeure).

attributes.name: safety_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issue poses a safety risk to workers, public, or operations. True if safety concern exists; false otherwise.

attributes.name: schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the issue has delayed or is expected to delay the project schedule. Negative values indicate schedule acceleration if issue resolution improved timeline.

attributes.name: scope_impact_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of how the issue affected project scope, including specific deliverables added, removed, or modified.

attributes.name: scope_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issue resulted in a change to project scope (addition, deletion, or modification of deliverables). True if scope was affected; false otherwise.

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: Planned or committed date by which the issue should be resolved. Used for tracking resolution performance and escalation triggers.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title summarizing the issue for quick identification in dashboards and reports.

attributes.name: work_location
attributes.description: Physical location or site area where the issue occurred (e.g., pump station 5, distribution main on Oak Street, wastewater treatment plant clarifier 2). Supports geographic analysis and field coordination.

products.name: closeout_record
products.description: Project closeout record documenting the formal completion and administrative closure of a CIP project including final cost reconciliation, retainage release authorization, punch list completion certification, as-built drawing acceptance, O&M manual delivery confirmation, warranty registration, final regulatory inspection sign-offs, lessons learned documentation, and SAP PS project settlement to fixed assets. Triggers final capitalization entries in SAP FI and asset record creation in IBM Maximo. Represents the definitive end-of-project administrative record.
products.reference: Project Closeout — SAP PS Final Settlement / AWWA Project Closeout Checklist

attributes.name: closeout_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project closeout record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project being closed out.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Project closeout finalizes cost center charges and closes cost center budget lines. Required for departmental budget reconciliation and performance reporting.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Project closeout finalizes fund expenditures and releases remaining fund commitments. Essential for fund balance reconciliation and appropriation closeout.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the closeout record received final approval from the designated authority, authorizing administrative and financial closure.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the authority who provided final approval for the closeout record, authorizing project closure and financial settlement.

attributes.name: as_built_drawings_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when as-built drawings were formally accepted and integrated into the Geographic Information System (GIS) and asset records.

attributes.name: as_built_drawings_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether as-built drawings reflecting actual constructed conditions have been received, reviewed, and accepted by the engineering team.

attributes.name: asset_handover_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all constructed assets have been formally handed over to operations and created in IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS) for ongoing maintenance.

attributes.name: asset_handover_date
attributes.description: Date when assets were formally transferred from the project team to the operations and maintenance team with full documentation.

attributes.name: budget_variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between final approved budget and total actual cost, indicating over or under budget performance (positive = under budget, negative = over budget).

attributes.name: budget_variance_percentage
attributes.description: The budget variance expressed as a percentage of the final approved budget, used for performance analysis and lessons learned.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was placed in service and capitalization entries were posted in SAP FI, triggering depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: closeout_coordinator_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual responsible for coordinating all closeout activities, documentation collection, and stakeholder communications.

attributes.name: closeout_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional closeout information, special circumstances, outstanding issues, or recommendations for future projects.

attributes.name: closeout_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the closeout record, typically following organizational numbering conventions for project administrative closure documentation.

attributes.name: closeout_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the closeout record indicating progression through the administrative closure workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|pending_approval|approved|rejected|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: closeout_type
attributes.description: Classification of the closeout indicating whether it is a standard completion, early termination, partial closeout, or administrative-only closure.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all closeout activities were completed and the project was formally closed in all systems.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this closeout record was first created in the system, marking the beginning of the administrative closure documentation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this closeout record.

attributes.name: final_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the owner formally accepted the completed project deliverables and granted final acceptance for operational turnover.

attributes.name: final_approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: The final approved budget amount including all approved change orders, amendments, and contingency allocations.

attributes.name: final_capitalization_amount
attributes.description: Total amount capitalized to fixed assets in SAP FI, representing the final asset value for depreciation and financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: initiation_date
attributes.description: Date when the project closeout process was formally initiated, marking the beginning of administrative closure activities.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this closeout record, tracking the progression of closeout activities and documentation.

attributes.name: lessons_learned_documented_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether lessons learned documentation has been completed, capturing successes, challenges, and recommendations for future Capital Improvement Program (CIP) projects.

attributes.name: lessons_learned_session_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal lessons learned session was conducted with project team members and stakeholders.

attributes.name: maximo_asset_creation_complete_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: IBM Maximo Asset Creation Complete Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all new assets have been created in IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS) with complete attributes, locations, and preventive maintenance (PM) schedules.

attributes.name: om_manuals_delivery_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Manuals Delivery Date
attributes.description: Date when complete Operations and Maintenance (O&M) manuals were delivered to the operations team for ongoing asset management.

tag_set.value: Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Manuals Delivery Date

attributes.name: om_manuals_received_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Manuals Received Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Operations and Maintenance (O&M) manuals for all installed equipment and systems have been delivered and accepted.

tag_set.value: Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Manuals Received Flag

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The initial approved budget amount for the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project at the time of authorization.

attributes.name: permit_closeout_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all construction permits, National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) permits, and regulatory authorizations have been formally closed out with issuing agencies.

attributes.name: project_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the project manager responsible for overseeing the closeout process and ensuring all administrative requirements are met.

attributes.name: punch_list_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all punch list items were completed and verified, clearing the way for final acceptance and closeout.

attributes.name: punch_list_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of punch list items identified during final inspection that required correction before final acceptance.

attributes.name: regulatory_inspection_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when final regulatory inspection sign-offs were received from all governing agencies, clearing the project for operational use.

attributes.name: regulatory_inspection_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required regulatory inspections by Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), state agencies, and local authorities have been completed and approved.

attributes.name: retainage_release_date
attributes.description: Date when final retainage was authorized for release to contractors following completion of all punch list items and acceptance.
